            copy.next = copy.next.next if copy.next else None
            cur = cur.next
        return new_head

approaches.nameZh: 按效率降序 + 最小堆维护速度
approaches.nameEn: Sort by efficiency + min-heap of speeds
approaches.ideaZh: 团队表现 = 速度和 × 最低效率。枚举谁是团队里效率最低的人：把工程师按效率从高到低排序，扫到第 i 个人时，让他做最低效率，队友只能从前面效率更高的人里选，并且应选速度最大的至多 k − 1 个。用最小堆维护当前选中的速度，超过 k 人就弹出最慢的，同时维护速度和，每步用 速度和 × 当前效率 更新答案。被弹出的若恰好是当前这人，算出的值只会偏小，不影响最大值。最后再对 1e9+7 取模。
approaches.ideaEn: Performance is (sum of speeds) x (minimum efficiency). Enumerate who holds the minimum efficiency: sort engineers by efficiency descending, so when we reach engineer i, teammates must come from those already seen and should be the fastest ones. Keep the chosen speeds in a min-heap, pop the slowest whenever the team exceeds k, maintain the running sum, and update the answer with sum x current efficiency. If the popped one is the current engineer, the value is only an underestimate, so the maximum is unaffected. Take the result mod 1e9+7 at the very end.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 表示前缀 s[0..i-1] 能否被切成字典里的词，dp[0] = True（空串）。对每个 i，枚举最后一个词的长度 L：若 dp[i−L] 为真且 s[i−L..i−1] 在字典中，则 dp[i] 为真。字典放进哈希集合，并且只枚举字典里实际出现过的长度，能少很多无用切片。字典里的词可以重复使用，DP 天然允许这一点；dp[n] 为假就说明无法拆分。复杂度里的 W 为字典中不同词长的个数，L 为切片长度，D 为字典总大小。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] say whether the prefix s[0..i-1] can be split into dictionary words, with dp[0] = True for the empty prefix. For each i, try every possible length L of the last word: dp[i] is true if dp[i-L] is true and s[i-L..i-1] is in the dictionary. Put the words in a hash set and only try lengths that actually occur in it. Words may be reused, which the DP allows naturally; dp[n] false means no split exists. In the bounds, W is the number of distinct word lengths, L the slice length, and D the total size of the dictionary.

approaches.nameZh: 每步贪心选剩余最多的字符
approaches.nameEn: Greedy: place the most plentiful allowed letter
approaches.ideaZh: 每一步都按剩余数量从多到少尝试三个字符：若某字符还有剩余，并且结果末尾不是两个相同的它，就放一个并继续；剩余最多的字符被“三连”规则卡住时，自动退而选次多的，相当于插入一个隔板。三个字符都放不了就结束。优先消耗最多的字符，是为了避免最后只剩一种字符而被迫停下，从而得到最长的结果。每步只对 3 个计数排序，是常数开销，所以总时间是线性的；空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: At each step try the letters in order of remaining count: place the first one that still has copies and would not make three in a row, then repeat. When the most plentiful letter is blocked by the no-triple rule, the next one is used as a separator automatically. Stop when no letter can be placed. Spending the most plentiful letter first keeps us from ending up with a single letter left over, which is what maximizes the length. Sorting three counts per step is constant work, so the total time is linear; space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 哈希集合记录访问过的节点
approaches.ideaZh: 沿着 next 往下走，把每个经过的节点（对象本身，不是值）放进集合。如果某次走到的节点已经在集合里，说明绕回来了，有环；如果走到了 None，说明链表有尽头，无环。思路直接，但需要 O(n) 额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk along next and put every visited node (the object, not its value) into a set. Meeting a node already in the set means we looped back, so there is a cycle; reaching None means the list ends. Simple, but it costs O(n) extra space.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.next = None

class Solution:
    def hasCycle(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        seen = set()
        while head:
            if head in seen:
                return True
            seen.add(head)
            head = head.next
        return False

approaches.ideaZh: 慢指针每次走一步，快指针每次走两步。无环时快指针会先走到 None，循环结束。有环时两者最终都会进入环，进环后快指针每轮比慢指针多走一步，相对距离每次缩小 1，所以一定会相遇而不会跳过。终止条件是“相遇”而不是“走到末尾”，只用两个指针，空间 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Move slow one step and fast two steps at a time. Without a cycle, fast reaches None and we stop. With a cycle both pointers end up inside it, and fast gains exactly one step per round, so the gap shrinks by one each time and they must meet rather than skip past each other. The stopping signal is meeting, not reaching the end, and only two pointers are used.

approaches.nameZh: 哈希集合找第一个重复节点
approaches.ideaZh: 从头沿 next 遍历并记录访问过的节点。第一个被再次访问到的节点，就是从链表头出发第一次进入环的位置，也就是入环点；走到 None 则无环返回 None。实现最直接，代价是 O(n) 的额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk from the head and record every node visited. The first node seen a second time is where the walk first entered the loop, which is the cycle entrance; reaching None means there is no cycle. The most direct version, at the cost of O(n) extra space.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.next = None

class Solution:
    def detectCycle(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        seen = set()
        while head:
            if head in seen:
                return head
            seen.add(head)
            head = head.next
        return None

approaches.nameZh: 快慢指针 + 距离推导
approaches.nameEn: Floyd's algorithm with the distance argument
approaches.ideaZh: 先用快慢指针判断是否有环并找到相遇点。设头到入环点距离为 a，入环点到相遇点为 b，环长为 L。相遇时快指针走的路程是慢指针的两倍：2(a + b) = a + b + kL，得到 a = kL − b，即从相遇点再走 a 步恰好回到入环点（绕了若干整圈）。所以让一个指针从头出发，另一个从相遇点出发，同速每次一步，它们相遇的节点就是入环点。
approaches.ideaEn: First run fast/slow pointers to detect a cycle and find their meeting point. Let a be the distance from head to the entrance, b from the entrance to the meeting point, and L the loop length. Fast travels twice as far: 2(a + b) = a + b + kL, so a = kL - b, meaning a steps from the meeting point land exactly on the entrance after whole laps. Start one pointer at head and one at the meeting point, move both one step at a time, and they meet at the entrance.

approaches.nameZh: 总和减去最小中间窗口
approaches.nameEn: Total minus the minimum middle window
approaches.ideaZh: 无论从两端怎么拿，拿完 k 张后剩下的一定是中间一段连续的 n − k 张牌。所以“拿到的最大”等价于“剩下的最小”：用长度固定为 n − k 的滑动窗口扫一遍，求出最小窗口和，再用总和减去它。k = n 时窗口长度为 0，最小和为 0，答案就是总和。
approaches.ideaEn: However the k cards are taken from the two ends, what remains is a contiguous block of n - k cards in the middle. So maximizing what we take is the same as minimizing what stays: slide a fixed window of length n - k, track its minimum sum, and subtract it from the total. When k = n the window is empty with sum 0, so the answer is the full total.

approaches.ideaZh: 链表的难点在于不能随机访问，拿不到“倒数第 i 个”节点。先把所有节点按顺序放进数组，就能用下标直接取任意位置。左右两个下标向中间靠拢，交替执行 nodes[i]→nodes[j]、nodes[j]→nodes[i+1] 的连接。两个下标相遇的位置就是新链表的尾巴，把它的 next 置空，否则会成环。
approaches.ideaEn: A linked list has no random access, so copy every node into an array first. Two indices walk inward from both ends, alternately linking nodes[i] -> nodes[j] and nodes[j] -> nodes[i+1]. The node where they meet becomes the new tail; clear its next pointer to avoid a cycle.

approaches.nameZh: 找中点 + 反转后半 + 交替合并
approaches.nameEn: Find middle, reverse second half, merge
approaches.ideaZh: 观察目标顺序 L0→Ln→L1→Ln-1→…，它其实就是“前半段”与“反转后的后半段”交替拼接。第一步用快慢指针找到中点并从这里断开；第二步把后半段原地反转；第三步把两条链表像拉链一样交替穿插。三步都是线性扫描且只改指针，额外空间是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: The target order is the first half interleaved with the reversed second half. Find the middle with slow/fast pointers and cut there, reverse the second half in place, then zip the two lists together. Three linear passes of pure pointer rewiring, O(1) extra space.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口 + 单调队列
approaches.ideaZh: “窗口内最大值减最小值 ≤ limit”具有单调性：一个窗口合法，它的任何子窗口也合法，因此可以用双指针滑动窗口。关键是快速拿到窗口的最值：维护一个单调递减队列（队头是最大值）和一个单调递增队列（队头是最小值）。右端加入新元素时，从队尾弹掉不可能再成为最值的元素；如果两个队头之差超过 limit，就右移左端，被移出的元素若正好是队头就一并弹出。每个元素最多进出每个队列一次，整体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: Validity is monotone (every sub-window of a valid window is valid), so a sliding window works. Keep a decreasing deque whose front is the window max and an increasing deque whose front is the min. When max - min exceeds limit, advance the left end and pop deque fronts that leave the window. Each element enters and leaves each deque at most once, so the whole scan is linear.

approaches.ideaZh: 前序遍历的定义本身就是递归的：先访问根，再前序遍历左子树，最后前序遍历右子树。写一个辅助函数，遇到空节点直接返回，否则按“根-左-右”的顺序记录节点值并递归。每个节点恰好访问一次，递归栈深度等于树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Preorder is defined recursively: visit the root, then the left subtree, then the right subtree. A helper returns on null and otherwise records the value before recursing left and right. Each node is visited once and the call stack is as deep as the tree.

approaches.ideaZh: 把递归的调用栈换成自己维护的栈。弹出栈顶节点后立刻记录它的值，然后先压右孩子、再压左孩子——栈是后进先出，这样左子树会先被处理，正好是“根-左-右”。这种写法不受递归深度限制，也是面试中最常被追问的版本。
approaches.ideaEn: Replace the call stack with your own. Pop a node and record it, then push the right child before the left so the left subtree comes out first (LIFO), which gives root-left-right. No recursion-depth limit, and it is the version interviewers usually ask for as a follow-up.

approaches.ideaZh: 一个节点是不是“好节点”，只取决于从根到它的这条路径：路径上没有比它更大的值。所以在 DFS 往下走的时候，把“当前路径上的最大值”当作参数传下去即可。到达节点时，若它的值不小于这个最大值就计数，再用更新后的最大值递归左右子树。每个节点只访问一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Whether a node is good depends only on its root-to-node path, so pass the path maximum down during DFS. A node counts if its value is at least that maximum; then recurse into both children with the updated maximum. Each node is visited once.

approaches.ideaZh: 后序遍历的顺序是“左-右-根”：先递归处理左子树，再递归处理右子树，最后才记录当前节点。空节点直接返回。每个节点访问一次，递归栈深度等于树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Postorder is left-right-root: recurse into the left subtree, then the right, and only then record the current node. Return immediately on null. Each node is visited once; the call stack is as deep as the tree.

approaches.ideaZh: 后序“左-右-根”整体倒过来就是“根-右-左”，而后者只是把前序遍历中左右孩子的处理顺序对调。于是用栈做一遍“根-右-左”遍历：弹出节点就记录，然后先压左孩子、再压右孩子。最后把结果数组反转，就得到后序序列。比起用 prev 指针判断右子树是否已访问的写法，这个技巧更不容易写错。
approaches.ideaEn: Postorder (left-right-root) reversed is root-right-left, which is just preorder with the children swapped. Run that with a stack (record on pop, push left then right) and reverse the output at the end. Much harder to get wrong than the prev-pointer version.

approaches.ideaZh: 窗口长度固定为 k，相邻两个窗口只差一个进来的字符和一个出去的字符。先数出第一个窗口里的元音个数，之后每右移一步，加上新进入的字符是否为元音，减去离开的字符是否为元音，并更新最大值。这样每个窗口的计数是 O(1) 得到的，不必重新数 k 个字符。
approaches.ideaEn: Windows have fixed length k, and neighboring windows differ by one char in and one char out. Count vowels in the first window, then on each shift add the entering char and subtract the leaving one, tracking the maximum. Each window costs O(1) instead of recounting k chars.

approaches.nameZh: 有序字典 / 标准库链表 + 哈希表
approaches.ideaZh: LRU 需要两件事都做到 O(1)：按 key 查值，以及维护“最近使用”的先后顺序。Python 的 OrderedDict 底层就是“哈希表 + 双向链表”：move_to_end 把刚访问的 key 挪到末尾，popitem(last=False) 弹出最久未使用的那个。C++ 用 std::list 存 (key, value)，再用 unordered_map 记录 key 到链表迭代器的映射，splice 可以 O(1) 把节点挪到表头。面试时可以先写这一版，再解释它的底层结构。
approaches.ideaEn: LRU needs O(1) lookup by key and O(1) reordering by recency. Python's OrderedDict is already a hash map plus a doubly linked list: move_to_end marks a key as most recent and popitem(last=False) evicts the oldest. In C++, a std::list of (key, value) plus an unordered_map from key to list iterator does the same, and splice moves a node to the front in O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 手写哈希表 + 双向链表
approaches.nameEn: Hand-written hash map + doubly linked list
approaches.ideaZh: 面试官往往希望看到底层实现。链表按使用时间排序：靠近头部的是最近用过的，靠近尾部的是最久没用的。头尾各放一个哨兵节点，插入和删除就不用处理空链表等边界。get 命中时把节点摘下再插到头部；put 时若 key 已存在就更新值并移到头部，否则新建节点插到头部，超出容量就删除尾哨兵前面的节点，并同步从哈希表里移除。节点里必须存 key，否则淘汰时无法反查哈希表。
approaches.ideaEn: The hand-rolled version keeps nodes ordered by recency, most recent next to the head. Sentinel head and tail nodes remove every edge case. get moves a hit to the front; put updates and moves an existing key, or inserts a new node at the front and evicts the node before the tail sentinel when over capacity. Each node stores its key so eviction can also delete it from the map.

approaches.ideaZh: 问题本质是：在有向图里，u 能不能走到 v。课程数最多 100，可以直接求整张图的可达矩阵。借用 Floyd 的思路：依次把每门课 k 当作“中转点”，如果 i 能到 k 且 k 能到 j，那么 i 就能到 j。三重循环结束后，每个查询直接查表即可，n³ = 10⁶ 次运算完全够快。
approaches.ideaEn: The question is reachability in a directed graph, and n ≤ 100 allows computing the full reachability matrix. Floyd-style: for each intermediate course k, if i reaches k and k reaches j, then i reaches j. After the triple loop every query is a table lookup, and n³ = 10⁶ is cheap.

approaches.ideaZh: 先修关系构成一张 DAG，可以按拓扑序处理。给每门课维护一个位集合，记录它所有直接或间接的先修课。用 Kahn 算法从入度为 0 的课开始出队，处理边 u→v 时，把 u 的先修集合连同 u 本身一起并入 v 的集合；由于 u 出队时它的所有先修都已处理完，这个集合一定是完整的。查询 (u, v) 只需看 v 的集合中第 u 位是否为 1。位运算让每次合并只需 n/64 个机器字。时间里的 w = 64 为机器字长。
approaches.ideaEn: Prerequisites form a DAG, so process courses in Kahn topological order while each course keeps a bitset of all its direct and indirect prerequisites. For edge u -> v, OR u's set plus u itself into v's set; u is dequeued only after all its own prerequisites, so its set is already complete. A query (u, v) checks bit u of v's set. Each merge costs about n/64 machine words. Here w = 64 is the machine word size.

approaches.nameZh: 从 0 出发遍历，统计背离的边
approaches.nameEn: Traverse from city 0, count outward edges
approaches.ideaZh: 把每条路当作无向边存进图里，同时记住它原本的方向。从城市 0 出发做一次 DFS（或 BFS）向外扩展：如果走过的这条边原方向是“从当前点指向更远的点”，说明它背离 0，需要翻转，计数加一；如果原方向本来就指向当前点（朝着 0），就不用动。因为图是一棵树，每条边恰好被走一次，累加的结果就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Store each road as an undirected edge tagged with its original direction. Traverse outward from city 0: an edge whose original direction points from the current node to the next one points away from 0 and must be flipped, so add 1; an edge already pointing toward the current node costs 0. The graph is a tree, so each edge is examined exactly once.

approaches.nameZh: 哑节点 + 链表插入排序
approaches.ideaZh: 思路和数组上的插入排序一样：维护一条“已排好序”的链表，把原链表的节点逐个插进去。用一个哑节点作为有序链表的头，插入时从哑节点往后找，停在最后一个值小于当前节点的位置，然后改两根指针完成插入。链表插入本身是 O(1)，但寻找位置是 O(n)，所以总体 O(n²)，好处是不需要额外数组。注意要先保存 cur.next，再修改指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Same as insertion sort on an array: keep a sorted list behind a dummy head and insert the original nodes one by one. For each node, walk from the dummy to the last node with a smaller value and splice it in with two pointer updates. The splice is O(1) but finding the spot is O(n), so O(n²) overall with no extra array. Save cur.next before relinking.

approaches.nameZh: 数组 + 当前指针 + 有效右边界
approaches.ideaZh: 用一个数组按顺序存访问过的页面，用下标 cur 表示当前所在的页面。back 和 forward 只是把 cur 向左或向右移动，并夹在合法范围内，都是 O(1)。关键在 visit：访问新页面要清空所有“前进”记录。不必真的删除数组尾部，只需把新页面写到 cur+1 的位置，并用 last 记录“有效历史的最后一位”，forward 不能越过它。这样所有操作都是 O(1)。visit 的 O(1) 是均摊意义下的，因为可能要在数组末尾追加。
approaches.ideaEn: Store visited pages in an array and keep an index cur for the current page. back and forward just move cur and clamp it, O(1). visit must discard forward history: instead of truncating, overwrite position cur+1 and record last, the end of the valid history, which forward may not pass. Every operation is O(1). visit is O(1) amortized, since it may append to the array.

approaches.ideaZh: 链表不能随机访问，快排、堆排都不好写，而归并排序天然适合链表：合并两条有序链表只需改指针，不需要额外数组。用快慢指针找到中点并断开，递归排序左右两半，再把结果合并。递归深度是 log n，所以额外空间是 O(log n)。让 fast 从 head.next 出发，可以保证只有两个节点时也能正确切成两半，不会无限递归。
approaches.ideaEn: Merge sort suits linked lists: merging two sorted lists is pure pointer work with no extra array. Find the middle with slow/fast pointers, cut, sort both halves recursively and merge them. Recursion depth is log n. Starting fast at head.next guarantees a two-node list splits into two halves instead of recursing forever.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果要求常数额外空间，就把递归改成迭代。先把链表看成若干长度为 1 的有序段，两两合并成长度 2，再合并成长度 4……直到段长不小于 n。每一轮从头扫描：用 split 依次切下两段长度为 size 的子链表，合并后接到已处理部分的尾巴上。没有递归栈，额外空间 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: For O(1) extra space, replace recursion with passes. Treat the list as sorted runs of length 1, merge pairs into runs of 2, then 4, and so on until the run length reaches n. Each pass cuts off two runs of length size with split, merges them and appends the result to the tail of the processed part. No recursion stack.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + 贪心判定
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the day + greedy check
approaches.ideaZh: 等待的天数越多，开的花越多，能做出的花束只会增加不会减少——答案具有单调性，可以二分“天数”。给定天数 day，从左到右扫一遍：连续开花的计数达到 k 就凑成一束并清零，遇到还没开的花也清零，最后看束数是否 ≥ m。在 [最早开花日, 最晚开花日] 上二分出最小的可行天数。如果 m·k 超过花的总数，无论等多久都做不到，直接返回 -1。其中 M = max(bloomDay)。
approaches.ideaEn: Waiting longer only adds bloomed flowers and never removes bouquets, so feasibility is monotone in the day and we can binary search it. For a candidate day, scan once: count consecutive bloomed flowers, form a bouquet whenever the run reaches k, and reset on an unbloomed flower. Search [min bloom, max bloom] for the smallest feasible day. If m·k exceeds the number of flowers, return -1 immediately. Here M = max(bloomDay).

approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with at most one zero
approaches.ideaZh: 删掉一个元素后得到的全 1 子数组，对应原数组中一个“最多包含一个 0”的窗口，再减去被删的那一个元素。用滑动窗口维护窗口内 0 的个数，超过 1 个就收缩左端。每个合法窗口的贡献是“长度 - 1”。即使整个数组全是 1，题目也要求必须删一个，所以统一减 1 恰好正确。
approaches.ideaEn: After deleting one element, the all-ones run corresponds to a window containing at most one zero, minus the deleted element. Slide a window tracking its zero count and shrink from the left whenever the count exceeds 1. Each window contributes length - 1; since a deletion is mandatory even when everything is 1, subtracting 1 everywhere is exactly right.

approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，再枚举第一个数 nums[i]，问题就变成在它右边的有序区间里找两个数，使和为 -nums[i]。用左右双指针：和偏小就右移左指针，和偏大就左移右指针，相等就记录答案并同时收缩。去重发生在两处：相同的 nums[i] 只处理第一次；找到一组解后跳过与刚才相同的左指针值。如果 nums[i] > 0，后面的数都更大，不可能凑出 0，可以提前结束。O(log n) 空间来自排序，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort, fix the first number nums[i], and the rest becomes two-sum on the sorted suffix with target -nums[i]: move the left pointer right when the sum is too small and the right pointer left when it is too large. Deduplicate in two places: skip a repeated nums[i], and after recording a triple skip left values equal to the one just used. Once nums[i] > 0 nothing can sum to zero, so stop early. The O(log n) space is used by sorting; the output is not counted.

approaches.ideaZh: 逆波兰表达式天然适合用栈求值：遇到数字就入栈；遇到运算符就弹出两个数，先弹出的是右操作数，后弹出的是左操作数，计算后把结果压回栈。操作数顺序很重要，减法和除法不能颠倒。题目要求除法向零截断：C++ 的整数除法本来就是如此，而 Python 的 // 是向下取整，负数时会出错，所以用 int(a / b)。最后栈里剩下的唯一元素就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: RPN evaluates naturally with a stack: push numbers; on an operator pop two values (the first popped is the right operand), apply the operator and push the result. Operand order matters for - and /. Division truncates toward zero: C++ integer division already does, while Python's // floors and is wrong for negatives, so use int(a / b). The single value left on the stack is the answer.

approaches.nameZh: 分割 + 反转 + 拼接
approaches.ideaZh: 直接利用语言内置能力：不带参数的 split 会按任意空白切分，并自动丢掉首尾空格和连续空格，得到干净的单词列表；把列表反转后用单个空格拼接即可。C++ 中用 istringstream 的 >> 逐个读单词，效果相同。这是实际工程中最该写的版本，代码短、不易出错。
approaches.ideaEn: Let the standard library do the work: argument-less split breaks on any whitespace and drops leading, trailing and repeated spaces; reverse the word list and join with single spaces. In C++, reading words with istringstream >> behaves the same. This is the version to write in production code.

approaches.nameZh: 整体反转 + 逐词反转（原地）
approaches.nameEn: Reverse everything, then each word (in place)
approaches.ideaZh: 面试的进阶要求通常是对可变字符串做到 O(1) 额外空间。先把整个字符串反转，此时单词的先后顺序已经对了，只是每个单词内部是倒着的。再扫描一遍，用写指针 w 把单词紧凑地搬到前面（单词之间只补一个空格），每搬完一个单词就在原地把它翻转回来。最后截断到长度 w。Python 字符串不可变，所以转成字符列表来演示同样的思路。O(1) 指 C++ 的原地操作；Python 的字符列表本身占 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: The usual follow-up asks for O(1) extra space on a mutable string. Reverse the whole string: word order is now correct but each word is backwards. Scan once with a write pointer w, compacting each word to the front with a single separating space and reversing it in place right after copying. Truncate to w. Python strings are immutable, so the Python version applies the same idea to a char list. O(1) refers to the in-place C++ version; the Python char list takes O(n).

approaches.nameZh: 同时维护最大积与最小积
approaches.nameEn: Track both max and min products
approaches.ideaZh: 和“最大子数组和”不同，乘积遇到负数会翻转大小：当前最小（最负）的乘积乘上一个负数，可能立刻变成最大。所以遍历时要同时维护“以当前位置结尾的最大乘积 hi”和“最小乘积 lo”。遇到负数先交换两者，再分别在“从 x 自己重新开始”和“接在前面后面”之间取更优。每一步都用 hi 更新全局答案；遇到 0 时两者都会被重置为 0，下一步自然从新元素重新开始。
approaches.ideaEn: Unlike maximum subarray sum, a negative factor flips the order: the most negative product times a negative number can become the largest. So track both the max (hi) and the min (lo) product of subarrays ending at the current index. On a negative element swap them first, then update each with the better of starting fresh at x or extending. Update the answer with hi at every step; a zero resets both naturally.

approaches.nameZh: 与右端点比较的二分查找
approaches.nameEn: Binary search against the right end
approaches.ideaZh: 旋转后的数组由两段递增序列组成，最小值就是第二段的开头。拿 nums[mid] 和区间右端 nums[hi] 比较：若 nums[mid] > nums[hi]，说明 mid 落在第一段，最小值一定在 mid 右边；否则 mid 落在第二段（或数组根本没旋转），最小值在 mid 处或其左边。每次排除一半，直到 lo == hi。和右端比较而不是和左端比较，可以统一处理“没有旋转”的情况。
approaches.ideaEn: A rotated sorted array is two increasing runs, and the minimum starts the second run. Compare nums[mid] with nums[hi]: if it is larger, mid lies in the first run and the minimum is strictly to its right; otherwise the minimum is at mid or to its left. Halve until lo == hi. Comparing with the right end instead of the left handles the unrotated case without special-casing.

approaches.nameZh: 后序 DFS 返回叶子距离计数
approaches.ideaZh: 两片叶子之间的最短路径一定经过它们的最近公共祖先，所以只需在每个节点统计“一片来自左子树、一片来自右子树”的叶子对，就能不重不漏。后序 DFS 让每个子树返回一个计数数组：cnt[d] 表示距离为 d 的叶子有多少片，距离超过 distance 的叶子以后不可能再配对，直接丢弃。在当前节点枚举左边距离 i 和右边距离 j，只要 i + j ≤ distance 就累加 L[i]·R[j]；然后把所有距离加一返回给父节点。distance ≤ 10，所以每个节点只有很小的 O(D²) 开销。其中 D 就是 distance。
approaches.ideaEn: The path between two leaves passes through their lowest common ancestor, so count each pair exactly once there: one leaf from the left subtree and one from the right. A post-order DFS returns, for each subtree, an array cnt[d] of leaves at distance d; leaves farther than distance can never pair again and are dropped. At a node, add L[i]·R[j] for every i + j ≤ distance, then shift all distances by one for the parent. With distance ≤ 10 the work per node is a tiny O(D²). Here D is distance.

approaches.nameZh: 二分查找，相等时收缩右端
approaches.nameEn: Binary search, shrink right end on ties
approaches.ideaZh: 这是 153 题的加强版，多了重复元素。nums[mid] 严格大于或严格小于 nums[hi] 时，处理方式与无重复版本完全相同。麻烦在相等：例如 [1,1,1,0,1] 和 [1,0,1,1,1]，单凭比较无法判断最小值在哪一侧。但既然 nums[mid] 与 nums[hi] 相等，即使 nums[hi] 恰好是最小值，mid 处也保留着同样的值，所以可以放心地把 hi 减一。最坏情况（几乎全相等）会退化到 O(n)，这是重复元素带来的必然代价，一般情况仍是 O(log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: This is problem 153 with duplicates. When nums[mid] is strictly greater or smaller than nums[hi], proceed exactly as before. On a tie (e.g. [1,1,1,0,1] vs [1,0,1,1,1]) we cannot tell which side holds the minimum, but nums[mid] keeps a copy of nums[hi]'s value, so decrementing hi never loses the answer. The worst case (almost all equal) degrades to O(n), which duplicates make unavoidable; typical inputs stay O(log n).

approaches.nameZh: 栈中同时保存“当前最小值”
approaches.nameEn: Store the running minimum with each entry
approaches.ideaZh: 栈只会在顶部发生变化，所以“当前最小值”只取决于从栈底到栈顶这一段元素。每次 push 时，把新值和“压入前的最小值”取较小者，与新值一起存成一对。这样栈顶那一对的第二个分量永远是整个栈的最小值；pop 之后，新的栈顶自然记录着之前的最小值，不需要任何额外处理。四个操作都是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: A stack only changes at its top, so the current minimum depends only on the elements below. On push, store the value together with min(value, previous minimum). The top pair's second field is then always the stack's minimum, and after a pop the new top already holds the previous minimum. All four operations are O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 二分答案 + 贪心放球
approaches.nameEn: Sort + binary search on the gap + greedy placement
approaches.ideaZh: “让最小间距最大”是典型的二分答案：如果最小间距至少为 gap 能做到，那么任何更小的间距也一定能做到，具有单调性。判定时先排序，贪心地把第一个球放在最左边，之后每遇到一个与上一个球距离 ≥ gap 的位置就放一个球——越早放，给后面留的空间越多，所以贪心最优。最后看放下的球数是否 ≥ m。答案的上界是 (最右 - 最左) / (m - 1)，下界是 1。其中 R 为最大与最小位置之差，O(log n) 空间来自排序。
approaches.ideaEn: "Maximize the minimum gap" is classic binary search on the answer: if gap g is achievable, every smaller gap is too. To test g, sort and greedily put the first ball at the leftmost position, then put a ball at each position at least g past the previous ball; placing as early as possible leaves the most room, so greedy is optimal. Check whether at least m balls fit. The answer lies in [1, (max - min) / (m - 1)]. Here R = max - min of the positions, and the O(log n) space is used by sorting.
approaches.time: O(n log n + n log R)

approaches.ideaZh: 把每一对点之间的曼哈顿距离看作一条边，问题就是求这张完全图的最小生成树。Kruskal 的做法是把所有边按长度从小到大排序后依次尝试加入：用并查集判断两个端点是否已经连通，已连通就跳过（否则会成环），未连通就合并并累加边权。选够 n-1 条边即可提前结束。它的缺点是要存储并排序 n(n-1)/2 条边，在完全图上偏慢、偏占内存。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat every pair of points as an edge weighted by Manhattan distance; the answer is the minimum spanning tree of this complete graph. Kruskal sorts all edges ascending and adds each edge whose endpoints are not yet connected (union-find detects that), stopping after n - 1 edges. The drawback is storing and sorting all n(n-1)/2 edges, which is heavy on a dense graph.

approaches.ideaZh: 完全图是最稠密的图，这时不用堆的朴素 Prim 反而最合适。维护 dist[v]：点 v 到“当前生成树”的最短连接边长。每一轮选出不在树中、dist 最小的点加入生成树并累加它的 dist，再用这个新点去更新其余点的 dist。一共 n 轮、每轮 O(n)，总计 O(n²)；而且边权是现算的，不需要存储任何边。
approaches.ideaEn: A complete graph is as dense as it gets, which is exactly where heap-free Prim shines. Keep dist[v], the cheapest edge from the current tree to point v. Each round, add the outside point with the smallest dist, add that dist to the total, and relax every other point through it. n rounds of O(n) work, and edge weights are computed on the fly so no edge list is stored.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口 + 哈希计数
approaches.ideaZh: 满足“最多两种字符”的窗口，其任何子窗口也满足，所以可以用滑动窗口。右指针每次纳入一个字符，用哈希表统计窗口内各字符的出现次数；当字符种类超过 2 时，不断右移左指针并减少计数，计数归零就从表中删除，直到种类回到 2 以内。每一步都用窗口长度更新答案。左右指针都只向前移动，所以是线性时间。哈希表里最多同时有 3 个键，所以空间是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Any sub-window of a window with at most two distinct chars also qualifies, so a sliding window applies. Extend the right end one char at a time and count chars in a hash map; while the map holds more than two keys, advance the left end, decrementing counts and deleting keys that reach zero. Update the answer with the window length each step. Both pointers only move forward, so it is linear. The map never holds more than 3 keys, so the space is O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 回溯 + 剩余长度剪枝
approaches.ideaZh: 从下标 i 开始枚举下一段子串 s[i:j]，只要它没在已用集合里出现过，就放进集合继续切剩下的部分，回来时再移除。切到末尾时，集合大小就是一种合法拆分的段数，用它更新答案。剪枝的关键：剩下 n-i 个字符最多再切出 n-i 段，如果「已用段数 + n-i」都不超过当前最优，这条分支不可能更好，直接返回。长度 n ≤ 16，配合剪枝搜索量很小。时间是最坏情况的上界，剪枝后实际搜索量远小于此。
approaches.ideaEn: From index i, try every next piece s[i:j]; if it is not already used, add it to the set, recurse on the rest, then remove it. Reaching the end gives a valid split whose size updates the answer. Prune: the remaining n-i characters can add at most n-i pieces, so if used + (n-i) cannot beat the best, stop this branch. With n <= 16 the pruned search is tiny. The time is a worst-case bound; pruning keeps the real search far smaller.

approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，固定第一个数 nums[i]，在它右边用左右指针找另外两个数。每算出一个三数和，先和当前最优比较「离 target 多近」，再决定指针怎么动：和偏小就右移左指针，偏大就左移右指针，恰好相等直接返回。更新答案和移动指针是两件独立的事，先更新再移动，就不会漏掉任何候选。排序后指针的移动方向是单调的，所以每个 i 只需要线性扫描一次。O(log n) 的空间来自排序用的栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort, fix the first number nums[i], and run two pointers on the suffix to its right. For each triple sum, first compare its distance to target against the best so far, then move pointers: too small moves left forward, too large moves right back, equal returns immediately. Keeping "update best" separate from "move a pointer" guarantees no candidate is skipped; sorting makes each scan linear. The O(log n) space is the sort’s stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 先把链表 A 的每个节点（按节点身份，而不是值）放进集合。再从头走链表 B，第一个出现在集合里的节点就是相交起点；走完都没有就说明不相交。思路直接，但需要额外 O(m) 空间，是理解后面双指针解法的铺垫。
approaches.ideaEn: Store every node of list A in a set (by identity, not value). Walk list B; the first node found in the set is the intersection, otherwise return null. Simple but costs O(m) extra space, which motivates the two-pointer trick.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 A 独有部分长 a，B 独有部分长 b，公共部分长 c。指针 pa 走完 A 后跳到 B 的头，pb 走完 B 后跳到 A 的头，两者都走了 a + b + c 步后会在交点相遇。如果不相交，两者都走 a + b 步后同时变成空指针，循环同样结束并返回空。只用两个指针，不需要额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Let A own a nodes, B own b nodes, and the shared tail be c nodes. Pointer pa walks A then jumps to B's head; pb walks B then jumps to A's head. After a + b + c steps both stand on the intersection; if there is none, both become null after a + b steps and the loop ends. Constant extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 nums[-1] 和 nums[n] 看成负无穷，那么只要往「上坡」方向走，一定能碰到峰值。取中点 mid：若 nums[mid] < nums[mid+1]，右侧在上坡，右半边必有峰值，令 lo = mid + 1；否则 mid 本身或其左侧必有峰值，令 hi = mid。区间每次减半，lo 与 hi 相遇处就是一个峰值。相邻元素互不相等，保证了每次比较都能确定方向。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat both ends as minus infinity; walking uphill must eventually reach a peak. At mid, if nums[mid] < nums[mid+1] the right side climbs, so a peak lies in (mid, hi]; otherwise one lies in [lo, mid]. Halve the range until lo == hi, which is a peak. Adjacent values differ, so each comparison picks a direction.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 类 LIS 的 O(n²) DP
approaches.ideaZh: 按 (年龄, 分数) 升序排序后，冲突只可能发生在「年龄小却分数高」的人身上，所以合法球队在排序后的分数必须单调不降。问题就变成：求分数不降子序列的最大分数和。dp[i] 表示以第 i 个人结尾的最优和，等于他的分数加上所有 j < i 且分数不超过他的 dp[j] 的最大值。答案是所有 dp[i] 的最大值。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort by (age, score). A conflict means a younger player scores higher, so after sorting a valid team must have non-decreasing scores. The task becomes a maximum-sum non-decreasing subsequence. dp[i] = score[i] + max dp[j] over j < i with score[j] <= score[i]; the answer is max dp.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 树状数组维护前缀最大值
approaches.nameEn: Sort + Fenwick tree of prefix maxima
approaches.ideaZh: 沿用上面的排序和状态定义，瓶颈在于「分数不超过 sc 的最大 dp」需要 O(n) 去找。把分数离散化后用树状数组维护「分数 ≤ v 的 dp 最大值」，查询和更新都是 O(log n)。按排序顺序处理每个人：先查前缀最大值再加上自己的分数，然后把结果写回自己分数的位置。同龄人按分数升序处理，前面的同龄人分数更低，被包含在前缀里也不会冲突。
approaches.ideaEn: Same sort and state, but the "best dp among scores <= sc" lookup is the O(n) bottleneck. Compress scores and keep a Fenwick tree of prefix maxima, so each lookup and update is O(log n). Process players in sorted order: query the prefix max, add own score, write the result back at own score. Same-age players come in increasing score, so including them in the prefix is always safe.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + BFS 连通性判断
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the answer + BFS reachability
approaches.ideaZh: 「体力消耗不超过 limit 能否走到终点」具有单调性：limit 越大，可走的边越多。于是二分 limit，在 [0, 10^6] 上找最小的可行值。判定时只允许走高度差 ≤ limit 的相邻格子，从左上角做一次 BFS/DFS，看能否到达右下角。这个思路把「最小化路径上的最大边」转化成了一系列简单的连通性问题。复杂度里的 H 为最大高度。
approaches.ideaEn: "Can we reach the end with effort <= limit" is monotone in limit, so binary search limit over [0, 10^6]. The check only uses edges whose height difference is <= limit and runs a BFS/DFS from the top-left corner. This turns "minimize the maximum edge on a path" into a series of plain reachability tests. In the time bound, H is the maximum height.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个格子看成点，相邻格子之间的边权是高度差，路径代价定义为路径上最大的边权。这个代价沿路径只增不减，满足 Dijkstra 的贪心前提：堆顶弹出的格子，其最小代价已经确定。松弛时新代价是 max(当前代价, 边权)，比记录值小就入堆。第一次弹出右下角时，对应的代价就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Cells are vertices, edges weigh the height difference, and a path costs its largest edge. That cost never decreases along a path, so Dijkstra's greedy invariant holds: a cell popped from the heap is final. Relax with max(current cost, edge weight); the first time the bottom-right cell is popped, its cost is the answer.

approaches.nameZh: 贪心：小顶堆保存梯子用在哪里
approaches.nameEn: Greedy: a min-heap holds the climbs that use ladders
approaches.ideaZh: 梯子不论高度差多大都只算一次，所以应该留给最大的那几次攀爬，砖块去填小的。从左往右走，遇到需要上升的一步就把高度差压入小顶堆，先假设用梯子。一旦堆的大小超过梯子数，就把堆里最小的高度差改成用砖块支付；砖块变成负数时，说明这一步走不过去，当前下标就是答案。全程都能走通则返回最后一个下标。复杂度里的 L 为梯子数。
approaches.ideaEn: A ladder covers any gap at the same cost, so ladders should go to the largest climbs and bricks to the small ones. Walk left to right; push every positive climb into a min-heap, tentatively using a ladder. When the heap holds more climbs than ladders, pay for its smallest climb with bricks; if bricks go negative, the current index is the answer. If every step succeeds, return the last index. In the bounds, L is the number of ladders.

approaches.nameZh: 后序遍历 + 计数确认两个节点都存在
approaches.nameEn: Post-order DFS that counts both targets
approaches.ideaZh: 和普通 LCA 一样做后序遍历：子树里找到 p 或 q 就往上返回，左右子树各返回一个非空时，当前节点就是公共祖先。区别在于 p、q 不一定在树中，所以不能找到一个就提前返回，必须把整棵树遍历完，并统计真正命中了几个目标。先递归左右子树，再判断当前节点是否为 p 或 q，这样即使 p 是 q 的祖先，q 也会被计数。最后只有计数等于 2 时才返回结果，否则返回空。
approaches.ideaEn: Run the usual post-order LCA: a subtree returns p or q when it finds one, and a node whose two children both return non-null is the LCA. Here p or q may be missing, so we must not short-circuit; visit the whole tree and count how many targets were actually hit. Recursing into children before checking the node itself ensures q is counted even when p is its ancestor. Return the result only when the count is 2.

approaches.nameZh: 哈希集合记录 p 的祖先链
approaches.ideaZh: 有了 parent 指针，从 p 一路往上走到根，把经过的节点（含 p 自己）都放进集合。再从 q 往上走，第一个出现在集合中的节点就是最近公共祖先。实现简单，但要 O(h) 额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: With parent pointers, walk from p up to the root and store every node (including p). Then walk up from q; the first node already in the set is the LCA. Simple, but uses O(h) extra space.

approaches.nameZh: 双指针（转化为链表相交）
approaches.ideaZh: 沿 parent 指针往上看，p 和 q 各自到根的路径就是两条在 LCA 处汇合的链表。于是套用「相交链表」的技巧：a 从 p 出发、b 从 q 出发，各自走到根之后跳到对方的起点继续走。两者走过的总步数相同，会恰好在 LCA 处相遇。只用常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Following parent pointers, the paths from p and from q to the root are two linked lists that merge at the LCA. Apply the intersection trick: a starts at p, b at q, and each jumps to the other's start after passing the root. Both cover the same total distance and meet exactly at the LCA, using O(1) space.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举分界线（前缀 b + 后缀 a）
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate the split point (b's before + a's after)
approaches.ideaZh: 平衡串一定形如「若干 a 后接若干 b」，所以可以枚举分界线：分界线左边的 b 和右边的 a 都要删掉。先统计全部 a 的数量作为「分界线在最左」的代价，然后从左到右移动分界线：遇到 a 就让右侧 a 减一，遇到 b 就让左侧 b 加一。每个位置的代价是两者之和，取最小值即可。一次遍历完成。
approaches.ideaEn: A balanced string is some a's followed by some b's, so enumerate the boundary: delete every b left of it and every a right of it. Start with the boundary at the far left (cost = number of a's), then sweep right: an a reduces the right-side a count, a b increases the left-side b count. The answer is the minimum sum seen.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dels 为让当前前缀平衡的最少删除数，bs 为前缀中 b 的个数。读到 b 时，把它接在平衡前缀后面永远合法，dels 不变，只把 bs 加一。读到 a 时有两种选择：删掉这个 a（dels + 1），或者保留它，那么前面所有 b 都得删（bs）。取两者较小值即为新的 dels，最终 dels 就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dels be the minimum deletions that balance the current prefix and bs the number of b's in it. Appending a b to a balanced prefix keeps it balanced, so only bs increases. For an a, either delete it (dels + 1) or keep it and delete every earlier b (bs); take the smaller. The final dels is the answer.

approaches.nameZh: 比较字符集合与频次多重集
approaches.nameEn: Compare the character sets and the frequency multisets
approaches.ideaZh: 操作 1 可以任意交换位置，所以顺序无关，只看每个字符出现几次。操作 2 能把两个已存在字符的频次互换，但不会凭空造出新字符，也不会改变「频次组成的多重集」。因此两个串接近，当且仅当：出现过的字符集合相同，且把各字符频次排序后完全一致。这两个条件也是充分的：频次多重集相同，就能通过若干次互换把频次分配对齐。其中 Σ = 26 为字母表大小。
approaches.ideaEn: Operation 1 makes order irrelevant; only per-character counts matter. Operation 2 swaps the counts of two existing characters but never creates a new character or changes the multiset of counts. So the strings are close iff they use the same set of characters and their sorted count lists are equal; both conditions together are also sufficient, since swaps can realign any matching multiset. Here Σ = 26 is the alphabet size.

approaches.nameZh: 逆向思考 + 滑动窗口
approaches.ideaZh: 从两端删数，剩下的一定是一段连续子数组，且它的和等于 sum(nums) - x。要删得最少，就是让剩下的子数组最长，问题变成「和恰为 target 的最长子数组」。元素都是正数，窗口和随右端点增加、随左端点右移减少，可以用滑动窗口：右端点扩张，和超过 target 就收缩左端点，等于 target 时更新最长长度。target < 0 时无解；找不到窗口也返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Removing from both ends leaves a contiguous subarray whose sum is sum(nums) - x. Fewest removals means the longest such subarray, so find the longest window with sum exactly target. All values are positive, so a sliding window works: extend right, shrink left while the sum exceeds target, record the length on equality. If target < 0 or no window matches, return -1.

approaches.nameZh: 模拟长除法 + 记录余数位置
approaches.ideaZh: 先处理符号和整数部分，再对余数做竖式除法：每次余数乘 10，商的一位写进小数部分，新余数继续下一轮。小数是否循环完全由余数决定：一旦某个余数第二次出现，从它第一次出现的位置开始的数字就会无限重复。所以用哈希表记录「余数 → 它对应的小数位下标」，遇到重复余数就在那个下标处插入左括号，末尾补右括号。余数变成 0 则是有限小数。注意先取绝对值并使用 64 位整数，避免 -2^31 取反溢出。复杂度里的 d 为分母的绝对值：余数最多 d 种，所以最多 d 位以内就会除尽或出现循环。
approaches.ideaEn: Handle the sign and integer part, then do long division on the remainder: multiply by 10, emit one digit, keep the new remainder. The decimal repeats exactly when a remainder reappears, and the repeating block starts where that remainder first appeared. Map each remainder to the index of the digit it produced; on a repeat, insert "(" at that index and close with ")". A zero remainder means the decimal terminates. Use 64-bit absolute values so -2^31 does not overflow. In the bounds, d is the absolute value of the denominator: there are at most d distinct remainders, so the digits terminate or repeat within d steps.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组已升序，左指针指向最小值，右指针指向最大值。两数之和偏小时，左指针对应的数和任何剩余的数配对都不够大，可以排除，左指针右移；偏大时同理右指针左移。每一步都安全地排除一个元素，题目保证有唯一解，所以一定会在某一步恰好相等。返回时下标按题意从 1 开始。
approaches.ideaEn: The array is sorted, so start with the smallest on the left and the largest on the right. If the sum is too small, the left value is too small to pair with anything left, so drop it; if too large, drop the right value. Each step safely discards one element, and a unique answer is guaranteed. Return 1-based indices.

approaches.ideaZh: 删得最少等价于留下最长的山形子序列。inc[i] 表示以 i 结尾的最长严格递增子序列长度，dec[i] 表示从 i 开始的最长严格递减子序列长度，分别从左、从右做一次经典 LIS DP。以 i 为山顶的山形长度是 inc[i] + dec[i] - 1，但要求两侧都至少有一个元素，即 inc[i] ≥ 2 且 dec[i] ≥ 2。答案是 n 减去满足条件的最大山形长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Fewest removals means keeping the longest mountain subsequence. inc[i] is the longest strictly increasing subsequence ending at i and dec[i] the longest strictly decreasing one starting at i, each from a classic LIS DP. A peak at i gives inc[i] + dec[i] - 1, valid only if inc[i] >= 2 and dec[i] >= 2. Answer = n minus the best valid length.

approaches.nameEn: LIS via greedy tails + binary search
approaches.ideaZh: 状态和上一种方法相同，只是把 LIS 的求法换成「最小结尾」数组 tails：tails[k] 是长度为 k+1 的递增子序列的最小结尾。处理 nums[i] 时，用 lower_bound 找到第一个 ≥ nums[i] 的位置 k，则以 i 结尾的严格递增子序列最长为 k + 1，再用 nums[i] 覆盖 tails[k]。用 lower_bound（而不是 upper_bound）保证了「严格」递增。从右往左再做一遍得到 dec，最后的组合方式不变。
approaches.ideaEn: Same states, but compute LIS with a tails array where tails[k] is the smallest ending value of an increasing subsequence of length k+1. For nums[i], lower_bound gives the first position k with tails[k] >= nums[i]; the longest strictly increasing run ending at i is k + 1, then set tails[k] = nums[i]. lower_bound (not upper_bound) enforces strictness. Repeat from the right for dec and combine as before.

approaches.ideaZh: 排序后左右指针分别指向最小和最大的数。和等于 k 就配成一对，两个指针同时向内移动；和偏小说明左边的数找不到搭档，左指针右移；偏大则右指针左移。每个数最多被用一次，贪心配对不会让结果变差：和为 k 的配对在排序后总是由一小一大组成。
approaches.ideaEn: After sorting, point to the smallest and largest values. If they sum to k, pair them and move both inward; if the sum is too small, the left value has no partner, so advance it; if too large, retreat the right. Each value is used at most once, and greedy pairing is safe because every k-sum pair is one small plus one large value.

approaches.ideaZh: 用哈希表记录「还没配上对的数」各有几个。遍历到 v 时，如果表里还有 k - v，就和它配成一对，计数减一、答案加一；否则把 v 自己放进表里等待后面的搭档。每个数只在表里出现一次或被消耗一次，所以配对数就是最大值。不需要排序，线性时间。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a map of unmatched values and their counts. For each v, if k - v is waiting, consume one and count a pair; otherwise store v for a future partner. Every value is either stored or consumed once, so the count is maximal, in linear time without sorting.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：统计每个数出现的次数，次数超过 n/2 的那个就是多数元素。只需一次遍历，但要额外 O(n) 空间存计数，是下一种方法要优化的地方。
approaches.ideaEn: Count occurrences of every value and return the one appearing more than n/2 times. One pass, but O(n) extra space for the counts, which the next method removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 把不同的两个数「互相抵消」，多数元素的个数超过其余所有数的总和，抵消到最后剩下的一定是它。维护一个候选值和票数：票数为 0 时把当前数设为候选；与候选相同票数加一，不同则减一。题目保证多数元素存在，所以遍历结束时的候选就是答案，无需二次验证。只用两个变量。
approaches.ideaEn: Cancel pairs of different values; the majority outnumbers everything else combined, so it is what survives. Keep a candidate and a vote count: when the count is 0 adopt the current value, add one for a match, subtract one otherwise. The majority is guaranteed to exist, so the final candidate is the answer, using two variables.

approaches.ideaZh: dp[i] 表示跳到下标 i 时能得到的最大得分，dp[i] = nums[i] + max(dp[i-k..i-1])。直接枚举前 k 个位置是 O(nk)，会超时；关键是快速求「滑动窗口最大值」。用双端队列保存下标，且对应 dp 值从队头到队尾递减：先弹出已滑出窗口的队头，队头即窗口最大；算出 dp[i] 后，从队尾弹掉所有 dp 不大于它的下标再入队。每个下标进出队列各一次，总体线性，答案是 dp[n-1]。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[i] is the best score on reaching index i: dp[i] = nums[i] + max(dp[i-k..i-1]). Scanning k predecessors is O(nk); the real need is a sliding-window maximum. Keep indices in a deque whose dp values decrease from front to back: drop the front if it left the window, read the max at the front, then pop every back index with dp <= dp[i] before pushing i. Each index enters and leaves once; the answer is dp[n-1].

approaches.ideaZh: 每个数字对应 3 或 4 个字母，结果是各位字母的笛卡尔积。用回溯按位填写：第 i 层依次尝试数字 digits[i] 对应的每个字母，填满长度时把当前路径加入答案，返回时撤销最后一个字母。输入为空串时应返回空列表，需要单独处理。答案共有至多 4^n 个，每个长度为 n。空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Each digit maps to 3 or 4 letters, so the answer is a Cartesian product. Backtrack position by position: at depth i try every letter of digits[i], record the path when it is full, and undo the last letter on return. An empty input must return an empty list. There are at most 4^n strings of length n. Space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 末尾的每个 0 来自一对 2 × 5，而 n! 中因子 2 远多于因子 5，所以只需数因子 5 的个数。1..n 中 5 的倍数各贡献一个 5，25 的倍数再多贡献一个，125 的倍数再多一个，以此类推。因此答案是 n/5 + n/25 + n/125 + ...，实现时反复把 n 除以 5 并累加商即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Each trailing zero needs a factor pair 2 x 5, and n! has far more 2s than 5s, so count the 5s. Multiples of 5 contribute one, multiples of 25 one more, multiples of 125 another, and so on. The answer is n/5 + n/25 + n/125 + ..., computed by repeatedly dividing n by 5 and summing the quotients.

approaches.nameEn: Flatten the in-order traversal up front
approaches.ideaZh: BST 的中序遍历就是升序序列，所以构造时直接把整棵树中序遍历存进数组，再用一个下标指向下一个要返回的元素。next 返回当前下标的值并后移，hasNext 判断下标是否越界。构造时的中序遍历耗时 O(n)，之后两个操作都是 O(1)，但需要 O(n) 空间保存全部节点值，不满足进阶要求的 O(h)。
approaches.ideaEn: An in-order traversal of a BST is sorted, so the constructor stores it in an array and keeps an index to the next value. next returns and advances the index; hasNext checks bounds. Building the array takes O(n) once; after that both operations are O(1), but storing every value costs O(n) space instead of O(h).

approaches.nameZh: 受控栈：按需模拟中序遍历
approaches.ideaZh: 把迭代版中序遍历「暂停」在两次 next 之间：栈里始终保存从当前位置往上、还没访问的左链节点。构造时把根的整条左链压栈，栈顶就是最小值。next 弹出栈顶作为答案，再把它右子树的整条左链压栈，这样新的栈顶就是下一个更大的值；hasNext 只需判断栈是否为空。每个节点只进出栈一次，所以 next 是均摊 O(1)（hasNext 始终 O(1)），栈的深度不超过树高 h。
approaches.ideaEn: Pause an iterative in-order traversal between calls: the stack holds the unvisited left-chain nodes above the current position. The constructor pushes the root’s whole left chain, so the top is the minimum. next pops the top, then pushes the left chain of its right child, making the new top the next larger value; hasNext checks emptiness. Each node is pushed and popped once, so next is amortized O(1) (hasNext is always O(1)) with O(h) space.

approaches.nameZh: 从终点倒推的 DP（滚动数组）
approaches.nameEn: Backward DP from the princess (rolling row)
approaches.ideaZh: 正着推不行：到达某格时既要记录当前血量又要记录途中的最低血量，两个指标无法同时取最优。倒过来定义 need[i][j]：从 (i, j) 出发（进入该格之前）至少要有多少血才能活着走到终点。从右边或下边中选需求更小的一格，扣掉本格的变化：need = max(1, min(右, 下) - dungeon[i][j])，与 1 取最大是因为任何时刻血量都必须至少为 1。从右下角往左上角填表，用一维数组滚动即可，答案是 need[0][0]。
approaches.ideaEn: A forward DP fails because it must track both current health and the lowest point so far, which cannot be optimized together. Instead let need[i][j] be the minimum health required on entering (i, j) to survive to the end. Take the cheaper of right and down and account for this cell: need = max(1, min(right, down) - dungeon[i][j]); the max with 1 keeps health positive at all times. Fill from the bottom-right with one rolling row; the answer is need[0][0].

approaches.ideaZh: 只要两端字符相同就可以删，并且把同一个字符的前缀和后缀删得越长越好：多删不会让后面的选择变差。左右指针各指向一端，当 l < r 且两端字符相同（记为 c）时，左指针跳过所有连续的 c，右指针也跳过所有连续的 c。两个循环都带 l ≤ r 的条件，避免像 "aaa" 这样全被删掉时指针越界。结束时剩余长度为 r - l + 1（可能为 0）。
approaches.ideaEn: Whenever both ends match we may delete, and deleting the longest run of that character on each side never hurts later choices. With pointers at both ends, while l < r and s[l] == s[r] == c, skip every c from the left and every c from the right. Both skips check l <= r so a string like "aaa" can vanish without overrunning. The remaining length is r - l + 1, possibly 0.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案（最大袋子球数）
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the maximum bag size
approaches.ideaZh: 直接决定怎么拆很难，但反过来问「要让每袋都不超过 p，最少要拆几次」就很简单：一袋 x 个球需要拆 ceil(x/p) - 1 = (x-1)//p 次。所需次数随 p 增大而单调不增，所以在 [1, max(nums)] 上二分，找最小的 p 使总次数 ≤ maxOperations。注意累加的次数可能很大，C++ 中要用 64 位整数。复杂度里的 M 为 nums 中的最大值。
approaches.ideaEn: Choosing splits directly is hard, but "how many splits make every bag <= p" is easy: a bag of x needs ceil(x/p) - 1 = (x-1)//p splits. That total never increases as p grows, so binary search p over [1, max(nums)] for the smallest value whose total is <= maxOperations. The total can be large, so use 64-bit sums in C++. In the time bound, M is the largest value in nums.

approaches.ideaZh: 长度不超过 100，可以枚举所有子串。固定起点 i，向右扩展终点 j，用两个 26 位掩码分别记录出现过的小写字母和大写字母；两个掩码相等就说明每个字母大小写都齐全，子串是美好的。只在长度严格更长时更新答案，起点从左往右枚举，保证并列最长时返回最早出现的那个。空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: With length <= 100 we can try every substring. Fix a start i and extend the end j, keeping a 26-bit mask of seen lowercase letters and one of uppercase letters; the substring is nice when the masks are equal. Update only on a strictly longer length; scanning starts left to right keeps the earliest among ties. Space excludes the output.

approaches.nameEn: Divide and conquer on a "bad" character
approaches.ideaZh: 如果某个字符的另一种大小写在整个串里都没有出现，那么任何包含它的子串都不可能美好，它就是一个分隔点。找到这样一个坏字符，按它把串切成若干段，对每段递归求答案，取最长的（并列时取靠左的）。如果串里没有坏字符，整个串本身就是美好的，直接返回。每段都不再包含被切掉的字符，字符种类严格减少，所以递归深度不超过 52 层。其中 Σ = 52，即大小写字母的总数。
approaches.ideaEn: If a character's other case never appears in the string, no nice substring can contain it, so it acts as a separator. Split on such a bad character, solve each piece recursively, and keep the longest (leftmost on ties). A string with no bad character is nice as a whole. Each piece loses the split character, so recursion depth is at most 52. Here Σ = 52, the count of upper- and lowercase letters.

approaches.ideaZh: 决定两个数谁在前，只需要看它们拼起来哪种更大：若 a+b 拼出的串大于 b+a，a 就应该排在 b 前面。这个关系是可传递的，所以可以直接拿它当排序比较器。把所有数转成字符串，按这个规则排好再拼接即可。唯一的特殊情况是全为 0：排完后首位是 "0" 说明整串都是 0，直接返回 "0"。其中 L 为数字的最大位数。
approaches.ideaEn: For two numbers a and b, a belongs in front exactly when the string a+b beats b+a. This relation is transitive, so it works as a sort comparator. Convert to strings, sort with it, and join. If the first string is "0", every number is zero, so return "0". Here L is the maximum number of digits.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 双重循环 + 双指针
approaches.nameEn: Sort, two loops, then two pointers
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，外面两层循环固定前两个数 nums[i] 和 nums[j]，剩下的问题就是在 j 之后的区间里找两数之和，用左右双指针收缩即可。去重靠排序后的相邻比较：同一层循环里遇到和上一个相同的值直接跳过，双指针找到一组答案后也把左指针移过所有重复值。四个数相加可能超过 32 位整数范围，C++ 里要用 long long 求和。O(log n) 空间来自排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort, fix the first two numbers with two nested loops, and solve the remaining two-sum on the suffix with converging pointers. Skip equal neighbours at each loop level and move the left pointer past duplicates after a hit, so every quadruple is emitted once. Sum in 64-bit in C++ to avoid overflow. The O(log n) space is used by sorting.

approaches.nameZh: 二分峰值 + 等差求和
approaches.nameEn: Binary search the peak with arithmetic sums
approaches.ideaZh: 想让 index 处的值 v 尽量大，其余位置就应该尽量小：从 v 开始向两侧每步减 1，减到 1 之后保持为 1，这样的数组总和最小。这个最小总和随 v 单调递增，所以可以二分最大的可行 v。某一侧有 L 个位置时，如果 L ≤ v-1，这一侧是从 v-1 递减的等差数列，和为 (2v-1-L)·L/2；否则先是 v-1 到 1 的等差数列，剩下的位置都填 1。总和不超过 maxSum 就说明 v 可行。
approaches.ideaEn: To make the value v at index as large as possible, every other cell should be as small as allowed: step down by 1 on each side and stay at 1 once reached. That minimal total grows with v, so binary search the largest v whose minimal total fits in maxSum. Each side is an arithmetic series, plus a run of 1s when the side is longer than v-1.

approaches.ideaZh: 条件 nums[i] + rev(nums[j]) == nums[j] + rev(nums[i]) 移项后变成 nums[i] - rev(nums[i]) == nums[j] - rev(nums[j])。于是每个数只和自己有关，算出 key = x - rev(x) 后，问题就变成统计 key 相同的下标对。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个 key 已出现的次数，当前元素能和之前所有同 key 的元素配对。最后对 1e9+7 取模。其中 U 为最大值，反转一个数需要 O(log U)。
approaches.ideaEn: Moving terms around turns the condition into nums[i] - rev(nums[i]) == nums[j] - rev(nums[j]), so each number maps to its own key x - rev(x). Count pairs with equal keys in one pass: each element pairs with every earlier element sharing its key, which a hash map tracks. Take the result modulo 1e9+7. Here U is the largest value; reversing a number takes O(log U).

approaches.nameZh: 按到达时间排序 + 最小堆模拟
approaches.nameEn: Simulate with arrival order and a min-heap
approaches.ideaZh: 把任务按入队时间排序，用一个指针表示“下一个还没到达的任务”。维护当前时间 t：每轮先把所有入队时间 ≤ t 的任务按 (处理时长, 下标) 放进最小堆，再弹出堆顶执行，t 加上它的处理时长。如果堆空了而 CPU 闲着，就把 t 直接跳到下一个任务的入队时间。堆的排序键正好对应题目的选择规则：先短任务，时长相同选下标小的。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort tasks by enqueue time and keep a pointer to the next one that has not arrived. At current time t, push every arrived task into a min-heap keyed by (processing time, index), pop the top, and advance t by its duration. If the heap is empty, jump t forward to the next arrival. The heap key encodes the tie-breaking rule directly.

approaches.ideaZh: 操作只能加 1，所以最终的众数一定是某个原数组里的值，而且把比它小、和它最接近的那些数抬上来最省。排序后，以 nums[r] 为目标的最佳选择是一段以 r 结尾的连续区间 [l, r]，把整段抬到 nums[r] 的代价是 nums[r]·(r-l+1) - 区间和。r 右移时代价只会变大，超过 k 就右移 l，因此是标准的双指针窗口。窗口长度的最大值就是答案。O(log n) 空间来自排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Only increments are allowed, so the target value is some nums[r], and the cheapest elements to raise are the ones just below it. After sorting, the best group for target nums[r] is a contiguous window [l, r], with cost nums[r] * len - windowSum. Grow r, shrink l while the cost exceeds k, and track the largest window. The O(log n) space is used by sorting.

approaches.ideaZh: 把区间按左端点排序，把查询按值从小到大处理（记住原下标）。处理查询 q 时，先把所有左端点 ≤ q 的区间以 (长度, 右端点) 放进最小堆；再从堆顶弹掉右端点 < q 的区间。因为查询是递增的，被弹掉的区间对后面的查询也不可能再有用，所以可以放心延迟删除。此时堆顶就是包含 q 的最短区间，堆为空则答案为 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort intervals by left end and answer queries in increasing order, remembering original positions. For query q, push every interval with left <= q as (size, right) into a min-heap, then pop tops whose right < q. Since queries only increase, a popped interval can never help later, so lazy deletion is safe. The heap top is then the answer, or -1 if empty.
approaches.time: O(n log n + q log q)

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举每个长度为 10 的子串，放进一个“见过”的集合；如果放之前它已经在集合里，就把它加入答案集合。答案用集合保存，保证同一个序列只输出一次。每次切片和哈希都要处理 10 个字符，常数不大，写法最直接。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk over every length-10 window, keeping a set of windows already seen. A window that is already in the set goes into a result set, which keeps each sequence from being reported twice. Each step hashes 10 characters, which is cheap.

approaches.ideaZh: DNA 只有四种字符，每个字符用 2 位二进制就能表示，长度 10 的子串正好是一个 20 位整数。窗口右移一位时，把整数左移 2 位、或上新字符的编码，再用掩码只保留低 20 位，就能 O(1) 得到新窗口的编码。用哈希表记录每个编码出现的次数，恰好第二次出现时把对应子串加入答案。这样哈希的是整数而不是字符串，省去了每步复制 10 个字符。
approaches.ideaEn: With four letters, each character fits in 2 bits and a length-10 window fits in a 20-bit integer. Sliding by one is a shift by 2, an OR with the new code, and a mask to keep 20 bits, all O(1). Count codes in a hash map and emit the substring the moment a code is seen for the second time.

approaches.nameZh: 二分速度 + 整数判定
approaches.nameEn: Binary search speed with an integer check
approaches.ideaZh: 速度越快总用时越少，所以“能否准时到达”对速度是单调的，可以二分最小可行速度，范围是 [1, 1e7]。给定速度 v，前 n-1 趟车都要等到整点才能换乘，用时是 ceil(d/v)；最后一趟不用等，用时 d/v。为了避开浮点误差，把 hour 乘 100 取整（题目保证最多两位小数），然后用整数比较 (整点小时数·v + 最后一段距离)·100 ≤ H·v。如果 hour ≤ n-1，前 n-1 趟至少各要 1 小时，最后一趟又必须花正的时间，直接返回 -1。其中 C = 1e7 为速度的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Total travel time decreases as speed grows, so binary search the smallest feasible speed in [1, 1e7]. At speed v, each of the first n-1 rides takes ceil(d/v) hours because you wait for the next whole hour, and the last ride takes d/v. Scale hour by 100 (it has at most two decimals) and compare (wholeHours * v + lastDist) * 100 <= H * v with integers to avoid float error. If hour <= n-1 it is impossible, so return -1. Here C = 1e7 is the upper bound on the speed.

approaches.nameZh: 按交易次数分层的状态 DP
approaches.nameEn: State DP layered by transaction count
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个 j = 1..k 维护两个量：buy[j] 表示已经开始第 j 笔交易、手里持有股票时的最大收益，sell[j] 表示已经完成 j 笔交易、手里空仓时的最大收益。看到价格 p 时，buy[j] 可以由“完成 j-1 笔后今天买入”转移来，即 sell[j-1] - p；sell[j] 可以由“持有第 j 笔今天卖出”转移来，即 buy[j] + p。每天按 j 从小到大更新即可，同一天买了又卖收益为 0，不会造成错误。最终答案是 sell[k]。
approaches.ideaEn: For each j in 1..k keep buy[j], the best profit while holding the j-th position, and sell[j], the best profit after closing j trades. At price p, buy[j] can come from sell[j-1] - p and sell[j] from buy[j] + p. Updating in place within a day is safe because buying and selling on the same day nets zero. The answer is sell[k].

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + 子序列检查
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on k with a subsequence check
approaches.ideaZh: 删得越多，p 越难保持为子序列：如果删前 k 个后 p 仍是子序列，删更少也一定是，所以可行性对 k 单调，可以二分最大的 k。为了让每次检查都是 O(n)，预先记录每个位置在 removable 中的序号 when[i]（不会被删就记为无穷大），检查 k 时跳过 when[i] < k 的字符即可。检查本身就是双指针判断子序列：扫一遍 s，能匹配 p 的当前字符就前进。其中 m 为 removable 的长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Removing more characters can only break the subsequence, so feasibility is monotone in k and we binary search the largest valid k. Precompute when[i], the position of index i in removable (infinity if never removed); a check for k skips characters with when[i] < k. The check itself is a two-pointer subsequence scan. Here m = len(removable).

approaches.nameEn: Two passes: measure the length first
approaches.ideaZh: 倒数第 n 个就是正数第 L-n+1 个，其中 L 是链表长度。第一遍数出 L，第二遍从哑结点出发走 L-n 步，停在待删结点的前驱上，把它的 next 跳过一个即可。哑结点让“删除头结点”不需要特判。
approaches.ideaEn: The n-th node from the end is node L-n+1 from the front. Count L in one pass, then walk L-n steps from a dummy node to reach the predecessor and unlink its successor. The dummy node makes deleting the head a normal case.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: Optional[ListNode], n: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        length, node = 0, head
        while node:
            length, node = length + 1, node.next
        dummy = prev = ListNode(0, head)
        for _ in range(length - n):
            prev = prev.next
        prev.next = prev.next.next
        return dummy.next

approaches.nameEn: One pass with a gap of n
approaches.ideaZh: 让快指针先从哑结点出发走 n 步，此后快慢指针一起前进，两者始终相隔 n 个结点。当快指针到达最后一个结点时，慢指针恰好停在倒数第 n 个结点的前一个位置。这样只扫一遍链表就能完成删除，同样借助哑结点处理删除头结点的情况。
approaches.ideaEn: Advance a fast pointer n steps from a dummy node, then move fast and slow together so they stay n apart. When fast reaches the last node, slow sits just before the node to delete. One pass, and the dummy node again covers removing the head.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: Optional[ListNode], n: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        fast = slow = dummy
        for _ in range(n):
            fast = fast.next
        while fast.next:
            fast, slow = fast.next, slow.next
        slow.next = slow.next.next
        return dummy.next

approaches.nameEn: Move bits one at a time
approaches.ideaZh: 循环 32 次，每次取出 n 的最低位，把结果左移一位后放进最低位，再把 n 右移一位。这样 n 的第 i 位最终会落在结果的第 31-i 位。C++ 里先转成无符号数再做移位，避免有符号右移带来的问题。
approaches.ideaEn: Loop 32 times: take the lowest bit of n, shift the result left and append that bit, then shift n right. Bit i of n ends up at bit 31-i of the result. In C++, work on an unsigned copy so shifts are well defined.

approaches.ideaZh: 翻转 32 位可以分层完成：先交换高低 16 位，再在每个 16 位块内交换相邻的 8 位，接着是 4 位、2 位、1 位。每一层用一个掩码同时挑出所有块的左半和右半，一次移位就能交换全部块。五步之后每一位都到了镜像位置，适合需要反复调用的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: Reverse in layers: swap the two 16-bit halves, then adjacent bytes inside each half, then nibbles, bit pairs and single bits. Each layer uses a mask to pick all left halves and all right halves at once, so a single shift swaps every block. Five constant-time steps finish the job.

approaches.ideaZh: 依次看 n 的每一位：最低位是 1 就计数，然后把 n 右移一位，直到 n 变成 0。循环次数等于最高位 1 的位置，最多 32 次。
approaches.ideaEn: Inspect the lowest bit, count it if set, and shift n right until it becomes zero. The loop runs once per bit up to the highest set bit, at most 32 times.

approaches.nameEn: Clear the lowest set bit with n & (n-1)
approaches.ideaZh: n-1 会把 n 最低位的那个 1 变成 0，并把它右边的 0 全变成 1，所以 n & (n-1) 恰好把最低位的 1 清掉。反复执行直到 n 为 0，执行的次数就是 1 的个数。循环次数只和 1 的个数有关，而不是和位数有关。
approaches.ideaEn: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit to 0 and the zeros below it to 1, so n & (n-1) clears exactly that bit. Repeat until n is zero; the number of iterations is the answer, and it depends only on how many bits are set.

approaches.ideaZh: 子序列里第偶数个位置（从 0 开始）的元素是加，奇数个位置是减，所以只需要知道“已经选了偶数个还是奇数个”。设 even 为已选偶数个元素时的最大交替和（空序列为 0），odd 为已选奇数个时的最大交替和。处理 x 时，选它放到奇数位会从 even 加上 x 得到新的 odd，放到偶数位会从 odd 减去 x 得到新的 even，两个状态要同时更新。最后答案是 odd，因为以减号结尾不会比去掉最后那个数更好。
approaches.ideaEn: Whether the next pick is added or subtracted depends only on how many elements are already chosen. Keep even (best sum with an even count, empty = 0) and odd (best sum with an odd count). For each x, odd can become even + x and even can become odd - x; update both at once. The answer is odd, since ending on a subtraction is never better.

approaches.ideaZh: 交替和 a0 - a1 + a2 - a3 + a4 可以重写成 a0 + (a2 - a1) + (a4 - a3)，相当于先拿下第一个数，之后每一对都是“低点减、高点加”，和股票多次买卖是同一个结构。因此最优解等于 nums[0] 加上所有相邻上升差 max(0, nums[i] - nums[i-1]) 的总和。这个视角把 DP 化简成一行累加。
approaches.ideaEn: Rewrite a0 - a1 + a2 - a3 + a4 as a0 + (a2 - a1) + (a4 - a3): take the first value, then each pair buys low and sells high, just like unlimited stock trading. So the optimum is nums[0] plus every positive adjacent difference.

approaches.ideaZh: 长度为 3 的回文形如 c?c，两端字符相同，中间任意。对每个字母 c，取它第一次和最后一次出现的位置 l、r，这样能让中间的选择范围最大。区间 (l, r) 内出现过多少种不同字符，就能组成多少个以 c 为两端的不同回文。对 26 个字母分别统计后求和即可。
approaches.ideaEn: A length-3 palindrome is c?c. For each letter c, use its first and last positions l and r, which give the widest middle range. The number of distinct characters strictly between them is the number of distinct palindromes with c on the ends. Sum over all 26 letters.

approaches.ideaZh: 把边列表建成邻接表，从 source 出发做 BFS，用访问标记避免重复入队。只要某一刻取出的结点是 destination 就返回 true；队列耗尽仍未到达则返回 false。每个点和每条边最多处理常数次。
approaches.ideaEn: Build an adjacency list and run BFS from source, marking visited nodes so each is enqueued once. Return true as soon as destination is dequeued, false if the queue empties first. Every node and edge is touched a constant number of times.

approaches.ideaZh: 只关心两点是否连通，而不关心具体路径，这正是并查集擅长的。遍历每条边，把两个端点所在的集合合并；最后比较 source 和 destination 的根是否相同。查找时做路径压缩，摊还下每次操作几乎是常数，而且不需要建邻接表。
approaches.ideaEn: We only need connectivity, not a path, which is exactly what union-find answers. Union the endpoints of every edge, then check whether source and destination share a root. With path compression each operation is nearly constant, and no adjacency list is needed.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 f(i) 为只考虑前 i 间房子时能偷到的最大金额。对第 i 间房只有两种选择：不偷，结果是 f(i-1)；偷，那么上一间不能偷，结果是 f(i-2) + nums[i]。转移只依赖前两项，用两个变量滚动保存即可，不需要整张表。
approaches.ideaEn: Let f(i) be the best haul from the first i houses. House i is either skipped, giving f(i-1), or robbed, giving f(i-2) + nums[i] since its neighbour must be skipped. Only the last two values matter, so two variables are enough.

approaches.nameZh: 层序遍历取每层最后一个
approaches.nameEn: Level order, keep the last node of each level
approaches.ideaZh: 从右边看过去，每一层能看到的就是这一层最靠右的结点。按层做 BFS，每一层按从左到右的顺序排好，把这一层最后一个结点的值记入答案，再用这一层所有结点的孩子组成下一层。空树直接返回空列表。空间里的 w 为树的最大层宽。
approaches.ideaEn: From the right side you see the rightmost node of each level. Do a level-by-level BFS with children in left-to-right order, record the last node of each level, and build the next level from the current one's children. Here w is the maximum width of a level.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def rightSideView(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res, level = [], [root] if root else []
        while level:
            res.append(level[-1].val)
            level = [child for node in level for child in (node.left, node.right) if child]
        return res

approaches.nameEn: DFS visiting the right child first
approaches.ideaZh: 做前序 DFS，但先走右子树再走左子树，同时记录当前深度。这样每一层第一个被访问到的结点一定是最右边的那个。只要当前深度等于答案的长度，说明这一层还没记录过，就把当前结点放进答案。其中 h 为树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Run a preorder DFS that visits the right child before the left, tracking depth. The first node reached at each depth is then the rightmost one, so append a node whenever its depth equals the current answer length. Here h is the height of the tree.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def rightSideView(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res = []

        def dfs(node, depth):
            if not node:
                return
            if depth == len(res):
                res.append(node.val)
            dfs(node.right, depth + 1)
            dfs(node.left, depth + 1)

        dfs(root, 0)
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 链表是逆序存的，表头就是个位，正好可以像竖式加法一样从低位往高位算。同时遍历两个链表，把当前两位和进位相加，取个位作为新结点，十位作为下一轮的进位。某个链表先走完就当它是 0；两个都走完但还有进位时，要再补一个结点。用哑结点做尾插可以省去对头结点的特判。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出链表。
approaches.ideaEn: The lists store digits least-significant first, so add them like column addition. Walk both lists together, add the two digits and the carry, append the ones digit and carry the tens. A finished list counts as 0, and a leftover carry adds one final node. A dummy head keeps appends uniform. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output list.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: Optional[ListNode], l2: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        carry = 0
        while l1 or l2 or carry:
            if l1:
                carry += l1.val
                l1 = l1.next
            if l2:
                carry += l2.val
                l2 = l2.next
            tail.next = ListNode(carry % 10)
            tail = tail.next
            carry //= 10
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 括号的配对是“后开先合”的，天然适合用栈。遇到左括号就压栈；遇到右括号时，栈必须非空，并且栈顶恰好是与它对应的左括号，否则立即判为无效，匹配上就弹出。扫描结束后栈为空才说明所有左括号都被关闭了。
approaches.ideaEn: Brackets close in last-opened-first-closed order, which is a stack. Push opening brackets; on a closing bracket the stack must be non-empty with the matching opener on top, otherwise the string is invalid. At the end the stack must be empty.

approaches.ideaZh: 逐格扫描网格，每遇到一个还没访问过的 "1"，就说明发现了一座新岛屿，计数加一。随后从这个格子出发做 DFS，把与它四连通的所有 "1" 都改成 "0"，这样同一座岛不会被重复计数。这里用显式栈代替递归，避免大网格时递归过深；如果不允许修改输入，可以另开一个 visited 数组。最坏情况下显式栈会存下 O(mn) 个格子。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan the grid; each unvisited "1" starts a new island, so increment the count. Then flood-fill from it, turning every 4-connected "1" into "0" so the island is never counted again. An explicit stack avoids deep recursion on large grids; use a separate visited array if the input must stay intact. In the worst case the explicit stack holds O(mn) cells.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为车开到地点 i 时能赚到的最多钱。到达 i 时要么这一段没有载客，dp[i] = dp[i-1]；要么刚刚放下一位在 i 下车的乘客，他从 start 上车，那么收益是 dp[start] + (i - start + tip)。预先把每条订单挂在它的终点上，从 1 到 n 依次计算，每条订单只被看一次。答案是 dp[n]，注意可能超过 32 位整数。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the best earnings on reaching point i. Either no passenger was dropped at i, so dp[i] = dp[i-1], or a ride (start, i, tip) just ended, giving dp[start] + i - start + tip. Bucket rides by end point and fill dp from 1 to n, touching each ride once. The answer dp[n] may exceed 32 bits.

approaches.ideaZh: 区间 [left, right] 内只要某一位在某个数上是 0，按位与的结果这一位就是 0。left 和 right 的二进制从高位起有一段公共前缀；在第一个不同的位上，区间里必然跨过一次进位，此后所有低位都会在某个数里出现 0。所以答案就是公共前缀后面补 0。实现上反复执行 right &= right - 1 去掉 right 的最低位 1，直到 right ≤ left，剩下的就是这个前缀。
approaches.ideaEn: A bit survives the AND only if every number in the range has it. Below the highest bit where left and right differ, the range crosses a carry, so every lower bit is 0 somewhere. The answer is their common prefix followed by zeros. Clearing right's lowest set bit with right &= right - 1 until right <= left leaves exactly that prefix.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口：少数派不超过 k
approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with at most k minority answers
approaches.ideaZh: 一段区间能被改成全相同，当且仅当其中 T 和 F 较少的那一种不超过 k 个，把少的那种全改掉即可。于是用双指针维护窗口内 T、F 的个数：右端扩张时加入新字符，一旦 min(T 数, F 数) > k 就收缩左端。窗口满足条件时它的长度就是一个候选答案，取最大值。每个字符最多进出窗口一次。
approaches.ideaEn: A window can be made uniform exactly when the rarer of T and F appears at most k times, since we flip all of the rarer ones. Grow the right end, and shrink the left while min(countT, countF) > k. Every valid window length is a candidate, and each character enters and leaves once.

approaches.nameZh: 哨兵节点 + 单指针扫描
approaches.ideaZh: 难点在于头节点本身也可能要删，单独处理会让代码分叉。在头节点前面挂一个哨兵节点，这样每个真实节点都有前驱，删除操作统一成"让前驱跳过它"。指针 cur 始终站在待检查节点的前一个位置：下一个节点的值等于 val 就把它摘掉，cur 原地不动，以便继续检查新接上来的节点；否则 cur 前进一步。扫描结束后返回哨兵的 next 即可。
approaches.ideaEn: The head itself may need to go, which normally forces a special case. Putting a sentinel in front of the head gives every real node a predecessor, so every deletion becomes "make the predecessor skip it". Keep cur on the node before the one being inspected: if the next value equals val, unlink it and stay put so the newly attached node is checked too; otherwise advance. Return sentinel.next at the end.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个数单独做试除要 O(n√n)，n 到 5×10^6 时太慢。换个方向：不去判断谁是质数，而是把合数划掉。从 2 开始，遇到一个还没被划掉的数 p，它一定是质数，再把 p 的倍数全部标成合数。p 的倍数里比 p² 小的那些，已经被更小的质因子划过了，所以从 p² 开始划即可，p 也只需枚举到 √n。最后统计没被划掉的数的个数。
approaches.ideaEn: Trial division on every number costs O(n√n), too slow for n up to 5×10^6. Flip the question: instead of testing primes, cross out composites. Walking up from 2, any number still unmarked is prime, and all its multiples are marked composite. Multiples below p² were already crossed out by a smaller factor, so start at p² and stop p at √n. Count what is left unmarked.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和 + 最近蜡烛预处理
approaches.ideaZh: 一个查询 [l, r] 真正有效的范围，是区间内最左边的蜡烛到最右边的蜡烛之间，这段里的盘子都被两端的蜡烛夹住了。所以先预处理两个数组：right[i] 是 i 及其右侧最近的蜡烛位置，left[i] 是 i 及其左侧最近的蜡烛位置；再预处理盘子数量的前缀和。查询时取 a = right[l]、b = left[r]，如果 a < b，答案就是前缀和之差 pre[b] - pre[a]，否则区间内不到两根蜡烛，答案为 0。预处理线性，每次查询 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: For a query [l, r], only the stretch between the leftmost and rightmost candle inside it matters, and every plate there is enclosed. Precompute right[i], the nearest candle at or after i, left[i], the nearest candle at or before i, and a prefix count of plates. For a query take a = right[l] and b = left[r]; if a < b the answer is pre[b] - pre[a], otherwise there are fewer than two candles and the answer is 0. Linear preprocessing, O(1) per query.

approaches.ideaZh: 把问题交给递归：先把 head 之后的部分整体反转，拿到新链表的头 newHead。此时 head.next 指向的节点已经变成反转后那段的尾巴，只要让它的 next 指回 head，再把 head.next 置空，head 就接到了末尾。空链表或只有一个节点时直接返回自身。代码短，但递归深度等于链表长度，栈空间是 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Let recursion reverse everything after head and hand back the new head. The node head.next is now the tail of that reversed part, so point its next back at head and clear head.next, which makes head the new tail. An empty or single-node list is returned as is. Short code, but the recursion goes n levels deep, so it uses O(n) stack.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
import sys

sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)


class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        new_head = self.reverseList(head.next)
        head.next.next = head
        head.next = None
        return new_head

approaches.ideaZh: 从头到尾走一遍，把每个节点的 next 改成指向它的前一个节点。用 prev 记录已经反转好的那段的头，cur 是当前节点。改 cur.next 之前先把原来的下一个节点存进 nxt，否则链就断了。改完后 prev 和 cur 各前进一步；cur 走到空时，prev 就是新的头。只用了常数个指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk the list once and make each node point to its predecessor. prev holds the head of the part already reversed and cur is the node being processed. Save cur.next before overwriting it, or the rest of the list is lost. Then move prev and cur forward; when cur becomes null, prev is the new head. Only a few pointers are used.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        prev, cur = None, head
        while cur:
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = prev
            prev, cur = cur, nxt
        return prev

approaches.ideaZh: 课程和先修关系构成一张有向图，能修完所有课当且仅当图里没有环。对每个节点做 DFS，用三种状态标记：0 表示没访问过，1 表示正在当前递归路径上，2 表示已经确认从它出发不会成环。DFS 过程中如果走到一个状态为 1 的节点，说明沿着路径绕回来了，存在环。一个节点的所有后继都检查完且没发现环，就把它标成 2，以后再遇到直接跳过，所以每条边只看一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Courses and prerequisites form a directed graph, and every course can be finished exactly when that graph has no cycle. Run DFS with three states per node: 0 unvisited, 1 on the current recursion path, 2 known to be cycle-free. Reaching a node in state 1 means the path looped back, so there is a cycle. Once all successors of a node check out, mark it 2 and never explore it again, so each edge is examined once.

approaches.ideaZh: 换一个角度模拟选课：入度为 0 的课程没有未满足的先修，可以直接上。先把所有入度为 0 的课放进队列；每取出一门课，就把它指向的课程入度减一，减到 0 的再入队。如果图中有环，环上的课入度永远减不到 0，不会被取出。所以最后只要比较取出的课程数是否等于 numCourses。这种写法不依赖递归，没有栈深度的顾虑。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulate taking courses: a course with in-degree 0 has no pending prerequisites and can be taken now. Seed a queue with all such courses; each time one is taken, decrement the in-degree of every course it unlocks and enqueue those that reach 0. Courses on a cycle never reach in-degree 0, so they are never taken. The answer is whether the number of courses taken equals numCourses. No recursion, so no stack-depth concerns.

approaches.nameZh: 按值分组的下标表 + 二分
approaches.ideaZh: 直接扫描区间每次要 O(n)，查询多了会超时。预处理时把每个值出现的下标按顺序收集到各自的列表里，因为是从左到右扫描，列表天然有序。查询 (left, right, value) 时只看 value 对应的列表，用一次 lower_bound 找第一个 ≥ left 的位置，一次 upper_bound 找第一个 > right 的位置，两者之差就是区间内的出现次数。值不存在时直接返回 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Scanning the range costs O(n) per query, which is too slow with many queries. During construction, collect the indices of each value into its own list; scanning left to right keeps every list sorted. For query (left, right, value), look only at that value's list: lower_bound finds the first index ≥ left and upper_bound the first index > right, and their difference is the count. A value that never appears gives 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组元素全是正数，所以前缀和严格递增。以 i 为左端点时，我们要找最小的 j 使 pre[j] - pre[i] ≥ target，也就是 pre[j] ≥ pre[i] + target，这在递增数组上可以二分。对每个左端点做一次二分，取 j - i 的最小值；找不到就说明从 i 开始凑不够。这正是题目进阶里要的 O(n log n) 做法，也为下一种方法铺垫：j 随 i 单调右移。
approaches.ideaEn: All elements are positive, so prefix sums are strictly increasing. For a left end i we need the smallest j with pre[j] - pre[i] ≥ target, i.e. pre[j] ≥ pre[i] + target, which is a binary search on a sorted array. Do one search per left end and keep the smallest j - i; no such j means no valid window starts at i. This is the O(n log n) follow-up, and it hints at the next idea: j only moves right as i grows.

approaches.ideaZh: 因为元素都是正数，窗口扩大和只会变大，缩小和只会变小，这让双指针可行。右指针每次把一个新元素加进窗口；只要窗口和已经 ≥ target，就记录当前长度，再把左端点右移、减掉对应元素，尝试找更短的窗口。左右指针都只向右走，各自最多移动 n 次。最后若从未满足条件就返回 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Positive elements mean growing the window only increases the sum and shrinking only decreases it, which makes two pointers work. The right pointer adds one element per step; while the sum is at least target, record the length, then drop the leftmost element and move left forward to look for a shorter window. Both pointers only move right, at most n times each. Return 0 if no window ever qualified.

approaches.ideaZh: 以 i 为中心、半径为 k 的子数组长度固定为 2k + 1，相邻两个中心的窗口只差头尾各一个元素。如果 2k + 1 超过数组长度，所有位置都是 -1。否则先求出第一个窗口 [0, 2k] 的和，之后中心每右移一步，就加上新进来的 nums[i + k]、减去移出去的 nums[i - k - 1]。每个合法中心的平均值是窗口和整除 2k + 1，两端不足 k 个元素的位置保持 -1。注意和最大可到 10^10，C++ 要用 long long。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出数组。
approaches.ideaEn: The window around center i with radius k always has length 2k + 1, and neighbouring centers differ by one element entering and one leaving. If 2k + 1 exceeds the array length, every answer is -1. Otherwise sum the first window [0, 2k], then for each step right add nums[i + k] and subtract nums[i - k - 1]. A valid center gets the window sum divided by 2k + 1 (integer division); positions too close to either end stay -1. The sum can reach about 10^10, so C++ needs long long. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output array.

approaches.ideaZh: 两个链表的头节点里较小的那个，一定是合并结果的头。把它挑出来之后，剩下的问题是"它的后继链表"与"另一个链表"的合并，规模更小、形式相同，正好交给递归。任意一个链表为空时，直接返回另一个。写法很短，但递归深度是两表长度之和，需要 O(n + m) 的栈空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The smaller of the two heads must be the head of the merged list. After picking it, what remains is merging its successor list with the other list, a smaller instance of the same problem, so recurse. If either list is empty, return the other. Very short, but the recursion depth is the combined length, so it uses O(n + m) stack.

approaches.nameZh: 哨兵节点 + 迭代拼接
approaches.ideaZh: 用一个哨兵节点作为结果链表的起点，tail 指向当前结果的末尾。每一步比较两个链表的当前头，把较小的那个接到 tail 后面，并让对应链表前进一步。某个链表先走完时，另一个剩下的部分本身已经有序，整体接上即可。全程只是改指针，不新建节点，额外空间为常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Start the result from a sentinel and keep tail at its end. At each step compare the two current heads, attach the smaller one after tail, and advance that list. When one list runs out, the rest of the other is already sorted, so attach it in one go. Only pointers are rewired and no nodes are created, so extra space is constant.

approaches.ideaZh: 先修关系 [a, b] 是一条从 b 指向 a 的边，一个合法的修课顺序就是这张有向图的拓扑序。统计每门课的入度，把入度为 0 的课放进队列；每次取出一门课追加到答案末尾，并把它解锁的课程入度减一，减到 0 的入队。队列里的课在入队时先修都已满足，所以答案中的顺序天然合法。如果最后答案长度不足 numCourses，说明有课困在环里，返回空数组。
approaches.ideaEn: A prerequisite [a, b] is an edge from b to a, and a valid study order is a topological order of that graph. Count in-degrees and seed a queue with every course of in-degree 0. Pop a course, append it to the answer, and decrement the in-degree of each course it unlocks, enqueuing those that hit 0. Every course enters the queue only after all its prerequisites, so the order is valid by construction. If the answer ends up shorter than numCourses, some courses sit on a cycle and the result is an empty array.

approaches.nameZh: 建有向图 + 从每个起点遍历
approaches.nameEn: Directed graph + traversal from every start
approaches.ideaZh: 炸弹 i 能引爆炸弹 j，当且仅当 j 的中心落在 i 的爆炸圆内，即两点距离的平方 ≤ r_i²。这个关系不对称（半径不同），所以要建有向图：i → j。引爆一颗炸弹后最终被波及的集合，就是从它出发能到达的所有节点。n 最多 100，对每个起点做一次 DFS/BFS 数可达节点，取最大值即可。比较时全部用整数平方，避免开根号的精度问题，C++ 中平方要用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: Bomb i sets off bomb j exactly when j's center lies inside i's circle, i.e. the squared distance is at most r_i². The relation is not symmetric because radii differ, so build a directed graph with edges i → j. Detonating one bomb reaches exactly the nodes reachable from it. With n ≤ 100, run a DFS or BFS from every start, count reachable nodes, and keep the maximum. Compare squared integers to avoid square roots; in C++ the squares need long long.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举左端点 + 维护区间最值
approaches.nameEn: Fix the left end, track running min/max
approaches.ideaZh: 固定左端点 i，让右端点 j 从 i 往右扩展，同时维护当前子数组的最小值和最大值，每扩展一步就把 max - min 加进答案。这样每个子数组只花 O(1)，总共 O(n²)，n ≤ 1000 时可以通过。它的问题在于要逐个枚举子数组；如果能直接算出每个元素作为最大值或最小值的次数，就能降到线性。
approaches.ideaEn: Fix the left end i and extend the right end j, keeping the running minimum and maximum, and add max - min at every step. Each subarray costs O(1), O(n²) overall, which passes for n ≤ 1000. The limitation is that it still visits every subarray; counting how often each element is the maximum or minimum avoids that.

approaches.ideaZh: 所有子数组的 (最大值 - 最小值) 之和，等于"所有子数组最大值之和"减去"所有子数组最小值之和"。对于 nums[j]，设它左边第一个比它大的位置是 L、右边第一个大于等于它的位置是 R，那么它是 (j - L) × (R - j) 个子数组的最大值；一边取严格、一边取非严格，保证相等元素不会重复计数。用单调递减栈扫一遍就能在弹栈时同时得到 L 和 R。最小值之和不必另写：把数组取反后求最大值之和，正好是原数组最小值之和的相反数，两者相加即为答案。
approaches.ideaEn: The total of (max - min) over all subarrays equals the sum of subarray maxima minus the sum of subarray minima. If L is the nearest index to the left of j with a strictly greater value and R the nearest to the right with a greater-or-equal value, nums[j] is the maximum of exactly (j - L) × (R - j) subarrays; mixing strict and non-strict comparisons keeps ties from being counted twice. A decreasing stack yields both L and R at the moment j is popped. For minima, negate the array: its sum of maxima is minus the original sum of minima, so the answer is the two maxima sums added together.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个单词单独做一次网格搜索，会把公共前缀反复走很多遍。把所有单词建成一棵字典树，然后从每个格子出发做 DFS，只沿着字典树里存在的分支走，一次搜索就能同时匹配所有单词。走过的格子临时改成 # 防止重复使用，回溯时再恢复。走到某个单词的结尾就记录它，并把该标记删掉，避免同一个词重复加入。还有一个关键剪枝：某个字典树节点的子树里已经没有待找的单词时，把它从父节点上摘掉，后续搜索就不会再进入这条死路。
approaches.ideaEn: Searching the grid once per word re-walks shared prefixes over and over. Put all words in a trie and run one DFS from each cell, following only branches that exist in the trie, so every word is matched in the same pass. Mark visited cells with # and restore them when backtracking. When a node ends a word, record it and clear the marker so the word is not added twice. The key pruning step: once a trie node has no words left below it, detach it from its parent so later searches never enter that dead branch.

approaches.nameZh: 拆环为两段线性打家劫舍
approaches.nameEn: Break the circle into two linear runs
approaches.ideaZh: 环形带来的唯一新约束是：第一间和最后一间不能同时偷。那么最优方案要么不偷最后一间，要么不偷第一间，两种情况必居其一。于是分别对 nums[0..n-2] 和 nums[1..n-1] 做普通的线性打家劫舍，取较大者。线性版本只需两个变量：take 表示偷当前这间时的最大值，skip 表示不偷时的最大值。只有一间房时要单独返回它，因为两段都会是空的。
approaches.ideaEn: The circle adds just one constraint: the first and last houses cannot both be robbed. So an optimal plan skips the last house or skips the first, one of the two. Run the ordinary linear house-robber on nums[0..n-2] and on nums[1..n-1] and take the larger. The linear version needs only two values: take, the best when robbing the current house, and skip, the best when not. A single house is returned directly, since both ranges would be empty.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个单词只有两个字母，回文串由左右对称的单词对组成。对于两个字母不同的词，比如 "ab"，只能和 "ba" 配对，一对贡献 4 个字符，对数是两者数量的较小值。两个字母相同的词，比如 "aa"，可以自己和自己配对，每两个贡献 4；如果某种这样的词数量是奇数，多出来的那个可以放在正中间，但整个回文串只能有一个中心，所以最多再加 2。用计数表统计后一次遍历即可。不同的单词最多 26×26 种，所以计数表是常数大小。
approaches.ideaEn: Each word has two letters, and a palindrome is built from mirrored word pairs. A word with different letters such as "ab" pairs only with "ba"; each pair adds 4 characters and the number of pairs is the smaller of the two counts. A word with equal letters such as "aa" pairs with itself, every two copies adding 4. If any such word has an odd count, one leftover copy can sit in the middle, but there is only one middle, so add 2 at most once. Count the words and make a single pass. There are at most 26×26 distinct words, so the counter has constant size.
