approaches.ideaZh: 只能在前面加字符，所以结果一定是"把 s 的某个后缀反转后放到前面"。要让加的字符最少，就要找 s 最长的回文前缀 s[0..i)，然后把剩下的 s[i..] 反转贴到最前面。判断 s[0..i) 是否回文，等价于判断它是否等于反转串 rev 的最后 i 个字符。从 i = n 往下试，第一个成立的就是答案。最坏 O(n²)（比如 "aaa...ab"），但它把问题清晰地化成了"求最长回文前缀"。
approaches.ideaEn: Characters can only go in front, so the result is always some suffix of s reversed and placed before s. To add as few as possible, find the longest palindromic prefix s[0..i) and prepend the reverse of the rest s[i..]. s[0..i) is a palindrome exactly when it equals the last i characters of rev, the reversed string. Try i from n downward and stop at the first match. Worst case O(n²) (e.g. "aaa...ab"), but it reduces the task cleanly to finding the longest palindromic prefix.

approaches.ideaZh: 最长回文前缀 = s 的最长前缀，同时也是 rev 的后缀。构造 t = s + "#" + rev，对 t 求 KMP 的前缀函数（每个位置上"既是前缀又是后缀"的最长长度）。t 末尾位置的值就是 s 的前缀与 rev 的后缀最长能重合多少；中间的 # 不会出现在 s 里，保证这个重合不会跨过分隔符、超过 s 的长度。设这个值为 L，答案就是 rev 的前 n - L 个字符拼上 s。前缀函数线性可求，整体 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: The longest palindromic prefix is the longest prefix of s that is also a suffix of rev. Build t = s + "#" + rev and compute its KMP prefix function, the length of the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix at each position. The value at the end of t is the longest overlap between a prefix of s and a suffix of rev; the # never occurs in s, so the overlap cannot cross the separator or exceed n. With that value L, the answer is the first n - L characters of rev followed by s. The prefix function is linear, so the whole thing is O(n).

approaches.ideaZh: 从前往后想很别扭：做了第 i 题会影响后面若干题能不能做。反过来定义 dp[i] 为只考虑第 i 题及之后的题目时能拿到的最高分，就变得干净。对第 i 题只有两种选择：跳过，得到 dp[i + 1]；解答，得到 points[i] 加上 dp[i + brainpower[i] + 1]（下标越界就当作 0）。两者取最大，从最后一题倒推到第 0 题，dp[0] 就是答案。分数总和可能超过 int，C++ 用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: Thinking forward is awkward because solving question i blocks a number of later ones. Define dp[i] as the best score using only questions i and after, and it becomes clean. Question i has two options: skip it and get dp[i + 1], or solve it and get points[i] plus dp[i + brainpower[i] + 1], treating an out-of-range index as 0. Take the larger, fill from the last question back to the first, and dp[0] is the answer. The total can exceed int, so C++ uses long long.

approaches.nameZh: 大小为 k 的最小堆
approaches.ideaZh: 维护一个只装 k 个元素的最小堆，堆里始终是目前见过的最大的 k 个数，堆顶是其中最小的那个。先用前 k 个数建堆，之后每来一个数，如果它比堆顶大，就替换掉堆顶。扫描结束后，堆顶正好是第 k 大的元素。时间 O(n log k)，当 k 远小于 n 时很快，而且适合数据流式到达的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a min-heap holding exactly k elements: the k largest seen so far, with the smallest of them on top. Build it from the first k numbers; for each later number, replace the top if the number is larger. After the scan, the top is the k-th largest. O(n log k) is fast when k is small and works on streaming input too.

approaches.nameZh: 随机快速选择（三路划分）
approaches.ideaZh: 排序后取下标是 O(n log n)，但我们只关心一个位置，不需要整个序列都有序。随机选一个基准 p，把数组分成"大于 p"、"等于 p"、"小于 p"三段。第 k 大落在哪一段可以由前两段的大小直接判断：落在等于段就返回 p，否则只在对应的那一段里继续找。随机基准使期望时间为 O(n)；三路划分是为了应对大量重复元素，否则全相等的数组会退化成平方。O(1) 空间指 C++ 的原地划分；Python 版本每轮新建列表，需要 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Sorting costs O(n log n), but only one position matters. Pick a random pivot p and split the values into greater than p, equal to p, and less than p. The sizes of the first two groups tell where the k-th largest lies: in the equal group, return p; otherwise continue only in the matching group. A random pivot gives expected O(n) time, and the three-way split handles heavy duplicates, which would otherwise degrade to quadratic time. The O(1) space is for the in-place C++ partition; the Python version builds new lists and needs O(n).

approaches.ideaZh: 只能用 1 到 9，每个数字最多用一次，组合不计顺序，所以规定数字按递增顺序选，天然避免重复组合。递归时记录下一个可选的起点 start 和剩余需要凑的和 remain。路径长度到达 k 时，只有 remain 恰好为 0 才记录。循环里一旦当前数字超过 remain 就可以停止，因为后面的数字只会更大。搜索空间最多是 9 个数字的子集，只有 512 种，所以复杂度可以视为常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Only digits 1 to 9 are allowed, each at most once, and order does not matter, so pick digits in increasing order to avoid duplicate combinations. The recursion tracks the next allowed digit start and the remaining sum remain. When the path reaches k digits, record it only if remain is exactly 0. Inside the loop, stop as soon as the digit exceeds remain, since later digits are even larger. The search space is at most the 512 subsets of nine digits, effectively constant.

approaches.ideaZh: 给定时间 t，所有公交一共能跑 sum(t // time[i]) 趟，这个数随 t 单调不减，所以"t 时间内能否完成 totalTrips 趟"是一个单调的判定，可以二分最小的可行 t。下界取 1；上界取最快那辆车单独跑完全部趟数的时间 min(time) × totalTrips，这一定可行。每次检验 O(n)，二分约 log(10^14) ≈ 47 轮。C++ 中累加趟数时一旦达到 totalTrips 就提前退出，否则总和可能溢出 long long。其中 R = min(time) × totalTrips，即二分的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Within time t the buses complete sum(t // time[i]) trips, which never decreases as t grows, so "can we finish totalTrips by time t" is monotone and the smallest feasible t can be binary searched. The lower bound is 1; the upper bound min(time) × totalTrips, the fastest bus doing every trip alone, is always feasible. Each check is O(n) and there are about log(10^14) ≈ 47 rounds. In C++, stop summing once the count reaches totalTrips, or the sum can overflow long long. Here R = min(time) × totalTrips, the upper end of the search.

approaches.ideaZh: 对每个值，只需要关心它上一次出现的位置：如果最近的一次都离得超过 k，更早的那些只会更远。所以从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个值最后一次出现的下标。遇到 nums[i] 时，若它出现过且 i 减去上次下标 ≤ k 就返回 true，否则把它的位置更新为 i。扫描完都没命中就返回 false。
approaches.ideaEn: For each value only its most recent occurrence matters: if even that one is more than k away, earlier ones are farther still. Scan left to right with a hash map from value to the last index where it appeared. At nums[i], return true if it appeared before and i minus that index is at most k; otherwise update its index to i. If the scan finishes without a hit, return false.

approaches.nameZh: 回溯：按剩余括号数生成
approaches.ideaZh: 先生成全部 2^(2n) 个括号串再筛选会做大量无用功，更好的办法是只生成合法的前缀。逐个字符构造：已用的左括号少于 n 时可以放 "("；已放的右括号少于左括号时才能放 ")"，这保证任何前缀里右括号都不会多于左括号。长度达到 2n 时得到一个合法组合。因为先尝试 "(" 再尝试 ")"，结果自然按字典序排列。答案个数是第 n 个卡特兰数，每个串长 2n。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Generating all 2^(2n) strings and filtering wastes most of the work; instead, only ever build valid prefixes. Add characters one at a time: "(" is allowed while fewer than n have been used, and ")" only while there are fewer closes than opens, so no prefix ever has more closes than opens. A string of length 2n is a complete valid combination. Trying "(" before ")" yields the results in lexicographic order. The output has Catalan(n) strings, each of length 2n. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 下标限制用滑动窗口处理：只保留最近 indexDiff 个元素。值的限制用分桶处理：桶宽取 valueDiff + 1，把 x 放进编号为 floor(x / (valueDiff + 1)) 的桶里，这样同一个桶内任意两个数之差一定 ≤ valueDiff。新来一个数时，如果它的桶里已经有数，直接返回 true；否则只需再看左右相邻的两个桶，差值合格也返回 true，更远的桶不可能满足。因为一旦同桶就返回，每个桶最多存一个数，用哈希表存即可；窗口右移时把滑出窗口的那个数所在的桶删掉。负数要向下取整，C++ 需要手动处理。
approaches.ideaEn: The index limit is a sliding window holding the latest indexDiff elements. The value limit is handled with buckets of width valueDiff + 1: x goes into bucket floor(x / (valueDiff + 1)), so any two numbers in one bucket differ by at most valueDiff. When a new number arrives, an occupied bucket means true right away; otherwise only the two neighbouring buckets can hold a close enough value, so check them. Because a shared bucket returns immediately, each bucket holds at most one number and a hash map suffices; as the window slides, delete the bucket of the element that leaves. Negative numbers need floor division, which C++ must do by hand.

approaches.ideaZh: 令 dp[i][j] 表示以 (i, j) 为右下角、全由 1 组成的最大正方形边长。如果该格是 0，dp 为 0；如果是 1，它能扩成多大的正方形，受上方、左方、左上方三个邻居共同限制，所以 dp[i][j] = min(上, 左, 左上) + 1。每行只依赖上一行和本行左边，可以压成一维数组，额外用一个变量 prev 记住被覆盖前的左上角值。遍历过程中记录最大边长，返回它的平方作为面积。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i][j] be the side of the largest all-ones square whose bottom-right corner is (i, j). A 0 cell gives 0; a 1 cell is limited by its top, left and top-left neighbours together, so dp[i][j] = min(top, left, top-left) + 1. Each row depends only on the previous row and the cell to its left, so one array suffices, with a variable prev holding the top-left value before it is overwritten. Track the largest side and return its square as the area.

approaches.ideaZh: 不利用完全二叉树的性质，任何二叉树都可以这样数：节点总数等于 1 加上左右子树的节点数，空树为 0。每个节点访问一次，时间 O(n)。它正确但没有用上"完全"这个条件，题目的进阶要求比 O(n) 更快。
approaches.ideaEn: Ignoring the completeness property, any binary tree can be counted as 1 plus the counts of its two subtrees, with 0 for an empty tree. Every node is visited once, O(n). Correct, but it never uses the fact that the tree is complete, and the follow-up asks for better than O(n).

approaches.ideaZh: 在完全二叉树里，一直往左走能得到最大深度，一直往右走得到最小深度。如果两者相等，这棵树就是满二叉树，节点数直接是 2^h - 1，不用再往下数。如果不相等，就对根做"1 + 左子树 + 右子树"的递归。关键在于：完全二叉树的左右子树中至少有一棵是满的，它会在下一层递归中立刻用公式返回，所以每层只有一条分支真正往下走。共 O(log n) 层，每层量高度 O(log n)，总计 O(log² n)。
approaches.ideaEn: In a complete tree, walking all the way left gives the largest depth and walking all the way right gives the smallest. If they match, the tree is perfect and has 2^h - 1 nodes, no further counting needed. Otherwise return 1 plus the counts of both subtrees. The key fact is that at least one subtree of a complete tree is perfect, so it returns via the formula one level down, and only one branch per level actually descends. That is O(log n) levels, each measuring heights in O(log n), for O(log² n) total.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果每个孩子能分到 x 颗糖，那么分到 x-1 颗也一定可以，所以"能否满足 k 个孩子"关于 x 是单调的。给定 x，每堆糖最多切出 candies[i] // x 份，把所有堆的份数加起来和 k 比较就能判定可行性。在 [0, max(candies)] 上二分最大的可行 x，答案为 0 表示连每人一颗都凑不够。注意 k 可达 10^12，C++ 里计数要用 long long，并且凑够 k 份后可以提前结束累加。其中 M = max(candies)。
approaches.ideaEn: If every child can get x candies, they can also get x-1, so feasibility is monotone in x. For a fixed x, pile i yields candies[i] // x portions; sum them and compare with k. Binary search the largest feasible x in [0, max(candies)]; 0 means even one candy each is impossible. k can reach 10^12, so count with 64-bit integers. Here M = max(candies).

approaches.nameZh: 栈保存括号外的结果与符号
approaches.ideaZh: 表达式只有加减和括号，所以每个数最终的贡献就是它前面所有符号相乘后的正负号。扫描时维护当前层的累计结果 res、正在读的数 num 和它前面的符号 sign。遇到 "(" 时把 (res, sign) 压栈，然后在括号内从 0 重新累计；遇到 ")" 时先结算括号内的值，再弹栈得到 外层结果 + 外层符号 × 括号值。一元负号（如 "-(2+3)" 或 "1-(-2)"）不需要特判：它等价于在 0 后面做减法。
approaches.ideaEn: With only + and - plus parentheses, each number contributes with a sign determined by the operators before it. Track the running result res, the number being read num, and its sign. On "(", push (res, sign) and restart from 0 inside; on ")", finish the inner value and combine it as outer + outerSign * inner. Unary minus needs no special case because it behaves like subtracting from 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 栈要求最后进来的元素最先出去，而队列只能从队头出。做法是让 push 承担重排成本：新元素入队后，把它前面的 n-1 个元素依次出队再入队，新元素就被转到了队头。这样队列的出队顺序始终就是栈的弹出顺序，pop 和 top 直接看队头即可。也可以反过来让 pop 承担成本，但那样 top 也要跟着付代价，不如这种写法简洁。
approaches.ideaEn: A stack pops the newest element, but a queue only removes from the front. Let push pay the cost: after enqueueing x, rotate the previous n-1 elements behind it so x moves to the front. The queue order then always matches stack pop order, so pop and top just read the front. Making pop pay instead also burdens top, so this version is simpler.

approaches.ideaZh: 一棵树翻转后的样子，就是根不动、左右子树互换，并且两棵子树各自也被翻转。所以对每个节点做一件事：交换它的左右孩子，再递归处理两个孩子。空节点直接返回。修改是原地进行的，返回原来的根即可；每个节点只访问一次。
approaches.ideaEn: The mirror of a tree keeps the root, swaps its subtrees, and mirrors each subtree. So at every node, swap its children and recurse into both. Empty nodes return immediately. The change is in place, so return the original root; every node is visited once.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def invertTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if root:
            root.left, root.right = self.invertTree(root.right), self.invertTree(root.left)
        return root

approaches.ideaZh: 乘除优先级高于加减，所以可以把表达式看成若干"项"相加，每一项是一串乘除。扫描时记住上一个运算符：遇到加号把数压栈，减号压它的相反数，乘除则直接和栈顶运算后替换栈顶。读到下一个运算符或字符串末尾时才结算当前数字，最后把栈里所有项加起来。整数除法要向零截断，而栈顶可能是负数，所以按绝对值整除后再补回符号，不能直接用 Python 的 //。
approaches.ideaEn: Multiplication and division bind tighter, so the expression is a sum of terms, each a chain of * and /. Remember the previous operator: push num for +, push -num for -, and for * or / combine with the stack top in place. Settle a number when the next operator or the end arrives, then sum the stack. Division truncates toward zero and the top may be negative, so divide absolute values and restore the sign.

approaches.nameZh: 常数空间：只保留最后一项
approaches.nameEn: O(1) space: keep only the last term
approaches.ideaZh: 栈里真正会被再次修改的只有栈顶，因为乘除只作用在最近的那一项上。所以把栈压缩成两个变量：res 是已经确定的项之和，last 是还可能被乘除改变的最后一项。遇到加减时把 last 并入 res，再让新数（或其相反数）成为 last；遇到乘除只更新 last。结束时答案就是 res + last，逻辑和栈法一一对应，但只用常数额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Only the stack top is ever modified again, because * and / act on the most recent term. Collapse the stack into res (sum of finished terms) and last (the term still open to * and /). On + or -, fold last into res and start a new last; on * or /, update last only. The answer is res + last, mirroring the stack method with constant extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接统计每个数出现的次数，再挑出次数超过 n/3 的那些。这是最直接的做法，时间线性，但需要额外的哈希表。它也说明了答案最多只有两个：如果有三个数都超过 n/3，总次数就会超过 n。这个上界正是下一种做法能用常数空间的原因。
approaches.ideaEn: Count every value and keep those appearing more than n/3 times. It is linear time but needs a hash map. It also shows there are at most two answers: three values above n/3 would exceed n in total. That bound is what lets the next approach run in constant space.

approaches.ideaZh: 把投票法推广成同时维护两个候选及其票数。遇到等于某个候选的数就给它加票；遇到空的票位就让当前数占位；否则三个互不相同的数"同归于尽"，两个候选各减一票。每次抵消都会消掉三个不同的数，所以真正超过 n/3 的数不可能被完全抵消，一定会留在候选里。但候选不一定就是答案，最后必须再扫一遍，统计两个候选的真实次数再确认。
approaches.ideaEn: Generalize voting to two candidates with counters. A value equal to a candidate adds a vote; an empty slot adopts the value; otherwise three distinct values cancel and both counters drop by one. Each cancellation removes three different values, so anything above n/3 survives as a candidate. Survivors are not guaranteed answers, so a second pass counts them for real.

approaches.ideaZh: 合并后的下一个节点，一定是 k 条链当前头节点中最小的那个。把所有非空链的头放进最小堆，每次弹出最小的接到结果尾部，再把它的后继推进堆。堆里始终最多 k 个元素，所以每个节点进出堆的代价是 O(log k)。Python 里节点不能直接比较，入堆时附带链的编号作为第二关键字来打破平局。
approaches.ideaEn: The next merged node is always the smallest among the k current heads. Put all non-empty heads into a min-heap, pop the smallest onto the result, and push its successor. The heap holds at most k items, so each of the N nodes costs O(log k). In Python, nodes are not comparable, so a list index breaks ties.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def mergeKLists(self, lists: List[Optional[ListNode]]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        heap = [(node.val, i, node) for i, node in enumerate(lists) if node]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        while heap:
            _, i, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
            tail.next = tail = node
            if node.next:
                heapq.heappush(heap, (node.next.val, i, node.next))
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 如果按顺序把链表一条条并进结果，前面的节点会被反复扫描，总代价接近 O(Nk)。改成像归并排序那样两两配对合并：第一轮合并后链数减半，每一轮所有节点只被扫描一次，一共 log k 轮。合并两条有序链就是经典的双指针拼接。这种做法不需要堆，额外空间只有递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Merging lists one by one rescans early nodes repeatedly, close to O(Nk). Instead pair them up like merge sort: each round halves the number of lists and touches every node once, for log k rounds. Merging two sorted lists is the standard two-pointer splice. No heap is needed; extra space is just the recursion stack.

approaches.nameZh: 迭代中序遍历，数到第 k 个就停
approaches.ideaZh: BST 的中序遍历恰好按从小到大的顺序访问节点，所以第 k 个被访问的节点就是答案。用显式栈模拟中序：一路向左压栈，弹出一个节点就把计数减一，减到 0 立刻返回，然后转向它的右子树。这样只访问了前 k 个节点及其路径上的祖先，不必遍历整棵树。
approaches.ideaEn: Inorder traversal of a BST visits values in ascending order, so the k-th visited node is the answer. Simulate inorder with an explicit stack: push left as far as possible, pop a node, decrement k, return when it hits 0, then move to the right child. Only the first k nodes and their ancestors are touched.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def kthSmallest(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], k: int) -> int:
        stack, node = [], root
        while True:
            while node:
                stack.append(node)
                node = node.left
            node = stack.pop()
            k -= 1
            if k == 0:
                return node.val
            node = node.right

approaches.ideaZh: 对固定的咒语 s，药水 p 成功当且仅当 s * p >= success，也就是 p >= ceil(success / s)。把药水排序后，满足条件的药水正好是一段后缀，用二分找到第一个不小于这个阈值的位置，后缀长度就是答案。用整数向上取整来算阈值，既避免了浮点误差，也避免了 s * p 在 C++ 里溢出 int。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序和输出。
approaches.ideaEn: For a spell s, potion p works iff s * p >= success, i.e. p >= ceil(success / s). After sorting potions, the working ones form a suffix; binary search for the first potion at or above the threshold. Computing the threshold with integer ceiling division avoids both floating-point error and overflow of s * p. Extra space is O(1), excluding the sort and the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组元素都是正数，所以子数组的得分（和 × 长度）在左端固定时随右端增大而单调增大，在右端固定时随左端右移而单调减小。枚举右端点 r，把 nums[r] 加入窗口，只要窗口得分 >= k 就右移左端点。此时以 r 结尾、左端在 [l, r] 之间的子数组得分都小于 k，一次性计入 r - l + 1 个。左右指针都只前进，总体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: All values are positive, so a subarray score (sum times length) grows as it extends and shrinks as its left end moves right. For each right end r, add nums[r] and advance l while the score is at least k. Then every subarray ending at r that starts in [l, r] qualifies, adding r - l + 1 at once. Both pointers only move forward.

approaches.nameEn: Bit trick: exactly one set bit
approaches.ideaZh: 2 的幂在二进制下恰好只有一个 1。n & (n - 1) 会把 n 最低位的那个 1 清掉，所以对正数而言，结果为 0 就说明原来只有一个 1。0 和负数都不是 2 的幂，必须先用 n > 0 排除；否则 0 会被误判为真，而 INT_MIN 在补码下也只有一个 1。
approaches.ideaEn: A power of two has exactly one set bit. n & (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit, so for positive n a zero result means only one bit was set. Zero and negatives must be excluded with n > 0 first; otherwise 0 passes, and INT_MIN also has a single set bit in two's complement.

approaches.ideaZh: 用一个输入栈接收 push，一个输出栈负责 pop 和 peek。输出栈为空时，把输入栈全部倒过去，顺序恰好反转，栈顶就是最早进入的元素。只在输出栈空时才倒，保证已经在输出栈里的元素顺序不被打乱，peek 也不会改变逻辑顺序。每个元素最多进出两个栈各一次，所以单次操作均摊 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: An input stack takes pushes and an output stack serves pop and peek. When the output stack is empty, pour the input stack into it; the order flips so the oldest element is on top. Pouring only when output is empty keeps existing order intact, so peek never disturbs the queue. Each element moves at most once between stacks, giving amortized O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 链表不能从尾部往回走，最省事的办法是先把所有值复制到数组里。数组支持随机访问，判断回文只要比较它和它的反转是否相同，或者用首尾双指针向中间收拢。代码很短，但需要 O(n) 额外空间，这正是下一种做法要优化掉的部分。
approaches.ideaEn: A singly linked list cannot walk backward, so copy the values into an array. With random access, a palindrome check is just comparing the array with its reverse, or two pointers moving inward. It is short but uses O(n) extra space, which the next approach removes.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        vals = []
        while head:
            vals.append(head.val)
            head = head.next
        return vals == vals[::-1]

approaches.nameZh: 快慢指针 + 反转后半段
approaches.ideaZh: 快指针一次走两步、慢指针一次走一步，快指针到底时慢指针停在中点附近。把慢指针之后的后半段原地反转，然后从头和从反转后的头同时向后比较，长度为奇数时中间节点自然被跳过。比较完再把后半段反转回去，调用方拿到的链表结构不变。整个过程只用几个指针。
approaches.ideaEn: Move a fast pointer two steps and a slow pointer one step; when fast reaches the end, slow sits at the middle. Reverse the half after slow in place, then compare from the head and from the reversed half; for odd length the middle node is skipped naturally. Reverse the second half back afterward so the caller sees the original list. Only a few pointers are used.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        def reverse(node):
            prev = None
            while node:
                node.next, prev, node = prev, node, node.next
            return prev

        slow = fast = head
        while fast.next and fast.next.next:
            slow, fast = slow.next, fast.next.next
        second = reverse(slow.next)
        p, q, ok = head, second, True
        while q:
            if p.val != q.val:
                ok = False
                break
            p, q = p.next, q.next
        slow.next = reverse(second)
        return ok

approaches.nameZh: 按数位和分组，记录组内最大值
approaches.nameEn: Group by digit sum, keep the group maximum
approaches.ideaZh: 只有数位和相同的数才能配对，所以按数位和分组。某一组里和最大的一对，一定是组内最大的两个数。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个数位和目前见过的最大值：当前数 x 和同组已有的最大值相加就是以 x 收尾的最优配对，用它更新答案，再用 x 更新该组最大值。这样不需要把每组都排序。不同的数位和只有 O(log M) 种，M 为最大值。
approaches.ideaEn: Only numbers with the same digit sum can pair, so group by digit sum. The best pair in a group is its two largest values. Scan once, keeping the largest value seen so far for each digit sum: x plus that maximum is the best pair ending at x, which updates the answer, then x updates the group maximum. No per-group sorting is needed. There are only O(log M) distinct digit sums, where M is the largest value.

approaches.nameZh: 沿 BST 性质向下走
approaches.ideaZh: 在 BST 中，如果 p 和 q 的值都小于当前节点，它们都在左子树里，公共祖先也在左边；都大于当前节点就往右走。一旦两者分居两侧，或者其中一个就等于当前节点，当前节点就是最近公共祖先，因为再往任何一边走都会丢掉另一个节点。只沿一条路径向下，不需要递归和额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: In a BST, if both p and q are smaller than the current node, they and their LCA lie in the left subtree; if both are larger, go right. Once they split to different sides, or one equals the current node, that node is the LCA, since moving either way would lose the other. It follows a single path with no recursion or extra space.

approaches.nameZh: 哈希表 + 每种菜系一个惰性删除堆
approaches.nameEn: Hash maps + lazy-deletion heap per cuisine
approaches.ideaZh: 用哈希表记录每道菜当前的评分和所属菜系，再给每个菜系建一个堆，按 (评分降序, 名字升序) 排列。改评分时不去堆里找旧记录，而是直接压入一条新记录 (新评分, 菜名)，旧记录留在堆里成为过期数据。查询时看堆顶：如果它记录的评分和哈希表里的当前评分不一致，说明已经过期，弹掉继续看下一条。每条记录最多被压入和弹出一次，所以总代价是对数级的均摊。
approaches.ideaEn: Hash maps store each food's current rating and cuisine, and each cuisine has a heap ordered by (rating desc, name asc). A rating change pushes a fresh (rating, food) entry instead of locating the old one, leaving the old entry stale. On a query, pop the top while its rating disagrees with the current rating in the map. Each entry is pushed and popped at most once, so costs are amortized logarithmic.

approaches.nameZh: 沿唯一出边各走一遍求距离
approaches.nameEn: Walk each path to record distances
approaches.ideaZh: 每个节点至多一条出边，从一个起点出发能到达的节点就是一条链（可能最终进入环），沿着 edges 一直走、遇到已访问节点就停，即可得到起点到每个可达节点的距离。分别从 node1 和 node2 各走一遍，得到两个距离数组。对两边都可达的节点，取两段距离的较大值，答案是使这个值最小的节点，平局时按下标从小到大扫描自然取到最小下标。两个都到不了则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Each node has at most one outgoing edge, so the nodes reachable from a start form a single path that may end in a cycle; follow edges until hitting a visited node to get distances. Do this from node1 and node2. Among nodes reachable from both, minimize the larger of the two distances; scanning indices in increasing order breaks ties toward the smaller index. Return -1 if no node is reachable from both.

approaches.nameZh: 后序递归，合并左右子树结果
approaches.ideaZh: 定义递归函数：在以 node 为根的子树里找 p 或 q，找到就返回那个节点，都没找到返回空。如果当前节点本身是 p 或 q，直接返回它，因为另一个要么在它下面（它就是答案），要么在别处由上层处理。否则分别递归左右子树：两边都非空，说明 p、q 分居两侧，当前节点就是最近公共祖先；只有一边非空就把那一边的结果向上传。题目保证两个节点都存在，所以根处返回的就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Let the recursion return p or q if found in the subtree, or null otherwise. If the node itself is p or q, return it: the other target is either below it (making it the LCA) or elsewhere, which an ancestor will handle. Otherwise recurse left and right; if both sides are non-null, p and q are split and this node is the LCA; if only one is, pass it up. Both targets are guaranteed to exist, so the root call returns the answer.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Solution:
    def lowestCommonAncestor(self, root: 'TreeNode', p: 'TreeNode', q: 'TreeNode') -> 'TreeNode':
        if not root or root is p or root is q:
            return root
        left = self.lowestCommonAncestor(root.left, p, q)
        right = self.lowestCommonAncestor(root.right, p, q)
        if left and right:
            return root
        return left or right

approaches.nameZh: 变形成相同键计数，取补集
approaches.nameEn: Rewrite as equal keys, count the complement
approaches.ideaZh: 好数对的条件 j - i == nums[j] - nums[i] 移项后就是 nums[i] - i == nums[j] - j，所以只要两个下标的 nums[k] - k 相同就是好数对。直接数坏数对不好数，于是取补集：总对数 n(n-1)/2 减去好数对数。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个键出现过几次，当前下标能和之前同键的每个下标组成好数对；也可以直接在扫描时把"之前不同键的个数"累加成坏数对。
approaches.ideaEn: The good-pair condition j - i == nums[j] - nums[i] rearranges to nums[i] - i == nums[j] - j, so pairs with equal key nums[k] - k are good. Count bad pairs as the complement of good ones. Scan left to right with a hash map of key counts: index j is bad with every earlier index whose key differs, which is j minus the count of its key so far.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 表示前 i 个元素能否被完整划分。最后一段只有三种可能：长度 2 且两数相等；长度 3 且三数相等；长度 3 且是连续递增（相邻差为 1）。所以 dp[i] 只要看 dp[i-2] 和 dp[i-3] 再配合最后一段是否合法。dp[0] 为真，答案是 dp[n]。dp 只依赖前三项，可以压成滚动变量，这里保留数组让转移更直观。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] say whether the first i elements can be fully partitioned. The last block is either two equal values, three equal values, or three consecutive increasing values. So dp[i] depends only on dp[i-2] and dp[i-3] plus a check of that block. dp[0] is true and dp[n] is the answer; the array could shrink to three rolling variables.

approaches.ideaZh: 除自身以外的乘积，等于它左边所有数的乘积乘以右边所有数的乘积。第一遍从左到右，把每个位置左侧的前缀积写进结果数组；第二遍从右到左，用一个变量累计右侧的后缀积并乘进结果。全程不用除法，所以数组里有 0 也不需要特判。除了输出数组外只用常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The product except self is the product of everything to the left times everything to the right. A left-to-right pass writes prefix products into the answer; a right-to-left pass multiplies in a running suffix product. No division is used, so zeros need no special handling. Extra space beyond the output is constant.

approaches.ideaZh: 每次操作是给区间 [start, end] 的所有字符统一加 1 或减 1，逐个修改会是 O(nq)。改用差分数组：在 start 处加上 +1 或 -1，在 end+1 处减去同样的值，最后做一次前缀和就得到每个位置的总位移。字母表是循环的，总位移可能是负数，要对 26 取模并规范到 [0, 26) 再加到字符上。Python 的 % 本身返回非负数，C++ 需要写成 ((x % 26) + 26) % 26。
approaches.ideaEn: Each operation adds +1 or -1 to a whole range, so applying them one by one costs O(nq). With a difference array, add the delta at start and subtract it at end+1, then one prefix sum gives each position's total shift. The alphabet wraps and totals can be negative, so normalize modulo 26 into [0, 26). Python's % is already non-negative; C++ needs ((x % 26) + 26) % 26.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 (值, 下标) 放进最大堆，堆顶就是当前见过的最大值。窗口右移时不去堆里删除离开的元素，而是在取答案前检查堆顶下标：如果它已经落在窗口左边界之外就弹掉，直到堆顶仍在窗口内。每个元素最多入堆出堆一次，总复杂度 O(n log n)。它好写，但堆里会留着许多永远不可能成为答案的元素，这就是单调队列要去掉的冗余。
approaches.ideaEn: Push (value, index) into a max-heap so the top is the largest seen. When the window slides, do not delete leaving elements; before reading the answer, pop the top while its index is left of the window. Each element is pushed and popped at most once, giving O(n log n). The heap keeps many elements that can never win, which the monotonic deque removes.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果一个元素左边有比它小（或相等）的元素，那个旧元素在之后的任何窗口里都不可能是最大值，因为当前元素更大且离开得更晚。所以双端队列里只保留下标，对应的值从队头到队尾严格递减：新元素进来前，从队尾弹掉所有不大于它的值。队头下标如果已经滑出窗口就从队头弹掉，此时队头就是窗口最大值。每个下标只进出队列一次，整体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: If an older element is not larger than a newer one, it can never be a window maximum again, since the newer one is at least as large and leaves later. Keep indices in a deque whose values strictly decrease from front to back: before adding a new element, pop smaller-or-equal values from the back. Pop the front if it has slid out of the window; the front is then the maximum. Each index enters and leaves once.

approaches.nameEn: Topological sort rows and columns separately
approaches.ideaZh: 行条件只约束数字之间的上下顺序，列条件只约束左右顺序，两者互不影响，可以拆成两个独立的问题。对行条件建有向图 above -> below，做一次 Kahn 拓扑排序，得到每个数字所在的行号；列条件同理得到列号。只要任何一个图有环（拓扑序不足 k 个），就不存在合法矩阵，返回空数组。两个拓扑序都是 1..k 的排列，于是每个数字占据唯一的 (行, 列)，把它填进 k×k 矩阵即可，其余位置为 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Row conditions only fix vertical order and column conditions only fix horizontal order, so they are independent. Build a graph above -> below and run Kahn's topological sort to assign each number a row; do the same for columns. If either graph has a cycle (fewer than k nodes ordered), no matrix exists and the answer is empty. Both orders are permutations of 1..k, so each number gets a unique (row, col) in the k x k grid, with zeros elsewhere.

approaches.ideaZh: 把问题拆成"交换前两个节点"加上"剩下的链表两两交换"。设前两个节点为 first 和 second，先递归处理 second 之后的部分得到新的后半段，再让 first 指向它、second 指向 first，返回 second 作为新头。少于两个节点时原样返回。写法很短，但递归深度是 n/2，需要 O(n) 栈空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the task into swapping the first two nodes and recursively swapping the rest. With first and second as the leading pair, recurse on the list after second, point first at that result, point second at first, and return second as the new head. Fewer than two nodes are returned as is. It is short but uses O(n) recursion depth.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def swapPairs(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        second = head.next
        head.next = self.swapPairs(second.next)
        second.next = head
        return second

approaches.ideaZh: 在链表前放一个哑节点，用 prev 指向"待交换这一对"的前驱。每一轮取出 a = prev.next 和 b = a.next，按顺序重连三根指针：prev 指向 b，a 指向 b 原来的后继，b 指向 a。然后 prev 移到 a（它现在是这一对的尾巴），继续下一对；剩不到两个节点时停止。哑节点让第一对和其他对的处理完全一样，只用常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Put a dummy node before the head and let prev point to the node before the next pair. Each round takes a = prev.next and b = a.next and rewires three pointers: prev to b, a to b's old successor, b to a. Then prev moves to a, now the tail of the pair; stop when fewer than two nodes remain. The dummy makes the first pair identical to the rest, with constant extra space.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def swapPairs(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = prev = ListNode(0, head)
        while prev.next and prev.next.next:
            a, b = prev.next, prev.next.next
            prev.next, a.next, b.next = b, b.next, a
            prev = a
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 每一行本身是升序的，所以可以对每一行单独做一次二分，找到第一个不小于 target 的位置再判断是否相等。这个做法只用到了"行有序"这一半条件，列有序完全没派上用场。它的价值在于提醒我们：二维有序矩阵至少能退化成 m 个一维问题。行数远小于列数时，这个解法其实也不慢。
approaches.ideaEn: Each row is sorted, so binary-search every row for the first value not less than target and check for equality. This only uses row ordering and ignores the column ordering entirely. It is a useful baseline: a 2D sorted matrix can always be treated as m independent 1D searches, which is fine when rows are few.

approaches.nameEn: Staircase search from the top-right corner
approaches.ideaZh: 站在右上角看：它是所在行的最大值，同时是所在列的最小值。若当前值比 target 大，那么这一整列往下只会更大，可以整列排除，向左走一步；若比 target 小，这一整行往左只会更小，可以整行排除，向下走一步。每一步都至少排除一行或一列，所以最多走 m+n 步。这正是把两个方向的有序性同时用上的写法。
approaches.ideaEn: The top-right cell is the largest in its row and the smallest in its column. If it is larger than target, its whole column below is larger too, so step left; if it is smaller, the rest of its row to the left is smaller too, so step down. Every step discards a full row or column, giving at most m+n steps. This is the solution that exploits both orderings at once.

approaches.nameZh: 双堆模拟（空闲房间堆 + 占用结束时间堆）
approaches.nameEn: Two heaps: free rooms and busy rooms
approaches.ideaZh: 先按开始时间排序会议，按顺序分配。用一个小根堆存空闲房间编号，另一个小根堆存 (结束时间, 房间号) 表示正在使用的房间。处理每个会议前，先把结束时间不晚于当前开始时间的房间全部释放回空闲堆。若有空闲房间，取编号最小的；否则从占用堆弹出最早结束的那间（结束时间相同则编号小者优先，这由元组比较自动保证），会议整体顺延，新结束时间为 旧结束时间 + 会议时长。最后统计每个房间使用次数，取次数最多且编号最小的。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort meetings by start time and assign them in order. Keep a min-heap of free room ids and a min-heap of (end time, room id) for busy rooms. Before each meeting, release every busy room whose end time is at most the current start. If a room is free, take the smallest id; otherwise pop the earliest-ending busy room (ties broken by id automatically through tuple ordering) and delay the meeting so it ends at old end + duration. Count uses per room and return the smallest id with the maximum count.
approaches.time: O(m log m + m log n)

approaches.nameEn: Hash by the shift-invariant difference pattern
approaches.ideaZh: 两个字符串能互相平移得到，当且仅当长度相同且相邻字符的差（模 26）完全一样。等价地，把每个字符减去首字符再模 26，相当于把字符串"平移到以 a 开头"，得到的规范形式就是分组键。模 26 处理了 z 到 a 的回绕，例如 "az" 和 "ba" 的规范形式都是 (0, 25)。单字符串的规范形式都是 (0,)，自然落入同一组。用哈希表按键收集即可。其中 L 为所有字符串的总长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Two strings are shifts of each other exactly when they have the same length and the same differences between adjacent letters modulo 26. Equivalently, subtract the first letter from every letter mod 26, i.e. shift the string so it starts with "a"; that canonical form is the group key. The modulo handles wraparound, so "az" and "ba" both map to (0, 25), and every single-letter string maps to (0,). Collect strings by key in a hash map. Here L is the total length of all strings.

approaches.nameZh: 哑节点 + 分组原地反转
approaches.nameEn: Dummy head with in-place group reversal
approaches.ideaZh: 用哑节点 dummy 指向头结点，prev 始终指向"上一组反转后的尾巴"。每轮先从 prev 往后数 k 个节点找到本组尾 tail，不足 k 个就直接返回，保证最后一段不动。记下下一组的起点 nxt，把本组 [prev.next, tail] 反转，反转时让第一个节点的 next 初始指向 nxt，这样反转完就自然接上了后面。最后把 prev.next 接到 tail（新的组头），并把 prev 移到原来的组头（现在的组尾）。整个过程只改指针，额外空间 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a dummy node before the head and keep prev at the tail of the previously processed group. Each round walks k nodes from prev to find this group's tail; if fewer than k remain, return immediately so the last short group stays untouched. Remember nxt = tail.next and reverse the group with the initial "previous" pointer set to nxt, so the reversed group is already linked to the rest. Then hook prev.next to tail (the new group head) and move prev to the old group head, which is now the group tail. Only pointers change, so extra space is O(1).
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        prev = dummy
        while True:
            tail = prev
            for _ in range(k):
                tail = tail.next
                if not tail:
                    return dummy.next
            nxt = tail.next
            pre, cur = nxt, prev.next
            while cur is not nxt:
                cur.next, pre, cur = pre, cur, cur.next
            first = prev.next
            prev.next = tail
            prev = first

approaches.nameZh: 逆向思考：最长可保留中间窗口
approaches.nameEn: Reverse view: longest middle window we may keep
approaches.ideaZh: 从两端取字符，等价于在中间保留一段连续子串不取。要求每种字符至少取 k 个，就是要求中间子串里每种字符的个数不超过 总数 − k。若某个字符总数本身就不足 k，直接返回 -1。于是问题变成：求满足这个上限的最长子串，经典滑动窗口——右端加入字符后若该字符超限，就移动左端直到恢复合法。答案是 n 减去最长窗口长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Taking characters from both ends is the same as keeping one contiguous middle substring. Taking at least k of each letter means the kept window may contain at most total - k of each letter; if any letter appears fewer than k times overall, return -1. Now find the longest window respecting those caps with a sliding window: after adding s[r], shrink from the left while that letter exceeds its cap. The answer is n minus the longest valid window.

approaches.nameZh: 按开始排序 + 结束时间小根堆
approaches.nameEn: Sort by start, min-heap of end times
approaches.ideaZh: 把会议按开始时间排序，堆里存每个已开房间当前会议的结束时间。新会议到来时，看最早结束的房间：若它的结束时间不晚于新会议开始，就复用这间房（替换堆顶）；否则必须新开一间（入堆）。堆的大小只增不减，最终大小就是同时使用的最大房间数。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort meetings by start time and keep a min-heap of end times, one per opened room. For each meeting, look at the room that frees up earliest: if it ends no later than the new start, reuse it by replacing the heap top; otherwise open a new room by pushing. The heap never shrinks, so its final size is the number of rooms needed.

approaches.nameZh: 扫描线：开始与结束分别排序
approaches.nameEn: Sweep line over sorted starts and ends
approaches.ideaZh: 房间数只取决于"某一时刻有多少会议在进行"，与具体哪场会议用哪间房无关。把所有开始时间、结束时间各自排序，用指针 j 指向最早还没结束的结束时间。依次处理开始时间 s：若 s >= ends[j]，说明有一场会议已经结束，可以腾出房间，j 前进；否则房间数加一。这个方法把区间问题转化为事件计数，是差分/扫描线思想的直接应用。
approaches.ideaEn: The room count only depends on how many meetings overlap at any moment, not on which meeting uses which room. Sort start times and end times separately and keep pointer j at the earliest end not yet consumed. For each start s in order: if s >= ends[j], some meeting has finished and its room is reused, so advance j; otherwise open a new room. This turns intervals into event counting, the core sweep-line idea.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口增量维护相等对数
approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with incremental pair count
approaches.ideaZh: 窗口里值 x 出现 c 次时，再加入一个 x 会新增 c 个相等对；移出一个 x 时，先把计数减一，再减去剩下的 c−1 个对。这样每次进出都能 O(1) 更新对数。"好"具有单调性：一个子数组是好的，向外扩展后仍是好的。所以对每个右端点 r，把左端点尽量右移直到窗口刚好不再是好的，此时左端点 l 左边的所有起点 0..l−1 都能和 r 组成好子数组，答案累加 l。
approaches.ideaEn: If value x already appears c times in the window, adding another x creates c new equal pairs; removing one x first decrements its count and then subtracts the remaining count. So pairs update in O(1) per move. Goodness is monotone: extending a good subarray keeps it good. For each right end r, advance the left end while the window is still good; afterwards every start in 0..l-1 forms a good subarray ending at r, so add l to the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 同一种分解的不同排列（如 [2,6] 和 [6,2]）只应出现一次，所以规定因子从左到右非降。dfs(n, start) 表示把 n 继续分解、下一个因子至少为 start。枚举 f 从 start 到 √n：若 f 整除 n，那么 path + [f, n/f] 本身就是一个合法答案（n/f ≥ f 保证非降），再递归 dfs(n/f, f) 把 n/f 继续拆。只枚举到 √n 是因为 f 之后的因子都不小于 f。时间与输出规模有关，F 为分解方案的个数；O(log n) 空间是递归深度。
approaches.ideaEn: Permutations of one factorization such as [2,6] and [6,2] must appear once, so force factors to be non-decreasing. dfs(n, start) factors n with the next factor at least start. Try every f from start up to sqrt(n): if f divides n, then path + [f, n/f] is already a valid answer (n/f >= f keeps order), and recursing with dfs(n/f, f) splits n/f further. Stopping at sqrt(n) works because every later factor must be at least f. The time is output-sensitive, with F the number of factorizations; the O(log n) space is the recursion depth.

approaches.ideaZh: 从根往下递归，参数里带着"到当前节点为止的路径字符串"。走到叶子（左右孩子都为空）时，路径就是一条完整答案，加入结果。非叶子节点在路径后追加 "->" 再分别递归左右子树。Python 字符串不可变，每层拿到的是自己的副本，相当于自动完成了回溯；C++ 按值传 string 也是同样效果。注意判定叶子要同时检查两个孩子，只有一侧为空的节点不能当作终点。时间主要花在复制路径字符串上；O(h) 是递归栈空间，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Recurse from the root while passing the path string built so far. At a leaf (both children null) the path is a complete answer, so record it. For an inner node, append "->" and recurse into both children. Passing the string by value gives each call its own copy, so backtracking happens for free. A node with only one child is not a leaf and must not end a path. The time goes into copying path strings; the O(h) space is the recursion stack, excluding the output.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def binaryTreePaths(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[str]:
        res = []

        def dfs(node, path):
            if not node:
                return
            path += str(node.val)
            if not node.left and not node.right:
                res.append(path)
                return
            path += '->'
            dfs(node.left, path)
            dfs(node.right, path)

        dfs(root, '')
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 用 k 表示已去重前缀 nums[0..k-1] 的长度，读指针 i 从左到右扫描。因为数组有序，重复元素一定相邻，所以只要 nums[i] 和前缀的最后一个元素 nums[k-1] 不同，它就是一个新值，写到 nums[k] 并让 k 加一。扫描结束后前 k 个位置就是去重结果，返回 k；k 之后的内容无关紧要。
approaches.ideaEn: Let k be the length of the deduplicated prefix nums[0..k-1] and scan with a read index i. Because the array is sorted, duplicates are adjacent, so nums[i] is new exactly when it differs from the last kept value nums[k-1]. Write it to nums[k] and increment k. After the scan the first k slots hold the answer and whatever lies beyond k does not matter.

approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的做法：统计每个数出现的次数，挑出只出现一次的两个数。它正确但需要 O(n) 额外空间，不满足题目的常数空间要求。写出它的意义在于对照：后面的位运算解法正是为了把这张哈希表"压缩"掉。
approaches.ideaEn: Count occurrences and return the two values that appear once. It is correct but uses O(n) extra space, violating the constant-space requirement. It serves as the baseline that the bit trick below compresses away.

approaches.nameEn: XOR and split by a differing bit
approaches.ideaZh: 把所有数异或起来，成对的数抵消，结果 x = a ^ b。因为 a ≠ b，x 至少有一位是 1，取最低位的 1：low = x & -x，这一位上 a 和 b 恰好一个是 0 一个是 1。按这一位把所有数分成两组：每对相同的数必然落在同一组，而 a、b 分在不同组。于是只异或其中一组，就得到 a，另一个是 x ^ a。C++ 中对 INT_MIN 取负会溢出，所以用无符号数计算 low。
approaches.ideaEn: XOR everything: pairs cancel and x = a ^ b remains. Since a != b, x has at least one set bit; take the lowest one, low = x & -x, where a and b differ. Splitting all numbers by that bit puts both copies of each duplicate in the same group but separates a from b. XOR one group to get a, and the other is x ^ a. In C++ compute low with unsigned arithmetic so INT_MIN does not overflow.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 前缀和 + 二分分界
approaches.nameEn: Sort, prefix sums and a binary-searched split
approaches.ideaZh: 对查询 q，总代价是 Σ|nums[i] − q|。排序后用二分找到第一个不小于 q 的位置 i：左边 i 个数都小于 q，代价是 q·i − 左侧和；右边 n−i 个数都不小于 q，代价是 右侧和 − q·(n−i)。左右两段的和都能用前缀和 O(1) 取出。于是预处理 O(n log n)，每个查询 O(log n)。答案可能超过 32 位，C++ 要用 long long。
approaches.ideaEn: For a query q the cost is the sum of |nums[i] - q|. After sorting, binary-search the first index i with nums[i] >= q. The i values on the left cost q*i - leftSum, the n-i values on the right cost rightSum - q*(n-i), and both sums come from a prefix-sum array in O(1). Preprocessing is O(n log n) and each query O(log n). Results exceed 32 bits, so C++ uses long long.

approaches.nameZh: 边数判定 + BFS 连通性
approaches.nameEn: Edge count check plus BFS connectivity
approaches.ideaZh: n 个点的树恰好有 n−1 条边且连通，这两个条件同时成立时也必然无环。所以先判断边数是否等于 n−1，不等直接返回 false。然后建邻接表，从 0 号点 BFS，统计能到达的点数；若等于 n 就是连通的，结合边数即可断定是树。这样避免了在无向图里显式判环时"父节点回边"的麻烦。
approaches.ideaEn: A tree on n nodes has exactly n-1 edges and is connected, and those two facts together already rule out cycles. So first reject if the edge count is not n-1. Then build an adjacency list, BFS from node 0 and count reachable nodes; reaching all n means connected, hence a tree. This sidesteps the parent-edge bookkeeping of explicit cycle detection in undirected graphs.

approaches.ideaZh: 逐条加入边：若两个端点已经在同一个集合里，再连这条边就会形成环，直接返回 false；否则合并两个集合。所有边处理完且没有环时，图是一个森林，森林连通当且仅当边数恰好是 n−1。并查集配合路径压缩，单次操作接近常数。它的好处是可以在线处理边，不需要先建图。
approaches.ideaEn: Add edges one by one: if both endpoints are already in the same set, this edge closes a cycle, so return false; otherwise union them. With no cycle the graph is a forest, which is connected exactly when it has n-1 edges. With path compression each operation is nearly constant. It handles edges online without building an adjacency list.

approaches.ideaZh: 回文串左右对称，除了正中间（长度为奇数时）以外，每个字符都必须成对出现。因此一个字符串能重排成回文，当且仅当出现奇数次的字符最多只有一个。统计每个字符的频次，数一数奇数频次的个数即可。也可以用一个集合"出现就加入、再出现就删除"，最后看集合大小是否 ≤ 1。其中 Σ 为字符集大小。
approaches.ideaEn: A palindrome is symmetric, so every character must pair up except possibly one in the middle. Hence a permutation is a palindrome exactly when at most one character has an odd count. Count characters and check how many counts are odd. An equivalent trick toggles characters in a set and checks that its final size is at most one. Here Σ is the alphabet size.

approaches.nameZh: 先判奇偶，再回溯排列一半
approaches.ideaZh: 先统计频次：奇数频次的字符超过一个就不存在回文排列，返回空列表；若恰好一个，它必须放在正中间。回文由左半边唯一决定，所以把每个字符的一半次数拿出来，只对这"半个字符串"做全排列，再拼上中间字符和左半边的反转。为避免重复，回溯时按"不同字符 + 剩余次数"选择，而不是按位置交换，这样相同字符不会被当作不同元素重复排列。最坏情况下时间与输出规模成正比；O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Count characters: more than one odd count means no palindrome, so return an empty list; exactly one means that character must sit in the middle. The left half determines the whole palindrome, so take half of every count and permute only that half, then append the middle and the reversed half. To avoid duplicates, backtrack over distinct characters with remaining counts rather than swapping positions, so equal letters are never permuted against each other. In the worst case the time is proportional to the output size; the O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 相邻单词建图 + 拓扑排序
approaches.nameEn: Edges from adjacent words, then topological sort
approaches.ideaZh: 字典序只比较第一个不同的字符，所以只需要看相邻的两个单词：找到第一个不同位置的字符 x、y，得到一条约束 x 在 y 前面，之后的字符不提供任何信息。特殊情况：若前一个单词比后一个长且后者是它的前缀（如 "abc" 在 "ab" 前面），这个字典本身不合法，直接返回空串。所有出现过的字符都是图中的点，用 Kahn 算法做拓扑排序；若最终输出的字符数少于点数，说明有环，同样返回空串。其中 C 为所有单词的字符总数；字母表固定，图最多 26 个点、26×26 条边，所以空间是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Lexicographic order is decided by the first differing character, so only adjacent word pairs matter: the first mismatch x, y gives the edge x before y and nothing after it carries information. If an earlier word is longer and the later word is its prefix (like "abc" before "ab"), the input is invalid, so return an empty string. Every character that appears is a node; run Kahn's algorithm, and if fewer characters come out than exist, there is a cycle and the answer is also empty. Here C is the total number of characters; with a fixed alphabet the graph has at most 26 nodes and 26×26 edges, so space is O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 写指针 k 指向下一个保留元素该放的位置，读指针顺序扫描。遇到不等于 val 的元素就写到 nums[k]，k 加一；等于 val 的直接跳过。扫描结束后前 k 个就是保留的元素，而且保持了原来的相对顺序。这种写法每个元素最多被写一次，是最通用的"原地过滤"模板。
approaches.ideaEn: A write index k marks where the next kept element goes while a read index scans the array. Copy every element different from val to nums[k] and advance k; skip the rest. The first k slots then hold the kept elements in their original order. This is the general in-place filter template, writing each element at most once.

approaches.nameEn: Swap with the end (order not preserved)
approaches.ideaZh: 题目不要求保持顺序，所以遇到等于 val 的元素时，可以直接用当前有效区间的最后一个元素覆盖它，并把有效长度 n 减一；此时不移动 i，因为换过来的元素还没检查过。不等于 val 时 i 前进。当要删除的元素很少时，这种写法的赋值次数只和删除个数有关，比覆盖法少得多。
approaches.ideaEn: Order does not matter, so when nums[i] equals val, overwrite it with the last element of the active range and shrink that range by one; do not advance i, because the moved element is unchecked. Otherwise advance i. When few elements are removed, the number of writes is proportional to the removals rather than the array length.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀 DP + 哈希集合
approaches.nameEn: Prefix DP with a hash set
approaches.ideaZh: dp[i] 表示前 i 个字符最少剩下多少多余字符。转移有两类：把第 i 个字符当作多余，dp[i] = dp[i-1] + 1；或者某个字典词恰好以第 i 个字符结尾，即 s[j:i] 在字典中，dp[i] = dp[j]。这和"单词拆分"是同一个模型，只是把"能否拆分"的布尔值换成了"最少损失"的最小值。枚举所有 j 并做子串哈希，n 很小时完全够用。O(n^3) 来自对 O(n^2) 个子串做切片和哈希；D 为字典中所有单词的总长度。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[i] is the minimum number of leftover characters in the first i characters. Either character i is wasted, dp[i] = dp[i-1] + 1, or some dictionary word ends exactly at i, i.e. s[j:i] is in the set, giving dp[i] = dp[j]. This is the word-break model with boolean reachability replaced by minimum loss. Trying every j with substring hashing is plenty for the small n here. The O(n^3) comes from slicing and hashing O(n^2) substrings; D is the total length of the dictionary words.

approaches.ideaZh: 把字典建成字典树，改为从后往前定义 dp[i]：后缀 s[i:] 最少剩下多少多余字符。dp[i] 先取 dp[i+1] + 1（跳过 s[i]），然后从 s[i] 出发沿字典树往下走，每到一个单词结尾节点（对应 s[i..j]）就用 dp[j+1] 更新。走不下去就立刻停止，省掉了所有不可能匹配的子串。这样每个起点只需一次线性扫描，总复杂度 O(n^2)。
approaches.ideaEn: Build a trie of the dictionary and define dp[i] as the minimum leftovers in suffix s[i:]. Start with dp[i] = dp[i+1] + 1 (skip s[i]), then walk the trie from s[i]; whenever a word ends at s[j], update with dp[j+1]. The walk stops as soon as no trie edge exists, pruning every impossible substring. Each start costs one linear walk, so the total is O(n^2).

approaches.nameEn: Convert in groups of three digits
approaches.ideaZh: 英文读数以千为单位分组：Billion、Million、Thousand 和个位组，每组都是一个 0–999 的数，读法完全相同。写一个辅助函数把 0–999 转成单词列表：先处理百位（X Hundred），再处理 20 及以上的整十（Twenty…Ninety），最后处理 1–19（它们有独立的单词，不能拆）。主函数从高到低取出每组，非零组才输出"组读法 + 单位"，这样中间的零组（如 1,000,010）不会产生多余单词。0 要单独返回 "Zero"，用列表拼接再 join 可以自然避免多余空格。
approaches.ideaEn: English reads numbers in groups of thousands (Billion, Million, Thousand, units), and each group is a 0-999 number read the same way. A helper turns 0-999 into words: hundreds first ("X Hundred"), then tens from Twenty to Ninety, then 1-19, which have their own words and must not be split. The main loop takes groups from high to low and emits "group words + scale" only for nonzero groups, so zero groups like in 1,000,010 add nothing. Zero itself returns "Zero", and joining a word list avoids stray spaces.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组升序时，若把位置 i 作为"高引用论文"的起点，那么从 i 到末尾共有 n−i 篇论文，它们的引用数都不小于 citations[i]。条件 citations[i] ≥ n−i 关于 i 是单调的：左边不满足、右边满足（i 增大时左边变大、右边变小）。用二分找到第一个满足条件的 i，答案就是 n−i；若都不满足，i = n，答案为 0。
approaches.ideaEn: With citations sorted ascending, choosing index i as the start of the "highly cited" papers gives n-i papers, each with at least citations[i] citations. The predicate citations[i] >= n-i is monotone in i: false on the left, true on the right, since the left side grows and the right side shrinks. Binary-search the first index where it holds; the answer is n-i, or 0 when no index qualifies.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 1, 4, 9, … 这些不超过 n 的平方数看作物品，每个可以无限次使用，目标是凑出容量 n 且物品数最少，这正是完全背包的最小值版本。dp[i] 表示和为 i 所需的最少平方数个数，dp[0] = 0，dp[i] = min(dp[i − j²] + 1)，对所有 j² ≤ i 取最小。i 从小到大计算即可，每个 i 枚举 √i 个平方数。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat the squares 1, 4, 9, ... up to n as items usable any number of times, and minimize the item count to reach exactly n: an unbounded knapsack in its minimum form. dp[i] is the fewest squares summing to i, with dp[0] = 0 and dp[i] = min(dp[i - j*j] + 1) over j*j <= i. Fill i in increasing order, trying sqrt(i) squares each.

approaches.ideaZh: 拉格朗日四平方和定理保证答案不超过 4，于是只需逐个排除。先不断除以 4（n 和 4n 的答案相同）；勒让德三平方和定理说明，此时若 n ≡ 7 (mod 8)，答案恰为 4。否则若 n 是完全平方数，答案为 1；再枚举 i，检查 n − i² 是否为完全平方数，能找到则答案为 2；都不满足就是 3。这个解法把 DP 降到 O(√n)，适合作为数学视角的补充。
approaches.ideaEn: Lagrange's four-square theorem caps the answer at 4, so just rule out cases. Divide out factors of 4 first (n and 4n share the answer); by Legendre's three-square theorem, if the reduced n is 7 mod 8 the answer is exactly 4. Otherwise answer 1 if n is a perfect square, 2 if some n - i*i is a perfect square, and 3 otherwise. This drops the cost to O(sqrt n) and complements the DP with a number-theory view.

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举 haystack 中每个可能的起点 i（0 到 n−m），把从 i 开始长度为 m 的片段和 needle 比较，第一次相等就返回 i。最坏情况下每个起点都要比较接近 m 个字符，例如 "aaaa…ab" 里找 "aa…ab"。它的问题在于失配后完全丢弃了已经匹配过的信息，这正是 KMP 要改进的地方。O(1) 空间不计切片产生的临时子串。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every start i from 0 to n-m and compare the length-m window with needle, returning the first match. In the worst case, such as searching "aa...ab" in "aaaa...ab", each start compares nearly m characters. Its weakness is that a mismatch throws away everything already matched, which is exactly what KMP fixes. The O(1) space ignores the temporary slices.

approaches.ideaZh: 先对 needle 计算前缀函数 nxt[i]：needle[0..i] 最长的"相等真前缀与真后缀"长度。匹配时 j 表示已匹配的长度，遇到失配不回退 haystack 的指针，而是令 j = nxt[j−1]，即跳到"已匹配部分里仍然可用的最长前缀"，继续比较。当 j 达到 m 时找到匹配，起点是 i − m + 1。前缀函数本身也是用同样的跳转规则让 needle 和自己匹配算出来的，两段代码几乎一模一样。
approaches.ideaEn: First compute the prefix function of needle: nxt[i] is the length of the longest proper prefix of needle[0..i] that is also its suffix. While scanning haystack, j is the matched length; on a mismatch the haystack pointer never moves back, and j falls back to nxt[j-1], the longest prefix still consistent with what was matched. When j reaches m, the match starts at i - m + 1. The prefix function is built by matching needle against itself with the same rule, so both loops look almost identical.

approaches.ideaZh: 依次决定每个数字片段：从位置 i 开始截取 num[i:j] 作为下一个操作数，片段长度大于 1 且以 0 开头时不合法，直接停止加长。递归状态里保存当前表达式的值 val 和最后一项 last（带符号）。加号：val + x，last = x；减号：val − x，last = −x；乘号要尊重优先级，先撤销上一项再乘回去：val − last + last·x，last = last·x。第一个片段前不加运算符。走到末尾且 val 等于 target 时记录表达式。O(n) 是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Choose the next operand as num[i:j]; a multi-digit operand starting with 0 is invalid, so stop extending there. Carry the current value val and the signed last term last. Plus gives val + x with last = x; minus gives val - x with last = -x; times must respect precedence, so undo the last term and reapply it multiplied: val - last + last*x with last = last*x. The first operand gets no operator. Record the expression when the end is reached with val equal to target. The O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 用写指针 k 把所有非零元素按原顺序依次写到数组前部，这一步和"移除元素"完全相同，保证了非零元素的相对顺序（稳定）。扫描结束后，从 k 到末尾全部填 0。整个过程原地完成，只用常数额外空间；总写入次数是 n。
approaches.ideaEn: Use a write index k to copy every nonzero element to the front in order, exactly like "remove element", which keeps nonzeros stable. Then fill positions k through the end with zeros. Everything is in place with constant extra space, at the cost of n writes in total.

approaches.ideaZh: 同样维护 k 为下一个非零元素该放的位置，但遇到非零元素时把它与 nums[k] 交换，而不是覆盖。不变式：nums[0..k-1] 是按序排列的非零数，nums[k..i-1] 全是 0，所以交换只会把一个 0 换到后面。这样不需要第二遍补零；当零很少时，i 与 k 常常相等，交换是自换，实际写入更少。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep k as the slot for the next nonzero, but swap nums[i] with nums[k] instead of overwriting. Invariant: nums[0..k-1] are the nonzeros in order and nums[k..i-1] are all zeros, so each swap just moves a zero backward. No second pass is needed, and when zeros are rare i often equals k, making the swap a no-op.

approaches.nameZh: 利用 BST 性质自顶向下查找
approaches.ideaZh: 中序后继就是树中比 p.val 大的最小值。从根开始往下走：若当前节点值大于 p.val，它是一个候选后继，记录下来，然后去左子树找有没有更小的候选；否则当前节点及其左子树都不大于 p.val，只能去右子树。走到空节点时，最后记录的候选就是答案。这一种写法同时覆盖了两种情况——p 有右子树时答案是右子树最左节点，没有时答案是"最近一个从左边拐下来的祖先"，不需要分类讨论，也不需要父指针。
approaches.ideaEn: The inorder successor is the smallest value greater than p.val. Walk down from the root: if the current value is greater than p.val, it is a candidate, so record it and go left looking for a smaller one; otherwise the node and its left subtree are all too small, so go right. When the walk falls off the tree, the last candidate is the answer. This one loop covers both textbook cases (leftmost node of the right subtree, or the nearest ancestor reached from its left) without parent pointers or case splits.

approaches.ideaZh: 房间到"最近的门"的距离，等价于从所有门同时出发做一次 BFS 时第一次到达它的层数。所以先把所有门一起放进队列，作为第 0 层。每次弹出一个格子，把它四周仍是 INF 的空房间设为当前距离加一并入队；墙和已经写过距离的格子都跳过。BFS 按层推进，第一次写入的值一定是最短距离，之后不会再被改。这比从每个门各跑一遍 BFS 省掉了门数这一倍的重复工作。
approaches.ideaEn: The distance from a room to its nearest gate is the BFS layer at which it is first reached when all gates start together. Seed the queue with every gate as layer 0. Pop a cell and give each neighboring room still equal to INF the current distance plus one, then enqueue it; walls and already-filled cells are skipped. Because BFS expands layer by layer, the first value written is the shortest one and never changes. This avoids repeating a full search for every gate.

approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the value range
approaches.ideaZh: 不看下标，而是在值域 [1, n] 上二分。对候选值 mid，统计数组里不超过 mid 的元素个数 cnt。如果没有重复落在 [1, mid] 里，cnt 最多是 mid；一旦 cnt > mid，重复数一定在左半段，否则在右半段。每轮扫一遍数组，共 log n 轮，不修改数组、只用常数空间。它是一个很好的中间方案：先放弃 O(n)，换一个容易证明的做法。
approaches.ideaEn: Binary search over the values [1, n] instead of indices. For a candidate mid, count how many elements are at most mid. Without a duplicate inside [1, mid] that count is at most mid, so count > mid means the duplicate lies in the lower half, otherwise in the upper half. Each round scans the array once, giving log n rounds, read-only and constant space. It trades the linear bound for an argument that is easy to prove.

approaches.ideaZh: 把 i -> nums[i] 看成一条边：n + 1 个下标、值都在 [1, n]，从下标 0 出发一直走，必然进入一个环。重复的值意味着有两个下标指向同一个节点，这个节点正是环的入口。第一阶段让慢指针每次走一步、快指针走两步，直到相遇；第二阶段把一个指针放回起点，两者都每次走一步，再次相遇的位置就是入口。证明依赖于"起点到入口的距离"与"相遇点继续走到入口的距离"模环长相等。全程只读数组、常数空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat i -> nums[i] as an edge. With n + 1 indices and values in [1, n], walking from index 0 must eventually enter a cycle. A duplicated value means two indices point to the same node, and that node is exactly the cycle entrance. Phase one moves slow by one step and fast by two until they meet; phase two resets one pointer to the start and moves both by one step, and they meet at the entrance. This works because the distance from the start to the entrance equals, modulo the cycle length, the distance from the meeting point to the entrance.

approaches.ideaZh: 按顺序处理 pattern 的每个字符，同时记录 s 中已经匹配到的位置。如果这个字符已经绑定过某个子串，只需检查 s 在当前位置是否以它开头，然后直接跳过去。如果还没绑定，就枚举从当前位置开始的每个非空子串作为候选，但这个子串不能已被别的字符占用，这就是"反向映射"，保证是双射。递归失败时撤销绑定再试下一个。剪枝：剩余的 pattern 字符每个至少要吃掉一个字符，因此候选子串的结束位置有上限。其中 n = len(s)，m = len(pattern)，这是最坏情况。
approaches.ideaEn: Process pattern characters in order while tracking the current position in s. If the character is already bound to a substring, just check that s continues with it and jump past it. Otherwise try every nonempty substring starting here, skipping any substring already owned by another character; that reverse set keeps the mapping a bijection. Undo the binding when the recursion fails. Each remaining pattern character needs at least one letter, which caps how far a candidate can extend. Here n = len(s) and m = len(pattern); this is the worst case.

approaches.nameZh: 有序数组 + 二分插入
approaches.ideaZh: 最直接的想法是始终维护一个有序数组。插入时用二分找到位置再插进去，查询中位数时直接取中间一个或中间两个的平均。查找位置是 O(log n)，但数组插入要搬动元素，所以 addNum 实际是 O(n)。数据量不大时完全够用，也能帮你确认中位数的取法；它的瓶颈在于我们其实只关心中间两个数，却维护了整个顺序。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep every number in a sorted array. Insert with binary search for the position and read the middle one or two elements for the median. Locating the slot is O(log n), but shifting elements makes addNum O(n). It is fine for small streams and pins down the median rule; its weakness is maintaining a full order when only the middle matters.

approaches.nameEn: Two heaps for the two halves
approaches.ideaZh: 把数据分成较小的一半和较大的一半：小的一半放在大顶堆 lo，大的一半放在小顶堆 hi。要同时守住两条不变量：lo 的堆顶不超过 hi 的堆顶；lo 的大小等于 hi 或比它多一个。插入时先放进 lo，再把 lo 的最大值挪到 hi，这一步保证了顺序；如果 hi 因此比 lo 多，再把 hi 的最小值挪回来，这一步保证了大小。中位数要么是 lo 的堆顶，要么是两个堆顶的平均。
approaches.ideaEn: Split the stream into a lower half in a max-heap lo and an upper half in a min-heap hi. Keep two invariants: top(lo) <= top(hi), and lo has the same size as hi or one more. To add, push into lo, then move the largest of lo into hi, which restores order; if hi becomes larger, move its smallest back, which restores the sizes. The median is top(lo) or the average of both tops.

approaches.nameZh: 前序遍历 + 空节点占位
approaches.ideaZh: 只记录节点值是不够的，同样的值序列可以对应很多种形状；关键是把空孩子也写出来。用前序遍历：遇到节点写它的值，遇到空写一个 "#"，用逗号分隔。反序列化时按同样的前序顺序读取：读到 "#" 返回空，否则建节点，再依次递归构建左子树和右子树。因为每个空位置都有标记，读到的序列唯一确定一棵树，编码和解码互为逆过程。
approaches.ideaEn: Values alone do not fix the shape, so record empty children too. Serialize in preorder: write the value for a node and "#" for a missing child, separated by commas. Deserialize by reading tokens in the same preorder: "#" returns null, otherwise create a node and recursively build its left and then right subtree. With every empty slot marked, the token stream determines exactly one tree, so the two functions are inverses.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode(object):
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Codec:

    def serialize(self, root):
        """Encodes a tree to a single string.

        :type root: TreeNode
        :rtype: str
        """
        out = []

        def dfs(node):
            if not node:
                out.append('#')
                return
            out.append(str(node.val))
            dfs(node.left)
            dfs(node.right)

        dfs(root)
        return ','.join(out)

    def deserialize(self, data):
        """Decodes your encoded data to tree.

        :type data: str
        :rtype: TreeNode
        """
        tokens = iter(data.split(','))

        def build():
            v = next(tokens)
            if v == '#':
                return None
            node = TreeNode(int(v))
            node.left = build()
            node.right = build()
            return node

        return build()

# Your Codec object will be instantiated and called as such:
# ser = Codec()
# deser = Codec()
# ans = deser.deserialize(ser.serialize(root))

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口 + 最近位置表
approaches.ideaZh: 维护一个窗口 [left, i]，保证里面没有重复字符。用哈希表记下每个字符最近一次出现的下标。右端走到字符 c 时，如果 c 上次出现的位置还在窗口内（不小于 left），就把 left 直接跳到那个位置的下一格；否则不动。left 只会往右走，不会因为一个早已离开窗口的旧位置被拉回去。每一步用窗口长度更新答案，整个过程只扫一遍。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a window [left, i] with no repeated characters and a map from each character to its latest index. When the right end reaches c and c was last seen inside the window (index >= left), jump left to just after that index; otherwise leave it. left only moves right, so an old occurrence outside the window never pulls it back. Update the answer with the window length at every step; one pass suffices.

approaches.ideaZh: 设每个单词长 w、共 k 个，答案子串长度固定为 w·k。对每个可能的起点，把这一段按 w 切成 k 块，统计词频，与 words 的词频比较。实现很短，正确性一眼可见。缺点是相邻起点的工作完全没复用，每个起点都要重新切 k 个词，总代价约 O(n·k·w)。
approaches.ideaEn: Every answer has fixed length w·k, where w is the word length and k the word count. For each start, cut that span into k pieces of length w, count them, and compare with the counts of words. It is short and clearly correct, but neighboring starts share no work, so each start re-cuts k words, about O(n·k·w) in total.

approaches.ideaZh: 起点模 w 相同的位置，切出来的单词边界是对齐的，所以只需按偏移 r = 0..w-1 分成 w 组，每组以"整个单词"为单位滑动窗口。窗口里用哈希表维护单词的多重集合：右端读入一个词，如果它根本不在 words 里，窗口整体清空、左端跳到它后面；如果它出现次数超过需要，就从左端一个词一个词地弹出，直到不超。窗口里正好有 k 个词时记录左端，再弹出一个词继续。每组里每个词进出窗口各一次，总共处理约 n 个长度为 w 的词。
approaches.ideaEn: Starts with the same remainder modulo w share word boundaries, so split them into w groups by offset r and slide a window one whole word at a time. Keep a multiset of the words in the window. If the incoming word is not in words, clear the window and move left past it; if it now appears too often, drop words from the left until it does not. When the window holds exactly k words, record left and drop one word to keep sliding. Each word enters and leaves a window once, so about n words of length w are processed in total.
approaches.python:
class Solution:
    def findSubstring(self, s: str, words: List[str]) -> List[int]:
        w, k, n = len(words[0]), len(words), len(s)
        need = Counter(words)
        res = []
        for r in range(w):
            left, cnt, have = r, 0, Counter()
            for j in range(r, n - w + 1, w):
                word = s[j:j + w]
                if word not in need:
                    left, cnt = j + w, 0
                    have.clear()
                    continue
                have[word] += 1
                cnt += 1
                while have[word] > need[word]:
                    have[s[left:left + w]] -= 1
                    cnt -= 1
                    left += w
                if cnt == k:
                    res.append(left)
                    have[s[left:left + w]] -= 1
                    cnt -= 1
                    left += w
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: 令 dp[i] 表示以 nums[i] 结尾的最长严格递增子序列长度。它可以接在任何 j < i 且 nums[j] < nums[i] 的序列后面，所以 dp[i] = 1 + 这些 dp[j] 的最大值（没有就是 1）。答案是所有 dp[i] 的最大值。状态定义"以 i 结尾"是关键，它让转移只依赖前面的位置。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence ending at nums[i]. It can extend any j < i with nums[j] < nums[i], so dp[i] is one plus the best such dp[j], or 1 if none exists. The answer is the maximum over all dp[i]. Defining the state as "ends at i" is what makes each transition look only backward.

approaches.ideaZh: 换一个状态：tails[L] 表示所有长度为 L+1 的递增子序列里，最小可能的结尾值。结尾越小，后面越容易接上，所以只保留最小结尾不会丢掉最优解。tails 一定严格递增，于是对每个新数 x，二分找到第一个 >= x 的位置：找不到说明 x 能把最长序列再延长一位，追加到末尾；找到了就用 x 替换它，让该长度的结尾变得更小。最后 tails 的长度就是答案，注意 tails 本身不一定是一个真实的子序列。
approaches.ideaEn: Change the state: tails[L] is the smallest possible last value among increasing subsequences of length L + 1. A smaller tail is never worse for future extensions, so keeping only the minimum loses nothing. tails is strictly increasing, so for each x binary-search the first entry >= x: if none exists, x extends the longest sequence and is appended; otherwise it replaces that entry, lowering the tail for that length. The length of tails is the answer, even though tails itself need not be an actual subsequence.

approaches.ideaZh: 第 d 层是从原串恰好删掉 d 个括号能得到的所有字符串，用集合存储自动去重。从第 0 层（原串本身）开始，每层先检查有没有合法串，有就把这一层所有合法串作为答案返回，因为 BFS 保证这是最少删除数。否则对层里每个串尝试删掉每一个括号，生成下一层。空串一定合法，所以循环必然结束。思路最直观，但层数多时状态会膨胀。两项都是最坏情况的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Layer d holds every string obtained by deleting exactly d parentheses, stored in a set to drop duplicates. Starting from layer 0 (the input), check each layer for valid strings and return all of them as soon as any exist, since BFS guarantees the minimum number of deletions. Otherwise delete each parenthesis from each string to build the next layer. The empty string is valid, so the loop always ends. It is the most direct idea but layers can grow quickly. Both bounds are worst case.

approaches.ideaZh: 先扫一遍算出最少必须删掉多少个左括号 l 和右括号 r：遇到 ")" 时如果前面没有未配对的 "("，它就必须删。然后从左到右回溯，每个括号有"删"或"留"两种选择：只有对应的删除额度还有剩余时才能删；留下右括号时要求当前未配对的左括号数 bal > 0，否则立刻剪枝。走到末尾时额度恰好用完且 bal 为 0，就得到一个答案。由于删除总数被固定为最小值，搜索空间比 BFS 小得多，用集合去掉重复结果即可。O(2^n) 是最坏情况，实际大部分分支会被剪掉；O(n) 空间是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: First scan once to get the minimum number of "(" and ")" that must go: a ")" with no unmatched "(" before it has to be deleted. Then backtrack left to right; each parenthesis is either deleted, allowed only while that type still has budget, or kept, and keeping ")" requires an open balance above zero, otherwise prune. Reaching the end with both budgets and the balance at zero yields an answer. Because the number of deletions is fixed at the minimum, the search is far smaller than BFS; a set removes duplicates. O(2^n) is the worst case, and pruning removes most branches; the O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 每天结束时只可能处于三种状态之一：hold 持有股票；sold 今天刚卖出；rest 不持股且今天没卖（可以自由买入）。转移是：hold 来自昨天的 hold，或昨天的 rest 今天买入；sold 只能来自昨天的 hold 今天卖出；rest 来自昨天的 rest 或昨天的 sold。冷冻期就体现在：买入只能从 rest 转移，而不能从 sold 直接转移，所以昨天卖出的人今天必须先进入 rest。三个变量滚动更新，最后答案是 sold 和 rest 中的较大者。
approaches.ideaEn: Each day ends in one of three states: hold (owning a share), sold (sold today), or rest (no share and did not sell today, so free to buy). hold comes from yesterday's hold or from yesterday's rest plus a purchase; sold only comes from yesterday's hold plus a sale; rest comes from yesterday's rest or sold. The cooldown is encoded by letting purchases start only from rest, never directly from sold. Roll three variables forward and return the larger of sold and rest.

approaches.nameEn: Peel leaves to find the centers
approaches.ideaZh: 以某点为根的树高，等于它到最远点的距离，而使这个距离最小的点就是树的"中心"，中心最多两个。把所有度为 1 的叶子同时删掉，剩下的树中心不变、直径减少 2。于是一层一层地剥叶子，维护每个点的剩余度数，度数降到 1 的点进入下一层。剩余点数不超过 2 时，最后这一层就是答案。相比从每个点出发各算一次高度的 O(n^2)，这里每条边只处理一次。
approaches.ideaEn: The height when rooted at v equals the distance from v to its farthest node, and the vertices minimizing it are the tree centers, of which there are at most two. Removing all leaves at once keeps the centers and shortens the diameter by two. So peel leaves layer by layer, tracking remaining degrees and queuing nodes whose degree drops to one. When at most two nodes remain, the last layer is the answer. Unlike computing a height from every node, which is O(n^2), each edge is handled once.

approaches.nameZh: 区间 DP：枚举最后戳破的气球
approaches.nameEn: Interval DP on the last balloon
approaches.ideaZh: 在两端各补一个值为 1 的虚拟气球，记为数组 a。如果按"先戳哪个"来想，戳完之后左右邻居会变化，子问题互相牵连。反过来想：在开区间 (i, j) 里，枚举最后一个被戳破的气球 k，那时它的邻居一定恰好是 a[i] 和 a[j]，得分 a[i]·a[k]·a[j]；而 k 把区间切成 (i, k) 和 (k, j) 两段，它们在 k 被戳之前互不影响。于是 dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + a[i]·a[k]·a[j])，按区间长度从小到大计算，答案是 dp[0][n+1]。
approaches.ideaEn: Pad both ends with a virtual balloon of value 1 to get array a. Thinking about which balloon to burst first makes neighbors shift and couples the subproblems. Reverse it: inside the open interval (i, j), choose the balloon k burst last; at that moment its neighbors are exactly a[i] and a[j], scoring a[i]·a[k]·a[j], and k splits the rest into (i, k) and (k, j), which no longer interact. So dp[i][j] = max over k of dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + a[i]·a[k]·a[j], filled by increasing length; the answer is dp[0][n+1].

approaches.ideaZh: 给根的列号设为 0，左孩子列号减一、右孩子加一。题目要求同一列内从上到下、同一行内从左到右，这正是层序遍历的访问顺序，所以用 BFS 依次弹出节点，把值追加到对应列的列表里，顺序天然正确。如果改用 DFS，同一列里更深的节点可能先被访问，就还得额外按行号排序。最后从最小列号到最大列号依次输出，列号是连续的，不需要排序。
approaches.ideaEn: Give the root column 0, a left child column - 1 and a right child column + 1. The required order, top to bottom and then left to right within a row, is exactly BFS visiting order, so appending each popped value to its column's list yields the right sequence. A DFS could visit a deeper node first and would need an extra sort by row. Columns form a contiguous range, so output them from the minimum to the maximum without sorting.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右构造答案，栈里保存当前结果，每个字母最多出现一次。遇到已经在栈里的字母直接跳过。否则，只要栈顶字母比当前字母大，而且它在后面还会再出现，就把它弹出，留到后面再放，这样能让更小的字母靠前；如果栈顶在后面再也不出现，就必须保留。为了 O(1) 判断"后面还会出现"，预先记录每个字母最后一次出现的下标；再用一个布尔数组记录哪些字母在栈中。
approaches.ideaEn: Build the answer left to right in a stack that holds each letter at most once. Skip a letter already in the stack. Otherwise, while the top is larger than the current letter and appears again later, pop it so the smaller letter moves earlier; a top that never appears again must stay. Precompute each letter's last index to answer "appears later" in O(1), and keep a membership array for the stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个字符只有两种命运：被缩写进数字，或者原样保留，所以共有 2^n 种结果。回溯时额外带一个计数 cnt，表示紧挨着当前位置、还没写出去的连续缩写长度。选择缩写时只把 cnt 加一，不急着写数字；选择保留时，先把非零的 cnt 写成数字，再写这个字符，并把 cnt 清零。走到末尾时同样把剩下的 cnt 补上。这样相邻的缩写一定被合并成一个数字，不会出现 "11" 这类非法形式。O(n) 是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Each character is either folded into a number or kept, giving 2^n results. Carry a counter cnt of consecutive abbreviated characters not yet written. Abbreviating only increments cnt; keeping first flushes a nonzero cnt as digits, then appends the character and resets cnt. At the end, flush the remaining cnt as well. This merges adjacent abbreviations into one number, so forms like "11" never appear. The O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.nameEn: Unbounded knapsack for the fewest coins
approaches.ideaZh: dp[x] 表示凑出金额 x 所需的最少硬币数，dp[0] = 0。每种硬币可以无限使用，所以对每枚硬币 c，从小到大枚举金额 x，用 dp[x - c] + 1 更新 dp[x]；正序遍历恰好允许同一枚硬币被重复选用。凑不出的金额用一个"不可能达到"的值表示，这里取 amount + 1，因为任何可行方案最多用 amount 枚面值为 1 的硬币。最后若 dp[amount] 仍是这个值就返回 -1；amount 为 0 时答案自然是 0。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[x] is the fewest coins summing to x, with dp[0] = 0. Coins are unlimited, so for each coin c iterate x upward and relax dp[x] with dp[x - c] + 1; the forward order is what allows reusing the same coin. Mark unreachable amounts with amount + 1, which exceeds any real answer since a valid combination uses at most amount coins. Return -1 if dp[amount] still holds that value; amount 0 naturally gives 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 一开始每个点自成一个连通分量，计数为 n，这样孤立点会被自然算进去。依次处理每条边，找到两端点所在集合的代表元；如果不同，就把两个集合合并，并把计数减一；如果相同，说明这条边落在已有分量内部，不影响计数。查找时做路径压缩，让后续查询接近常数时间。处理完所有边，计数就是连通分量数。
approaches.ideaEn: Start with every node as its own component, so the count is n and isolated nodes are included automatically. For each edge, find the representatives of both endpoints; if they differ, merge the sets and decrement the count, otherwise the edge lies inside an existing component. Path compression keeps later finds nearly constant time. After all edges, the count is the number of components.

approaches.ideaZh: 排序后把数组分成较小的前半段和较大的后半段（前半段多放一个），偶数位依次放前半段、奇数位依次放后半段，这样每个奇数位都比两边大。但如果正序穿插，中位数附近的相等元素可能在相邻位置撞上，例如 [4,5,5,6]。把两半都倒过来再穿插，相等的中间值会被分别推到序列的两端，彼此隔开。题目保证有解，这种放法在有解时一定合法。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort, split into a smaller first half (one extra element when n is odd) and a larger second half, put the first half on even indices and the second on odd indices, so each odd slot beats its neighbors. Interleaving in ascending order can place equal middle values side by side, as in [4,5,5,6]. Reversing both halves first pushes equal middle values toward opposite ends so they never touch. When an answer exists, this placement is always valid.
approaches.python:
class Solution:
    def wiggleSort(self, nums: List[int]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify nums in-place instead.
        """
        s = sorted(nums)
        half = (len(nums) + 1) // 2
        nums[::2], nums[1::2] = s[:half][::-1], s[half:][::-1]

approaches.nameZh: 中位数划分 + 虚拟下标
approaches.ideaZh: 其实不需要完整排序，只需知道中位数 med，然后把元素分成大于、等于、小于 med 三类：大于的放奇数位，小于的放偶数位，等于的填在中间。用快速选择在期望 O(n) 时间找到 med。再定义虚拟下标 A(i) = nums[(1 + 2i) % (n | 1)]，它先依次访问 1, 3, 5, … 再访问 0, 2, 4, …；在这个虚拟顺序上做一次荷兰国旗三路划分，把大于 med 的放前面、小于的放后面，就同时完成了"大数进奇数位、小数进偶数位、相等的分散到两端"。C++ 中 nth_element 加原地划分只需常数额外空间。Python 的快速选择会复制列表，需要 O(n) 空间。
approaches.ideaEn: A full sort is unnecessary: knowing the median med, send larger values to odd slots, smaller ones to even slots, and let equal values fill the gaps. Quickselect finds med in expected O(n). Define a virtual index A(i) = nums[(1 + 2i) % (n | 1)], which visits 1, 3, 5, … and then 0, 2, 4, …. A three-way Dutch-flag partition in that virtual order, larger first and smaller last, places big values on odd slots, small ones on even slots, and spreads equal values to both ends. In C++, nth_element plus the in-place partition needs only constant extra space. The Python quickselect copies lists, so it needs O(n) space.

approaches.nameEn: Split into odd and even chains in place
approaches.ideaZh: 用 odd 和 even 两个指针分别串起奇数位和偶数位节点，并提前记住偶数链的头 evenHead。每轮让 odd 跳过一个节点接到 even 的下一个，再让 even 接到新 odd 的下一个，两个指针交替前进。循环条件是 even 和 even.next 都存在，此时 odd 停在奇数链的最后一个节点。最后把 odd.next 指向 evenHead 拼起来；偶数链的尾巴在循环中已被设为 None（或本来就是 None），不会形成环。
approaches.ideaEn: Thread odd-position nodes with an odd pointer and even-position nodes with an even pointer, remembering evenHead. Each round links odd to the node after even, then even to the node after the new odd, so the pointers leapfrog. Loop while even and even.next exist; odd then rests on the last odd node. Finally attach evenHead after odd. The even chain's tail was already set to None during the loop, so no cycle forms.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def oddEvenList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head:
            return head
        odd, even = head, head.next
        even_head = even
        while even and even.next:
            odd.next = even.next
            odd = odd.next
            even.next = odd.next
            even = even.next
        odd.next = even_head
        return head

approaches.ideaZh: 只能走到严格更大的相邻格子，所以路径不可能绕回原处，格子之间的依赖关系是一个有向无环图。令 f(i, j) 为从 (i, j) 出发的最长递增路径长度，它等于 1 加上所有更大邻居的 f 的最大值。每个格子的 f 只算一次并缓存，之后直接复用，于是从每个格子都"出发"一次也只需要总共 O(mn) 的工作。答案是所有 f 的最大值。注意递归深度可能达到 mn，Python 需要足够大的递归上限。
approaches.ideaEn: Moves go only to strictly larger neighbors, so no path can loop back and the cells form a DAG. Let f(i, j) be the longest increasing path starting at (i, j): one plus the best f among larger neighbors. Each f is computed once and cached, so starting from every cell costs O(mn) overall. The answer is the maximum f. Recursion depth can reach mn, so Python needs a high recursion limit.

approaches.ideaZh: 同样把"走向更大的邻居"看成有向边。先统计每个格子的出度（有多少个更大的邻居），出度为 0 的格子是局部最高点，作为第一层。每剥掉一层，就把这些格子的更小邻居出度减一，减到 0 的进入下一层。最长路径上的每个格子恰好属于不同的层，所以总层数就是答案。这个做法完全迭代，不用担心递归深度。
approaches.ideaEn: Again treat each move to a larger neighbor as a directed edge. Count each cell's out-degree (its larger neighbors); cells with out-degree zero are local peaks and form the first layer. Peeling a layer decrements the out-degree of each smaller neighbor, and those reaching zero form the next layer. Every cell on a longest path lands in a different layer, so the number of layers is the answer. It is fully iterative, so recursion depth is not a concern.

approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the sorted half
approaches.ideaZh: 旋转数组从任意 mid 切开，左右两半至少有一半是完全有序的。若 nums[lo] <= nums[mid]，左半 [lo, mid] 有序，此时只需看 target 是否落在 [nums[lo], nums[mid]) 之间，是就去左边，否则去右边；反之右半 (mid, hi] 有序，用 (nums[mid], nums[hi]] 判断。有序的那一半可以用两端值精确判断包含关系，另一半则交给下一轮。不变量是：如果 target 存在，它一定在 [lo, hi] 中；每轮区间减半。
approaches.ideaEn: Cut a rotated array at any mid and at least one half is fully sorted. If nums[lo] <= nums[mid], the left half [lo, mid] is sorted: go left when target lies in [nums[lo], nums[mid]), otherwise go right; else the right half (mid, hi] is sorted and the test uses (nums[mid], nums[hi]]. The sorted half can be tested exactly by its endpoints, and the other half is left to the next round. Invariant: if target exists it stays inside [lo, hi], which halves every round.

approaches.nameZh: 维护最小的一元和二元候选
approaches.nameEn: Track the smallest one- and two-element candidates
approaches.ideaZh: 扫描时维护两个值：first 是目前见过的最小值，second 是"某个递增二元组里第二个数"的最小可能值。对每个 x：若 x <= first，更新 first；否则若 x <= second，说明 x 能接在某个更小的数后面，更新 second；否则 x 比 second 还大，三元组成立。first 被更新到 second 之后的位置并不影响正确性，因为 second 的存在已经证明它前面有一个比它小的数。全程一遍扫描、两个变量。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan while keeping first, the smallest value seen, and second, the smallest possible end of an increasing pair. For each x: if x <= first, lower first; else if x <= second, x follows some smaller value, so lower second; otherwise x exceeds second and a triplet exists. first may move past second's position without harm, because second already certifies a smaller value before it. One pass, two variables.

approaches.ideaZh: 枚举所有有序对 (i, j)，i ≠ j，把 words[i] + words[j] 拼起来判断是不是回文。正确性显然，但单词数 n 较大时，n^2 次拼接和检查太慢。它提醒我们：真正需要的是给每个单词快速找到能与它配对的"补全串"。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every ordered pair (i, j) with i != j and test whether words[i] + words[j] is a palindrome. Correct but too slow for many words, since it does n^2 concatenations and checks. It shows what we actually need: a fast way to find the complement of each word.

approaches.nameZh: 切分点 + 反转哈希表
approaches.nameEn: Split points with a reversed-word map
approaches.ideaZh: 先把每个单词反转后存进哈希表，值是原下标。对单词 w 的每个切分点 j（0 到 len(w)），得到前缀 pre 和后缀 suf。如果 pre 是回文，而 suf 的反转是某个单词 u，那么 u + w = rev(suf) + pre + suf 是回文，记 [u, w]；如果 suf 是回文，而 pre 的反转是某个单词 v，那么 w + v 是回文，记 [w, v]。第二种情况跳过 j = len(w)，否则整词互为反转的两词会被各算两次；空串也正好被这两种情况覆盖：它和任意回文单词都能双向配对。每个单词做 k+1 次切分、每次 O(k) 的回文判断和哈希查找。
approaches.ideaEn: Store every word reversed in a hash map pointing to its index.
