For each split j (0 to len(w)) of word w into pre and suf: if pre is a palindrome and suf reversed is some word u, then u + w = rev(suf) + pre + suf is a palindrome, so record [u, w]; if suf is a palindrome and pre reversed is some word v, then w + v is a palindrome, so record [w, v]. Skip the second case at j = len(w), otherwise two mutually reversed words are each counted twice. The empty string is covered too, pairing both ways with every palindromic word. Each word has k + 1 splits, each costing O(k) for the palindrome test and lookup.

approaches.nameZh: 树形 DP：返回偷与不偷两个值
approaches.ideaZh: 对每个节点，后序遍历返回一对值：偷这个节点时子树的最大收益，以及不偷它时的最大收益。偷当前节点，两个孩子都不能偷，所以是 node.val + 左孩子"不偷" + 右孩子"不偷"；不偷当前节点，孩子偷不偷各自取最优，所以是 max(左) + max(右)。空节点返回 (0, 0)。根节点两值取大即是答案。相比"偷根就去看孙子"的朴素递归，每个节点只计算一次，避免了重复子问题。
approaches.ideaEn: In postorder, return a pair for each node: the best total if this node is robbed and the best if it is not. Robbing it forbids both children, giving node.val plus each child's "skip" value; skipping it lets each child choose its own better option, giving max(left) + max(right). A null node returns (0, 0), and the answer is the larger value at the root. Unlike the naive recursion that jumps to grandchildren, each node is evaluated exactly once.

approaches.ideaZh: 对 0 到 n 的每个数单独数 1 的个数。用 x &= x - 1 每次清掉最低位的 1，循环次数正好等于 1 的个数。每个数最多 log n 次，总体 O(n log n)。它没有利用相邻数之间的关系，是下面递推做法的对照。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Count bits for each number from 0 to n independently. x &= x - 1 clears the lowest set bit, so the loop runs once per set bit, at most log n times per number, O(n log n) overall. It ignores how numbers relate to each other, which the recurrence below exploits. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output array.

approaches.ideaZh: i 右移一位得到 i >> 1，它比 i 小，答案已经算好；两者的二进制只差被移掉的最低位。所以 bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1)，从 1 递推到 n 即可。每个数 O(1)，也不依赖任何内建的 popcount。同样可以用 bits[i] = bits[i & (i - 1)] + 1，思路都是复用更小数的结果。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Shifting i right gives i >> 1, a smaller number whose answer is already known, and the two differ only in the dropped lowest bit. So bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1), filled from 1 to n. Each step is O(1) with no built-in popcount. bits[i] = bits[i & (i - 1)] + 1 works the same way, reusing a smaller result. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output array.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组有序，所以等于 target 的元素一定连成一段。写一个"下界"二分：返回第一个 >= x 的位置。lower(target) 就是这段的起点；如果越界或者那里的值不等于 target，说明不存在，返回 [-1, -1]。终点是 lower(target + 1) - 1，也就是第一个比 target 大的位置往前退一格。两次二分共用同一个函数，边界只需要想清楚一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Because the array is sorted, all copies of target form one contiguous block. Write a single lower-bound search that returns the first index whose value is >= x. lower(target) is the start of the block; if it is out of range or holds a different value, return [-1, -1]. The end is lower(target + 1) - 1. Reusing one helper means the boundary logic is reasoned about only once.

approaches.ideaZh: 用左右两个指针维护一个窗口，并用哈希表记录窗口里每个字符出现的次数。右指针每次纳入一个字符；一旦表里的不同字符数超过 k，就不断右移左指针、减少计数，计数归零就把该字符从表里删掉，直到窗口重新合法。每次合法时用窗口长度更新答案。每个字符最多进出窗口各一次，所以是线性的。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep a window [left, right] and a hash map of character counts inside it. Extend right one character at a time; whenever the map holds more than k distinct keys, advance left, decrementing counts and deleting keys that hit zero, until the window is valid again. Record the window length after each step. Every character enters and leaves the window at most once, so the scan is linear.

approaches.ideaZh: dp[i] 表示把 i 拆成至少两个正整数后能得到的最大乘积。枚举拆出的第一段 j（1 <= j < i），剩下的 i - j 有两种选择：不再拆，乘积是 j * (i - j)；继续拆，乘积是 j * dp[i - j]。两者取大，再对所有 j 取最大值。这个做法不需要任何数学直觉，适合面试时先稳稳拿下。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the best product when i is split into at least two positive parts. Fix the first part j (1 <= j < i); the rest i - j is either kept whole, giving j * (i - j), or split further, giving j * dp[i - j]. Take the larger and maximize over all j. It needs no number-theory insight, which makes it a safe first answer in an interview.

approaches.nameEn: Math: take as many 3s as possible
approaches.ideaZh: 观察最优拆法里会出现哪些因子：因子 1 只会浪费；任何 f >= 5 都可以拆成 2 和 f - 2，而 2(f - 2) > f，所以最优解里只剩 2、3（4 等价于 2 + 2）。又因为 3 * 3 > 2 * 2 * 2，2 最多出现两次。于是 n <= 3 时必须拆，答案是 n - 1；否则不断拆出 3，直到剩下 2、3 或 4 为止，剩下的数直接乘上去（剩 4 正好对应两个 2）。
approaches.ideaEn: Look at which factors can appear in an optimal split. A factor 1 is wasted, and any f >= 5 can be replaced by 2 and f - 2 since 2(f - 2) > f, so only 2s and 3s remain (4 equals 2 + 2). Since 3 * 3 > 2 * 2 * 2, there are at most two 2s. So for n <= 3 the forced split gives n - 1; otherwise peel off 3s while more than 4 remains and multiply by the leftover 2, 3 or 4 (a leftover 4 is exactly two 2s).

approaches.ideaZh: 一个指针从头、一个从尾向中间走，每一步交换两端的字符，然后同时向内收缩一格。两指针相遇或交错时，所有对称位置都已交换完毕。只用常数个变量，满足原地修改的要求。
approaches.ideaEn: Start one pointer at each end, swap the two characters, then move both pointers inward. When they meet or cross, every mirrored pair has been swapped. Only a couple of variables are used, so the reversal is in place.

approaches.ideaZh: 和反转整个字符串一样用首尾两个指针，只是只交换元音。左指针遇到非元音就右移，右指针遇到非元音就左移；两边都停在元音上时交换，然后一起向内走。注意大小写元音都要算，用一个包含 aeiouAEIOU 的集合判断即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Use the same two-pointer sweep as a full reversal, but only swap vowels. Move the left pointer past non-vowels, move the right pointer past non-vowels, and when both rest on vowels swap them and step inward. Both cases count, so test membership against the set aeiouAEIOU.

approaches.ideaZh: 要找的位置恰好是"第一个 >= target 的下标"：target 存在时就是它的位置，不存在时就是它该插入的位置。维护左闭右开区间 [lo, hi)，中点值小于 target 就说明答案在右边，否则答案在 mid 或其左边。循环结束时 lo == hi，就是答案；全部元素都小于 target 时返回 n，也自然成立。
approaches.ideaEn: The answer is exactly the first index whose value is >= target: its position if present, its insertion point otherwise. Keep a half-open range [lo, hi); if nums[mid] < target the answer lies to the right, otherwise it is mid or further left. When lo == hi the loop ends at the answer, and if every element is smaller it correctly returns n.

approaches.ideaZh: 交集里每个数出现的次数等于它在两个数组中出现次数的较小值。先对较短的数组做计数，再遍历另一个数组：当前数的剩余计数大于 0 就放进结果并减一。对短数组计数能让额外空间只和较短的数组相关。
approaches.ideaEn: Each value appears in the intersection min(count1, count2) times. Count the shorter array, then walk the other one: whenever the current value still has a positive count, append it and decrement. Counting the shorter side keeps the extra space proportional to the smaller input.

approaches.nameEn: Sort and merge with two pointers
approaches.ideaZh: 如果两个数组已经有序（进阶问题之一），可以像归并一样同时扫描：较小的一边前进，相等时记录答案并让两边同时前进。重复元素会被自然地按次数配对。排序后除了结果之外只需要常数空间，适合内存紧张或数据已经排好序的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: If both arrays are sorted (one of the follow-ups), scan them together like a merge: advance the side with the smaller value, and on a tie record the value and advance both. Duplicates pair up by count automatically. Apart from the output and the sort, only constant extra space is needed, which suits memory-tight or pre-sorted inputs.
approaches.time: O(m log m + n log n)

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + O(n²) 动态规划
approaches.ideaZh: 按宽度排序后，能套进第 i 个信封的只可能排在它前面，问题就变成"二维严格递增的最长链"。dp[i] 表示以第 i 个信封为最外层时最多能套几层，枚举所有更早的 j，若宽高都严格更小就用 dp[j] + 1 更新。它把问题清楚地化归为最长递增子序列，但 n 达到 1e5 时平方复杂度会超时，下一个方法专门解决这一点。
approaches.ideaEn: After sorting by width, any envelope that fits inside envelope i comes before it, so the task becomes the longest chain that is strictly increasing in both dimensions. dp[i] is the longest chain ending at envelope i; for every earlier j with smaller width and height, try dp[j] + 1. This makes the reduction to longest increasing subsequence explicit, but the quadratic time is too slow for n up to 1e5, which the next approach fixes.

approaches.nameZh: 宽升高降排序 + 二分 LIS
approaches.nameEn: Width ascending, height descending, then binary-search LIS
approaches.ideaZh: 关键技巧在排序：宽度升序，宽度相同时高度降序。这样同宽的信封在高度序列里是递减的，不可能被同时选进严格递增子序列，于是只需要对高度求一维的最长严格递增子序列。求 LIS 用"耐心排序"：tails[len] 记录长度为 len + 1 的递增子序列可能的最小结尾，对每个高度二分找第一个 >= 它的位置并替换，找不到就追加。tails 的长度就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: The trick is the sort order: width ascending, and for equal widths height descending. Equal-width envelopes then appear in decreasing height order, so they can never both join a strictly increasing subsequence, and the problem collapses to a 1D LIS on heights. Compute it with patience sorting: tails[i] is the smallest possible tail of an increasing run of length i + 1; for each height, binary-search the first tail >= it and replace it, or append if none exists. The final length of tails is the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 时间戳按非递减顺序到来，所以用一个先进先出的队列按顺序存下每次敲击的时间。查询 getHits(t) 时，把队头所有 <= t - 300 的时间戳弹出，它们已经不在最近 300 秒里，而且以后也不会再回来；剩下的队列长度就是答案。每个时间戳只进出队列一次，均摊下来每次操作都是 O(1)，缺点是同一秒大量敲击时队列会很长。
approaches.ideaEn: Timestamps arrive in non-decreasing order, so push every hit onto a FIFO queue. For getHits(t), pop every timestamp <= t - 300 from the front: it is outside the last 300 seconds and will never be relevant again. The remaining queue length is the answer. Each timestamp is pushed and popped once, so operations are amortized O(1); the downside is that a burst of hits in one second makes the queue long.
approaches.space: O(number of hits in the window)

approaches.ideaZh: 进阶问题担心每秒敲击次数巨大，那就按秒聚合。开两个长度 300 的数组，桶 i = t % 300 记录"最近写入它的时间戳"和"该秒的敲击次数"。敲击时如果桶里的时间戳不是当前秒，说明是 300 秒前的旧数据，直接覆盖并清零再加一。查询时只累加时间戳仍在 (t - 300, t] 内的桶。空间固定为 300，与敲击总数无关。
approaches.ideaEn: The follow-up worries about huge numbers of hits per second, so aggregate by second. Keep two arrays of size 300; bucket t % 300 stores the timestamp last written there and that second's hit count. On a hit, if the bucket holds a different timestamp it is data from 300+ seconds ago, so reset it before incrementing. A query sums the buckets whose timestamp still lies in (t - 300, t]. Memory is fixed at 300 slots regardless of how many hits occur.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 动态规划回溯路径
approaches.nameEn: Sort, DP, and reconstruct via parent links
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序。对于有序的整除链 a1 | a2 | ... | ak，只要相邻两项满足整除，整条链两两之间都能整除，这和最长递增子序列的结构一样。dp[i] 表示以 nums[i] 结尾的最长整除链长度，枚举 j < i，若 nums[i] % nums[j] == 0 就尝试 dp[j] + 1，同时用 prev[i] 记下转移来源。最后从 dp 最大的位置沿 prev 往回走，反转后就是一个最大子集。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort first. In a sorted chain a1 | a2 | ... | ak, divisibility between neighbors implies divisibility between every pair, so the structure mirrors longest increasing subsequence. dp[i] is the longest chain ending at nums[i]; for each j < i with nums[i] % nums[j] == 0, try dp[j] + 1 and remember the predecessor in prev[i]. Walk back from the index with the largest dp through prev and reverse to obtain one largest subset.

approaches.ideaZh: 先扫描一遍棋盘，记下所有空格，并用三组 9 位掩码分别表示每行、每列、每个 3x3 宫已经用过哪些数字。按顺序给空格填数：当前格可用的数字是三组掩码并集取反后的低 9 位，逐个取最低位的 1 尝试，填入后更新掩码并递归下一个空格；走不通就撤销（异或回去）换下一个数字。填完最后一个空格时题目保证的唯一解就已写在 board 里。位运算让"能填什么"的判断变成 O(1)。其中 m 为空格数；这是最坏上界，实际剪枝后快得多。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan the board once, list the empty cells, and keep three groups of 9-bit masks recording which digits each row, column and 3x3 box already uses. Fill the empty cells in order: the candidates for a cell are the low 9 bits of the complement of the three masks combined; try them one lowest bit at a time, update the masks, and recurse to the next cell, undoing with XOR on failure. When the last cell is filled, the guaranteed unique solution is already in the board. Bit tricks make the "what can go here" check O(1). Here m is the number of empty cells; this is a worst-case bound, and pruning makes it far faster in practice.

approaches.ideaZh: 逐个更新区间需要 O(length) 次加法，k 次就是 O(k * length)。改用差分数组：给区间 [l, r] 整体加 inc，只需 diff[l] += inc、diff[r + 1] -= inc，含义是"从 l 开始多了 inc，从 r + 1 开始又减回去"。所有更新处理完后，对 diff 做一次前缀和，第 i 项就是位置 i 的最终值。数组多开一格可以省去 r + 1 越界的判断。
approaches.ideaEn: Applying each update cell by cell costs O(length) per update. With a difference array, adding inc to [l, r] is just diff[l] += inc and diff[r + 1] -= inc: the value rises by inc from l and drops back from r + 1. After all updates, one prefix-sum pass over diff yields the final value at each index. Allocating one extra slot removes the bounds check for r + 1.

approaches.nameZh: 异或求和 + 与运算求进位
approaches.nameEn: XOR for the sum, AND for the carry
approaches.ideaZh: 二进制加法拆成两部分：a ^ b 是不考虑进位的逐位和，(a & b) << 1 是每一位产生的进位。把这两者再相加，就回到同样的问题，于是循环直到进位为 0。进位每轮至少左移一位，32 位整数最多循环 32 次。C++ 里左移负数是未定义行为，所以先转成 unsigned 再移；Python 的整数没有位宽，需要用 0xFFFFFFFF 掩码模拟 32 位补码，最后把超过 0x7FFFFFFF 的结果还原成负数。
approaches.ideaEn: Binary addition splits in two: a ^ b is the bitwise sum without carries, and (a & b) << 1 is the carry out of every bit. Adding those two is the same problem again, so loop until the carry is 0; the carry moves left each round, so at most 32 rounds run. In C++ shifting a negative value is undefined, so shift as unsigned. Python ints are unbounded, so mask with 0xFFFFFFFF to emulate 32-bit two's complement and convert results above 0x7FFFFFFF back to negatives.

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个 nums1[i] 看成一条有序链：(i, 0), (i, 1), (i, 2)...，因为 nums2 有序，链上的和单调不减。问题就成了合并多条有序链并取前 k 个。先把每条链的链头 (nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0) 放进最小堆（只需前 min(k, n1) 条，更靠后的链头不可能先被用完前 k 个名额）；每弹出一个 (i, j) 就记入答案，再把同一条链的下一个 (i, j + 1) 推进堆。弹出 k 次即可，堆的大小始终不超过 k。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each nums1[i] as a sorted chain (i, 0), (i, 1), ... whose sums never decrease because nums2 is sorted. The task becomes merging these chains and taking the first k items. Seed a min-heap with the head of each chain, (nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0), for only the first min(k, n1) rows, since later rows cannot be needed before those. Each time (i, j) is popped, record it and push its successor (i, j + 1). After k pops you are done, and the heap never holds more than k entries.

approaches.nameZh: 区间动态规划（极小化极大）
approaches.ideaZh: 要保证赢，就得为最坏情况付钱：在区间 [lo, hi] 里猜 x，花费 x，然后对手会把你引向代价更大的那一边，即 max(dp[lo][x - 1], dp[x + 1][hi])。我们选择让这个最坏代价最小的 x，所以 dp[lo][hi] = min over x of (x + max(左, 右))，空区间或单个数代价为 0。长区间依赖短区间，因此 lo 从大到小、hi 从小到大填表，答案是 dp[1][n]。表多开两格可以让 x = lo 或 x = hi 时直接取到 0。
approaches.ideaEn: To guarantee a win you pay for the worst case: guessing x in [lo, hi] costs x, after which the adversary steers you to the costlier side, max(dp[lo][x - 1], dp[x + 1][hi]). You pick the x that minimizes this, so dp[lo][hi] = min over x of x + max(left, right), with empty or single-number ranges costing 0. Longer ranges depend on shorter ones, so fill lo from high to low and hi from low to high; the answer is dp[1][n]. Two padding slots let x = lo or x = hi read a 0 directly.

approaches.nameZh: 按目标值递推（排列计数）
approaches.ideaZh: 题目里不同顺序算不同组合，所以本质是在数"和为 target 的序列"有多少个。看序列的最后一个数 x：去掉它之后是一个和为 t - x 的序列，于是 dp[t] = 所有 x <= t 的 dp[t - x] 之和，dp[0] = 1 表示空序列。外层循环遍历目标值、内层遍历 nums，正是这种循环顺序让不同排列被分别计数（反过来就变成了求组合数）。C++ 中某些中间状态会超出 32 位，但最终答案保证在 int 范围内，用 unsigned 做模 2^32 运算可以避免有符号溢出的未定义行为，结果仍然正确。
approaches.ideaEn: Different orders count separately, so we are counting sequences that sum to target. Look at the last element x: removing it leaves a sequence summing to t - x, so dp[t] is the sum of dp[t - x] over all x <= t, with dp[0] = 1 for the empty sequence. Looping over targets outside and nums inside is what counts each ordering separately (swapping the loops would count combinations instead). In C++ some intermediate states exceed 32 bits even though the answer fits; unsigned arithmetic wraps modulo 2^32 without undefined behavior and still yields the correct final value.

approaches.ideaZh: 每一行都是有序的，相当于 n 条有序链表。把每行第一个元素放进最小堆，弹出 k - 1 次，每弹出 (i, j) 就把同一行的下一个元素 (i, j + 1) 推进去；此时堆顶就是第 k 小。只需要前 min(n, k) 行入堆，因为第 k 小不可能出现在更靠后行的行首之后。思路直接，但没有利用"列也有序"这一条件。
approaches.ideaEn: Each row is sorted, so the matrix is n sorted lists. Put the first element of each row into a min-heap, pop k - 1 times, and after popping (i, j) push the next element of that row, (i, j + 1). The heap top is then the k-th smallest. Only the first min(n, k) rows need seeding. It is straightforward but ignores the fact that columns are sorted too.

approaches.nameZh: 值域二分 + 阶梯计数
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the value with a staircase count
approaches.ideaZh: 答案一定落在 [matrix[0][0], matrix[n-1][n-1]] 之间，于是对数值本身二分：找最小的 x，使得矩阵中 <= x 的元素个数至少为 k。计数利用行列都有序的性质走"阶梯"：从右上角出发，逐行向下，每行里把列指针左移到第一个 <= x 的位置，该行贡献 j + 1 个；由于下一行同一列的值更大，列指针只会左移，整个计数是 O(n)。二分收敛到的 x 一定是矩阵里真实存在的元素，因为计数恰好在这个值处跨过 k。
approaches.ideaEn: The answer lies in [matrix[0][0], matrix[n-1][n-1]], so binary-search on the value: find the smallest x such that at least k entries are <= x. Count with a staircase walk that uses both sorted directions: go down the rows, and in each row move the column pointer left until the entry is <= x, adding j + 1. Lower rows are larger, so the pointer only moves left and counting is O(n). The x the search converges to is always an actual matrix entry, since that is exactly where the count crosses k.

approaches.nameZh: 动态数组 + 哈希表记下标
approaches.ideaZh: 随机取值要 O(1)，就得把元素放在连续数组里按下标随机；查找和删除要 O(1)，就再用哈希表记录每个值在数组中的下标。插入时追加到数组末尾并登记下标。删除时不能在中间挖洞，而是把末尾元素搬到被删元素的位置、更新它的下标，再弹出末尾，删除的值从哈希表移除。先更新末尾元素的下标、再删除目标值，可以正确处理"删的恰好是末尾元素"的情况。这些 O(1) 都是哈希表意义下的平均复杂度。
approaches.ideaEn: O(1) random access needs the elements in a contiguous array; O(1) lookup and deletion needs a hash map from value to its array index. Insert appends to the array and records the index. To delete without leaving a hole, move the last element into the removed slot, update its index, pop the tail, and drop the removed value from the map. Updating the moved element before deleting the target keeps the case where the target is the last element correct. These O(1) bounds are average-case, as with any hash map.

approaches.nameZh: 动态数组 + 值到下标集合
approaches.ideaZh: 思路和不含重复的版本相同：元素放在数组里以便等概率随机，哈希表负责定位。区别在于一个值可能占多个位置，所以表里存的是"下标集合"。插入时把新下标加入集合，集合大小为 1 说明之前不存在。删除时从该值的集合里任取一个下标 i，用数组末尾元素覆盖位置 i，在末尾元素的集合里加入 i、去掉原来的末尾下标，再弹出数组末尾。先加后删的顺序保证了 i 恰好是末尾下标时也不会出错。由于重复值在数组中出现多次，getRandom 的概率自然与出现次数成正比。这些 O(1) 都是哈希表意义下的平均复杂度。
approaches.ideaEn: Same idea as the distinct version: the array gives uniform random access and a hash map locates elements. Because a value can occupy several slots, the map stores a set of indices. Insert adds the new index to the set and returns true if the set now has size 1. Remove takes any index i from the value's set, overwrites slot i with the last element, adds i to that element's set and removes the old tail index, then pops the array. Adding before discarding keeps the case i == tail correct. Duplicates appear multiple times in the array, so getRandom is automatically proportional to multiplicity. These O(1) bounds are average-case, as with any hash map.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 回溯（可重复选）
approaches.ideaZh: 用回溯枚举每个候选数选几次。为了不产生 [2,3] 和 [3,2] 这种重复组合，规定只能从当前下标 start 往后选；因为同一个数可以重复使用，递归时下一层的起点仍是 i 而不是 i + 1。先排序有一个好处：一旦 candidates[i] 已经大于剩余目标，后面的数只会更大，可以直接 break 剪枝。剩余目标恰好为 0 时把当前路径拷贝进答案。其中 S 为所有合法组合的总长度，最坏情况下呈指数级；空间是递归深度。
approaches.ideaEn: Backtrack over how many times each candidate is used. To avoid duplicates like [2,3] and [3,2], only choose from the current index start onward; since a number may be reused, the recursive call starts again at i rather than i + 1. Sorting first allows a cheap cut: once candidates[i] exceeds the remaining target, every later value does too, so break. When the remaining target hits 0, copy the current path into the result. Here S is the total size of all valid combinations, exponential in the worst case; the space is the recursion depth.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右扫描，维护"当前层已经解码出的字符串 cur"和"正在读的重复次数 num"（数字可能有多位）。遇到 [ 时进入新的一层：把 (cur, num) 压栈保存外层现场，然后清空两者。遇到 ] 时当前层结束：弹出外层的 (prev, k)，令 cur = prev + cur * k。普通字母直接接到 cur 后面。扫描完 cur 就是答案。设解码后长度为 L、嵌套深度为 d，每个字符最多随着每层拼接被复制一次，所以时间是 O(L·d)。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right, keeping cur (the decoded text of the current level) and num (the repeat count being read, possibly multi-digit). On [ start a new level: push (cur, num) to save the outer context and reset both. On ] the level ends: pop (prev, k) and set cur = prev + cur * k. Letters are appended to cur. At the end cur is the answer. With decoded length L and nesting depth d, each output character is copied at most once per level, giving O(L·d) time.

approaches.nameZh: 分治：按不合格字符切开
approaches.nameEn: Divide and conquer on deficient characters
approaches.ideaZh: 如果某个字符在整个串里出现次数都不到 k，那么任何包含它的子串都不可能合法，所以答案一定完全落在被它切开的某一段里。统计当前串的字符频次：若所有字符都至少出现 k 次，整串就是答案；否则以出现次数不足 k 的字符为界把串切开，对每一段递归求解并取最大值。每深入一层，子串里至少少了一种字符，递归深度不超过字母表大小 26，每层总工作量 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: If some character occurs fewer than k times in the whole string, no valid substring can contain it, so the answer lies entirely inside one of the pieces it separates. Count frequencies: if every character appears at least k times, the whole string is the answer; otherwise split at the deficient characters, solve each piece recursively, and take the maximum. Each level removes at least one distinct character, so recursion depth is at most the alphabet size 26 with O(n) total work per level.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举不同字符数 + 滑动窗口
approaches.ideaZh: 直接滑窗不行，因为"每个字符都至少 k 次"在窗口扩大或缩小时都不单调。办法是再加一个约束：枚举窗口里恰好允许 t 种不同字符（t = 1..26）。在固定 t 的条件下，窗口不同字符数超过 t 就收缩左端，这就恢复了单调性。窗口内另外维护 enough，即出现次数已经达到 k 的字符种数；当 distinct == enough 时窗口合法，用它的长度更新答案。26 轮线性扫描，总复杂度 O(26·n)，只用常数额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: A plain sliding window fails because "every character appears at least k times" is not monotone as the window grows or shrinks. Add a constraint to restore monotonicity: for each t = 1..26, require the window to contain at most t distinct letters and shrink from the left whenever it exceeds t. Also track enough, the number of letters whose count has reached k; when distinct == enough the window is valid and its length is a candidate. That is 26 linear passes, O(26·n) time with constant extra space.

approaches.nameZh: 建图 + 逐个查询 DFS
approaches.nameEn: Weighted graph and a DFS per query
approaches.ideaZh: 把每个变量看成图上的点，a / b = v 对应一条 a→b 权重 v 的边和一条 b→a 权重 1/v 的边。查询 a / c 就是在图上找一条从 a 到 c 的路径，沿路把边权乘起来：(a/b)·(b/c) = a/c。对每个查询做一次带 visited 集合的 DFS，找到终点就返回乘积，找不到返回 -1。任一变量没在方程里出现过时直接返回 -1，所以 ["x","x"] 也是 -1，而已知变量对自身的查询是 1。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each variable as a node; a / b = v becomes an edge a→b of weight v and b→a of weight 1/v. Answering a / c means finding any path from a to c and multiplying the weights along it, since (a/b)·(b/c) = a/c. Run a DFS with a visited set per query, returning the product on reaching the target or -1 otherwise. If either variable never appeared in an equation the answer is -1, so ["x","x"] gives -1 while a known variable divided by itself gives 1.

approaches.ideaZh: 在并查集的每个节点上额外存 ratio[x] = x / parent[x]。find 在路径压缩时把沿途比值乘起来，使 ratio[x] 直接变成 x / root。合并 a / b = v 时，先找到两边的根 ra、rb，由 a = ratio[a]·ra、b = ratio[b]·rb 推出 ra / rb = v·ratio[b] / ratio[a]，把 ra 挂到 rb 下并记下这个比值。查询 a / b 时，若两者同根，答案就是 ratio[a] / ratio[b]（根相互抵消）；不同根或有未知变量则返回 -1。查询多时比每次重新搜图快得多。
approaches.ideaEn: Store ratio[x] = x / parent[x] on every node. During find, path compression multiplies the ratios along the way so ratio[x] becomes x / root. To merge a / b = v, find roots ra and rb; from a = ratio[a]·ra and b = ratio[b]·rb we get ra / rb = v·ratio[b] / ratio[a], so attach ra under rb with that ratio. A query a / b with a common root is ratio[a] / ratio[b] (the root cancels); different roots or unknown variables give -1. With many queries this beats searching the graph each time.

approaches.nameEn: Merge with two pointers up to the middle
approaches.ideaZh: 像归并排序那样用两个指针从两个数组头部往后走，每次取较小的那个，只需走到合并序列的第 (m + n) / 2 个位置为止，同时记住上一个取出的数。总长为奇数时中位数就是最后取出的数；为偶数时是最后两个数的平均值。它不需要真的开辅助数组，但仍是线性时间，达不到题目要求的对数复杂度。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk two pointers from the fronts of both arrays like a merge, always taking the smaller value, but stop after reaching position (m + n) / 2 of the merged order, remembering the previous value as well. For an odd total the median is the last value taken; for an even total it is the average of the last two. No merged array is built, but the time is still linear, short of the required logarithmic bound.

approaches.nameZh: 在短数组上二分切分点
approaches.nameEn: Binary search the partition in the shorter array
approaches.ideaZh: 中位数等价于把两个数组各切一刀，使左半部分共有 half = (m + n + 1) / 2 个元素，且左半最大值 <= 右半最小值。设短数组切在 i，长数组就必须切在 j = half - i，所以只需在短数组上二分 i。检查切口两侧的四个数：若 a[i-1] > b[j]，说明 i 切得太靠右；若 b[j-1] > a[i]，说明太靠左；否则切分合法，奇数总长时答案是左半最大值，偶数时是左半最大值与右半最小值的平均。越界的位置用正负无穷代替，二分范围只依赖短数组长度。
approaches.ideaEn: The median corresponds to cutting both arrays so that the left side holds half = (m + n + 1) / 2 elements and every left value is <= every right value. If the shorter array is cut at i, the longer one must be cut at j = half - i, so binary-search i on the shorter array only. Compare the four values around the cuts: a[i-1] > b[j] means i is too far right, b[j-1] > a[i] means it is too far left, and otherwise the cut is valid. The median is then the max of the left side for an odd total, or its average with the min of the right side for an even total. Out-of-range neighbors act as -inf or +inf.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 回溯（同层去重）
approaches.nameEn: Sort, then backtrack skipping same-level duplicates
approaches.ideaZh: 和组合总和类似地回溯，但每个数只能用一次，所以递归时起点是 i + 1。难点在于数组本身有重复值，比如两个 1 会生成两份 [1,7]。先排序让相同的数挨在一起，然后规定：在同一层（同一个 start 下的 for 循环）里，相同的数只尝试第一个，即 i > start 且 candidates[i] == candidates[i - 1] 时跳过。这样不同层仍然可以选相同的值（得到 [1,1,6]），同层的重复分支则被剪掉。排序后遇到比剩余目标大的数可以直接 break。时间是最坏情况的上界。
approaches.ideaEn: Backtrack as in Combination Sum, but each element is used at most once, so recurse from i + 1. The catch is duplicate values: two 1s would otherwise produce [1,7] twice. Sort so equal values sit together, and within one level (the loop for a fixed start) only try the first of each run, skipping i > start with candidates[i] == candidates[i - 1]. Different levels may still take equal values, which yields [1,1,6], while duplicate branches at the same level are cut. Sorting also allows breaking as soon as a value exceeds the remaining target. The time is a worst-case bound.

approaches.ideaZh: 想让剩下的数最小，就要让高位尽可能小：从左往右扫，如果当前数字比栈顶小，那么删掉栈顶（一个更高位上的大数字）一定更划算。于是维护一个单调不降的栈，只要还有删除次数且栈顶大于当前数字就弹出。扫完后如果 k 还没用完，说明剩下的序列已经单调不降，直接从末尾再删 k 个。最后去掉前导零，结果为空时返回 "0"。
approaches.ideaEn: To minimize the result, make the high-order digits as small as possible. Scan left to right; whenever the current digit is smaller than the stack top, deleting that top (a larger digit in a higher position) is always worth it. Keep a non-decreasing stack and pop while deletions remain. If k is still positive afterwards, the stack is already non-decreasing, so drop the last k digits. Strip leading zeros and return "0" for an empty result.

approaches.nameZh: 石头 → 跳跃长度集合
approaches.nameEn: Stone to set of jump lengths
approaches.ideaZh: 只知道"能不能到某块石头"是不够的，因为到达时上一跳的长度决定了下一跳能跳多远，所以状态要是（石头位置，上一跳长度）。用哈希表把每块石头映射到"能以哪些跳跃长度到达它"的集合，起点放入长度 0。按位置从小到大处理每块石头，对集合里的每个长度 k 尝试 k-1、k、k+1，若落点是石头就把这个步长加入落点的集合。最后看终点石头的集合是否非空。每块石头的跳跃长度不超过石头总数，状态总数是 O(n²)。
approaches.ideaEn: Knowing only whether a stone is reachable is not enough: the length of the last jump decides the next jump, so the state is (stone, last jump length). Map each stone to the set of jump lengths that can land on it, seeding the first stone with length 0. Process stones in increasing order; for each length k in a stone's set try k-1, k and k+1, and record the step in the target stone's set when it exists. The answer is whether the last stone's set is non-empty. Each set holds at most n lengths, giving O(n^2) states.

approaches.nameZh: 递归时由父节点判断左叶子
approaches.nameEn: Recursion: the parent identifies left leaves
approaches.ideaZh: 一个节点自己并不知道它是不是"左"孩子，所以判断要放在父节点那里做：看当前节点的左孩子是否存在且没有任何孩子。如果是，就把它的值计入答案；否则继续递归处理左子树。右子树无论如何都要递归下去，因为右子树里也可能藏着左叶子。只有一个根节点时，它不是左叶子，答案为 0。
approaches.ideaEn: A node cannot tell on its own whether it is a left child, so the check happens at the parent: is its left child present and childless? If so, add that value; otherwise recurse into the left subtree. Always recurse into the right subtree too, since it may contain left leaves deeper down. A lone root is not a left leaf, so the answer is 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 回文串两侧是对称的，每个字符都必须成对使用，只有正中间可以放一个落单的字符。统计每个字符的出现次数，次数为偶数的可以全部用上，次数为奇数的要扔掉一个。设奇数次的字符有 odd 种，那么能用的字符数是 len(s) - odd；只要 odd > 0，还能挑一个放到中心再加 1。
approaches.ideaEn: A palindrome is symmetric, so characters must be used in pairs, except for one optional center character. Count each character; even counts are fully usable, odd counts lose one character. With odd characters having odd counts, len(s) - odd characters can be paired, and if odd > 0 one more can sit in the center.

approaches.ideaZh: 长度为 n 的数组最多容纳 1..n 这 n 个正整数，所以答案一定落在 [1, n+1] 里。把所有数放进集合，再从 1 开始往上找第一个不在集合中的数，最多找 n+1 次。这个做法容易写对，但用了 O(n) 额外空间，不满足题目的常数空间要求，可以作为思路起点。
approaches.ideaEn: An array of length n can hold at most the n values 1..n, so the answer lies in [1, n+1]. Put every number in a set and scan upward from 1 until a value is missing; this takes at most n+1 checks. It is easy to get right but uses O(n) extra space, which the problem forbids, so treat it as a stepping stone.

approaches.nameZh: 原地归位（数组当哈希表）
approaches.ideaZh: 既然答案在 [1, n+1] 里，就让数组自己当哈希表：值 v（1 ≤ v ≤ n）应该放在下标 v-1。遍历每个位置，只要当前值在范围内且目标位置上还不是它，就把它交换过去，换回来的新值继续处理。每次交换都会让一个数归位，所以总交换次数不超过 n。归位完成后再扫一遍，第一个 nums[i] != i+1 的位置给出答案 i+1，全部吻合则答案是 n+1。注意目标位置已经是同一个值时要停，否则重复值会死循环。
approaches.ideaEn: Since the answer is in [1, n+1], let the array act as its own hash table: value v (1 <= v <= n) belongs at index v-1. For each position, while the value is in range and its home slot does not already hold it, swap it home and keep processing whatever comes back. Every swap fixes one value permanently, so there are at most n swaps. A final scan returns i+1 at the first index where nums[i] != i+1, or n+1 if all match. Stopping when the home slot already holds the same value avoids an infinite loop on duplicates.

approaches.nameZh: 二分答案 + 贪心分组
approaches.nameEn: Binary search on the answer + greedy grouping
approaches.ideaZh: 反过来问：如果每段和不能超过 limit，最少要分几段？从左往右贪心地往当前段里塞数，塞不下就新开一段，这样得到的段数就是最少段数。limit 越大，需要的段数越少，具有单调性。答案的下界是 max(nums)（单个元素必须放得下），上界是 sum(nums)（整个数组一段）。在这个区间里二分，找最小的、使段数 ≤ k 的 limit；段数少于 k 也没关系，因为可以把某段再拆开而不会让最大值变大。其中 S = sum(nums)。
approaches.ideaEn: Flip the question: with every part sum capped at limit, how few parts are needed? Greedily extend the current part and start a new one only when the next number does not fit; this gives the minimum count. A larger limit never needs more parts, so the predicate is monotone. The answer lies between max(nums) (each element must fit) and sum(nums) (one part). Binary search for the smallest limit needing at most k parts; fewer than k is fine because splitting a part further never raises the maximum. Here S = sum(nums).

approaches.ideaZh: 两个子集和相等，等价于能否挑出一些数恰好凑出 total/2；total 为奇数时直接不可能。用布尔数组 dp[s] 表示"目前处理过的数里能否凑出和 s"，初始只有 dp[0] 为真。每加入一个数 x，就用 dp[s - x] 更新 dp[s]。容量必须从大到小遍历：这样 dp[s - x] 还是加入 x 之前的旧值，保证每个数只用一次；如果从小到大，x 会被重复使用，变成完全背包。
approaches.ideaEn: Two equal halves exist exactly when some subset sums to total/2; an odd total rules it out immediately. Let dp[s] mean "some subset of the processed numbers sums to s", starting with only dp[0] true. For each number x, update dp[s] from dp[s - x]. Iterate capacities from high to low so dp[s - x] still reflects the state before x, using each number once; ascending order would reuse x and turn it into an unbounded knapsack.

approaches.ideaZh: 把上一种做法的布尔数组压成一个整数（或 bitset）：第 s 位为 1 表示和 s 可以凑出。加入数 x 相当于把所有可达和整体平移 x，再与原来的集合取并，即 bits |= bits << x。移位一次性处理了所有容量，并且右边用的是旧的 bits，天然保证每个数只用一次。最后检查第 total/2 位。
approaches.ideaEn: Pack the boolean array into one integer (or a bitset), where bit s set means sum s is reachable. Adding x shifts every reachable sum by x and unions it with the old set: bits |= bits << x. The shift handles all capacities at once and reads only the old bits, so each number is used once. Finally test bit total/2.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果从每个格子出发模拟水往下流，会有大量重复搜索。反过来想：水能从 A 流到海洋，等价于从海洋出发"逆流而上"能走到 A，逆流的条件是下一格高度不低于当前格。于是从太平洋的边界（第一行、第一列）出发做一次 DFS/BFS，得到能流进太平洋的格子集合；再从大西洋边界（最后一行、最后一列）做一次。两个集合的交集就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Simulating flow downhill from every cell repeats a lot of work. Reverse it: water from cell A reaches an ocean exactly when climbing from that ocean (moving only to cells at least as high) reaches A. Run one DFS/BFS from the Pacific border (top row, left column) to mark cells that drain into it, and another from the Atlantic border (bottom row, right column). Return the cells marked by both.
approaches.python:
class Solution:
    def pacificAtlantic(self, heights: List[List[int]]) -> List[List[int]]:
        m, n = len(heights), len(heights[0])

        def climb(starts):
            seen = set(starts)
            stack = list(seen)
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r - 1, c), (r, c + 1), (r, c - 1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < m and 0 <= nc < n and (nr, nc) not in seen
                            and heights[nr][nc] >= heights[r][c]):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            return seen

        pac = climb([(0, c) for c in range(n)] + [(r, 0) for r in range(m)])
        atl = climb([(m - 1, c) for c in range(n)] + [(r, n - 1) for r in range(m)])
        return [[r, c] for r in range(m) for c in range(n) if (r, c) in pac and (r, c) in atl]

approaches.ideaZh: 每个位置能存的水 = min(左侧最高, 右侧最高) - 自身高度，这里的"左侧最高"和"右侧最高"都包含自身，所以结果不会是负数。先从左到右求前缀最大值数组，再从右到左求后缀最大值数组。最后逐个位置累加 min(left[i], right[i]) - height[i]。思路直接，三次线性扫描，代价是两个额外数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Water above position i equals min(highest bar on the left, highest bar on the right) minus height[i], where both maxima include i itself so the value is never negative. Build a prefix-maximum array left to right and a suffix-maximum array right to left. Sum min(left[i], right[i]) - height[i] over all positions. Three linear passes, at the cost of two extra arrays.

approaches.ideaZh: 其实不需要知道两侧的精确最大值，只需要知道较矮的那一侧。用左右两个指针向中间收拢，并记录各自走过部分的最大值 lmax、rmax。如果 height[l] < height[r]，说明右边至少有一根柱子比 height[l] 高，左指针位置的水位只由 lmax 决定，于是结算 lmax - height[l] 并右移 l；反之对称地结算右指针。每次移动的总是较矮的一侧，因为较矮一侧的水位已经确定。
approaches.ideaEn: We do not need both exact maxima, only the smaller one. Move two pointers inward while tracking lmax and rmax over the scanned parts. If height[l] < height[r], some bar on the right is taller than height[l], so the water at l is bounded only by lmax; add lmax - height[l] and advance l. Otherwise settle the right pointer symmetrically. Always move the lower side, because its water level is already determined.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口 + 历史最大频次
approaches.nameEn: Sliding window with historical max frequency
approaches.ideaZh: 一个窗口能变成全同字符所需的替换次数 = 窗口长度 - 窗口内出现最多的字符次数，只要它不超过 k 窗口就合法。右指针每次扩展一格，更新计数和 maxf；如果窗口不合法，左指针右移一格。关键在于 maxf 不必在缩窗时回退：只有 maxf 变得更大，答案才可能变得更长，用偏大的旧 maxf 只会让窗口"平移"而不会把答案算错。因为窗口只平移不收缩，最终窗口长度 len(s) - left 就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: A window can become one repeated letter with (window length - count of its most frequent letter) replacements; it is valid while that is at most k. Extend the right end each step, updating counts and maxf; if the window becomes invalid, move the left end by one. maxf never needs to decrease: a longer answer requires a larger maxf, and a stale maxf only makes the window slide instead of shrinking. Because the window never shrinks, its final length len(s) - left is the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: BST 的中序遍历正好是升序，所以只要按中序访问节点，把相邻两个节点互相连起来即可：前一个节点的 right 指向当前节点，当前节点的 left 指向前一个节点。用显式栈做迭代中序，记录 prev，第一个访问的节点就是链表头。改指针是安全的：访问当前节点时它的左子树已经处理完，而 prev 的右子树也已经进入遍历。遍历结束后，把头和尾（最后的 prev）首尾相连形成环。空树直接返回空。
approaches.ideaEn: An in-order walk of a BST visits values in ascending order, so we only need to link consecutive nodes: prev.right = cur and cur.left = prev. Use an explicit stack for the in-order walk and keep prev; the first visited node is the head. Rewiring is safe because cur's left subtree is finished when cur is visited, and prev's right subtree has already been entered. At the end connect the head and the last node to close the circle. An empty tree returns null.

approaches.nameZh: 遇到 child 就整段拼接
approaches.nameEn: Splice each child list in place
approaches.ideaZh: 从头沿 next 往后走，遇到带 child 的节点 cur 时，把它的子链表整段插到 cur 和 cur.next 之间。具体做法：先沿子链表找到它的尾 tail，然后连 tail.next = cur.next（如果 cur.next 存在，还要把它的 prev 改成 tail），再连 cur.next = child、child.prev = cur，最后把 cur.child 置空。插进来的子链表里可能还有更深的 child，但因为主指针会继续走过这些节点，它们会在之后被同样处理。每个节点最多被找尾扫过一次、被主指针走过一次，所以是线性的。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk along next; when a node cur has a child, splice the whole child list between cur and cur.next. Find the child list's tail, link tail.next = cur.next (fixing cur.next.prev if it exists), then cur.next = child and child.prev = cur, and finally clear cur.child. Deeper children inside the spliced list are handled later because the main pointer walks through them. Each node is scanned at most once by a tail search and once by the main pointer, so the total is linear.

approaches.nameZh: 计数桶双向链表 + 哈希表
approaches.nameEn: Doubly linked count buckets + hash map
approaches.ideaZh: 把相同计数的 key 放进同一个"桶"，桶按计数从小到大串成双向链表，头尾各放一个哨兵；再用哈希表记录每个 key 当前所在的桶。inc 时 key 要搬到计数 +1 的桶：如果右邻桶正好是 cnt+1 就直接放进去，否则在当前桶右边新建一个；dec 对称地搬到左边 cnt-1 的桶，计数降到 0 时直接从哈希表删除。搬走后如果原桶空了就把它摘掉，这样链表中永远没有空桶。于是最小 key 在第一个真实桶里，最大 key 在最后一个真实桶里，所有操作都是 O(1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Group keys with equal counts into one bucket and chain the buckets in ascending count order in a doubly linked list with sentinels at both ends; a hash map records each key's bucket. inc moves the key to the count+1 bucket, reusing the right neighbor if it has exactly that count or creating one right after the current bucket; dec mirrors this to the left, and a key whose count reaches 0 is simply dropped from the map. A bucket left empty is unlinked, so the list never holds empty buckets. The minimum key then lives in the first real bucket and the maximum in the last, and every operation is O(1).

approaches.ideaZh: 把每个基因串看成图上的点，只差一个字符且目标在基因库里的两个串之间有一条边，求的就是起点到终点的最短路，边权都为 1，所以用 BFS。从起点出发，对当前串的 8 个位置分别尝试换成 A/C/G/T，生成的新串如果还在"未访问的基因库"集合里，就入队并从集合中删掉，防止重复访问。第一次弹出终点时的步数就是答案；队列空了还没遇到终点则返回 -1。其中 B 为基因库的大小，L = 8 为基因长度。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat each gene as a vertex, with an edge between strings that differ in one position when the target is in the bank; we need the shortest path with unit weights, so use BFS. From the current gene, try replacing each of the 8 positions with A, C, G or T; any result still in the unvisited bank set is enqueued and removed from the set. The step count when the end gene is dequeued is the answer, and -1 if the queue empties first. Here B is the bank size and L = 8 is the gene length.

approaches.ideaZh: 最少删除多少个区间，等价于最多能保留多少个互不重叠的区间。按右端点从小到大排序，依次扫描：如果当前区间的左端点不早于上一个保留区间的右端点（端点相接不算重叠），就保留它并更新右端点，否则删掉。选结束最早的区间，能给后面留下最多的空间，这一点可以用交换论证说明：任何最优解的第一个区间都可以换成结束最早的那个而不变差。答案是总数减去保留数。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Minimizing removals is the same as maximizing the number of non-overlapping intervals kept. Sort by end point and scan; keep an interval if its start is not before the end of the last kept one (touching endpoints do not overlap), otherwise drop it. Choosing the earliest-finishing interval leaves the most room for the rest; an exchange argument shows any optimal solution can swap its first interval for this one without loss. The answer is the total minus the number kept. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 路径必须向下走，但起点可以是任意节点。最直接的做法是：对每个节点，都把它当作起点向下 DFS，沿途累计和，等于 targetSum 就计数一次；外层再递归地把每个节点都当作起点试一遍。每个起点要扫描它的整棵子树，最坏（链状树）是 O(n²)。这个写法清楚展示了"起点 × 终点"的枚举结构，也正是下一种做法要优化掉的部分。
approaches.ideaEn: Paths go downward but may start at any node. The direct approach treats every node as a start and runs a downward DFS accumulating the sum, counting each time it equals targetSum; an outer recursion tries every node as the start. Each start scans its whole subtree, so a chain-shaped tree costs O(n^2). This makes the start-times-end enumeration explicit, which is exactly what the next approach removes.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和 + 哈希表回溯
approaches.nameEn: Prefix sums with a backtracked hash map
approaches.ideaZh: 把根到当前节点的路径看成一个数组，以当前节点结尾、和为 targetSum 的向下路径数，就是这条路径上前缀和等于 cur - targetSum 的位置个数（cur 是根到当前节点的和）。DFS 时用哈希表记录当前根到节点这条链上各前缀和出现的次数，初始放入 {0: 1} 表示空前缀。进入节点时先查询再把 cur 计数加一，递归左右子树，离开时再减一撤销。撤销这一步很关键，它保证哈希表里只包含当前这条链上的前缀，而不会混入兄弟子树。空间包括 O(h) 的递归栈和 O(n) 的哈希表。
approaches.ideaEn: View the root-to-node path as an array: the number of downward paths ending at the current node with sum targetSum equals the number of earlier prefix sums equal to cur - targetSum, where cur is the root-to-node sum. During DFS keep a hash map counting prefix sums on the current root-to-node chain, seeded with {0: 1} for the empty prefix. On entering a node, query first, then increment cur's count, recurse into both children, and decrement on the way out. Undoing the increment keeps the map limited to the current chain so sibling subtrees never leak in. Space is O(h) for the recursion plus O(n) for the map.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def pathSum(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], targetSum: int) -> int:
        seen = Counter({0: 1})

        def dfs(node, cur):
            if not node:
                return 0
            cur += node.val
            res = seen[cur - targetSum]
            seen[cur] += 1
            res += dfs(node.left, cur) + dfs(node.right, cur)
            seen[cur] -= 1
            return res

        return dfs(root, 0)

approaches.ideaZh: 异位词只看各字母的数量，所以 s 中长度为 |p| 的窗口是 p 的异位词，当且仅当两边 26 个字母的计数完全相同。先统计 p 的计数，然后让窗口在 s 上滑动：右边进来一个字符就加计数，窗口长度超过 |p| 就把最左边的字符减掉。每一步比较两个长度 26 的数组，相等就记录窗口起点 i - |p| + 1。比较是常数代价，整体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: An anagram depends only on letter counts, so a length-|p| window of s is an anagram of p exactly when the two 26-letter count arrays match. Count p first, then slide a window over s: add the incoming character on the right, and once the window exceeds |p| remove the leftmost one. Compare the two arrays each step and record the window start i - |p| + 1 on a match. Each comparison is constant, so the whole scan is linear.

approaches.ideaZh: 值域是 1..n，正好和下标 0..n-1 一一对应，可以把数组本身当作"是否出现过"的标记表。遍历每个数 x，看下标 |x|-1 处的值：如果还是正的，说明 |x| 第一次出现，把它取负做标记；如果已经是负的，说明之前见过 |x|，它就是重复数。因为位置上的数可能已经被取负，读取值时要先取绝对值。每个数最多出现两次，所以每个重复数只会被记录一次。除输出外只用 O(1) 额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Values lie in 1..n, matching indices 0..n-1, so the array itself can serve as a seen-table. For each number x, look at index |x|-1: if the value there is positive, |x| is new, so negate it as a mark; if it is already negative, |x| was seen before and is a duplicate. Take absolute values when reading, since entries may already be negated. Each value appears at most twice, so every duplicate is reported once. Extra space is O(1) besides the output.

approaches.nameEn: Add from the tail using two stacks
approaches.ideaZh: 链表是高位在前，而加法要从低位开始算进位。不反转原链表的话，可以先把两条链表的数字分别压进栈，栈顶就是最低位。每次各弹出一位（空栈视为 0），加上进位，得到当前位 carry % 10 和新进位 carry // 10。新节点用头插法接在结果前面，这样结果链表自然也是高位在前。两个栈都空且没有进位时结束。
approaches.ideaEn: The lists store the most significant digit first, but addition proceeds from the least significant digit. Without reversing the inputs, push each list's digits onto a stack so the top is the lowest digit. Pop one digit from each (0 if empty), add the carry, and emit carry % 10 with carry // 10 carried forward. Prepend each new node so the result is also most-significant first. Stop when both stacks are empty and no carry remains.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: Optional[ListNode], l2: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        def digits(node):
            st = []
            while node:
                st.append(node.val)
                node = node.next
            return st

        a, b = digits(l1), digits(l2)
        head, carry = None, 0
        while a or b or carry:
            carry += (a.pop() if a else 0) + (b.pop() if b else 0)
            head = ListNode(carry % 10, head)
            carry //= 10
        return head

approaches.ideaZh: 数值 1..n 和下标 0..n-1 一一对应。第一遍对每个数 x，把下标 |x|-1 处的值变成负数，表示 |x| 出现过；用 -abs(...) 而不是直接取反，避免出现两次的数把标记又翻回正数。第二遍扫描，仍为正数的位置 i 说明 i+1 从未出现过，收集起来即可。除了返回结果外不需要额外空间。
approaches.ideaEn: Values 1..n map one-to-one onto indices 0..n-1. In the first pass, for each x make the value at index |x|-1 negative to mark that |x| appeared; use -abs(...) rather than plain negation so a value seen twice does not flip the mark back. In the second pass, any index i still holding a positive number means i+1 never appeared. No extra space is needed beyond the output.

approaches.nameZh: 前序序列 + 值域上下界重建
approaches.ideaZh: 普通二叉树序列化需要写出空节点，而 BST 不需要：前序序列加上"左小右大"的性质就足以唯一确定结构。序列化时只按前序输出节点值，用空格分隔。反序列化时递归 build(lo, hi)：如果下一个值落在 (lo, hi) 开区间内，它就是当前子树的根，然后依次用 (lo, val) 构建左子树、(val, hi) 构建右子树；否则说明这个值属于某个祖先的另一侧，返回空。每个值只被读取一次，整体线性。
approaches.ideaEn: A general binary tree needs null markers, but a BST does not: the preorder sequence plus the ordering property fixes the shape. Serialize by writing node values in preorder separated by spaces. Deserialize with build(lo, hi): if the next value lies in the open range (lo, hi), it is this subtree's root, so build the left subtree with (lo, val) and the right with (val, hi); otherwise it belongs to an ancestor's other side, so return null. Each value is consumed once, so both directions are linear.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.left = None
#         self.right = None

class Codec:

    def serialize(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> str:
        """Encodes a tree to a single string.
        """
        out = []

        def pre(node):
            if node:
                out.append(str(node.val))
                pre(node.left)
                pre(node.right)

        pre(root)
        return ' '.join(out)

    def deserialize(self, data: str) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        """Decodes your encoded data to tree.
        """
        vals = [int(x) for x in data.split()]
        i = 0

        def build(lo, hi):
            nonlocal i
            if i == len(vals) or not lo < vals[i] < hi:
                return None
            node = TreeNode(vals[i])
            i += 1
            node.left = build(lo, node.val)
            node.right = build(node.val, hi)
            return node

        return build(float('-inf'), float('inf'))

approaches.ideaZh: 把跳跃看成 BFS：跳 j 次能到达的位置构成一段连续区间，跳 j+1 次能到达的是从这段区间里任一点出发能跳到的更远区间。扫描时维护当前层的右边界 end 和下一层能到的最远位置 far。走到 end 时，说明当前层已经扫完，必须再跳一次，跳数加一并把 end 更新为 far。只需扫到倒数第二个位置，因为到达最后一个位置后不需要再跳。这里不是"每次跳最远"，而是"每层取最远边界"。
approaches.ideaEn: View jumping as BFS: positions reachable in j jumps form a contiguous range, and the next range is everything reachable from it. While scanning, keep end, the right edge of the current layer, and far, the farthest index the next layer reaches. On reaching end the current layer is exhausted, so count one more jump and set end = far. Scan only up to the second-to-last index, since no jump is needed after landing on the last one. The greedy choice is the farthest layer boundary, not the longest single jump.

approaches.nameZh: 递归查找 + 分情况删除
approaches.ideaZh: 利用 BST 的有序性递归查找：key 比当前值小就去左子树删，比当前值大就去右子树删，并把返回的新子树根接回去。找到目标节点后分三种情况：没有孩子时直接返回空；只有一个孩子时用这个孩子顶替自己；有两个孩子时，找右子树里最小的节点（后继），把它的值复制到当前节点，再到右子树里删除这个后继值。后继在右子树最左端，最多只有一个右孩子，所以那次删除会落到前两种简单情况。
approaches.ideaEn: Use BST order to search recursively: recurse left when key is smaller, right when larger, and reattach the returned subtree root. At the target there are three cases: no children, return null; one child, let that child replace the node; two children, take the smallest node of the right subtree (the successor), copy its value into the current node, then delete that value from the right subtree. The successor is the leftmost node there and has at most a right child, so that second deletion hits one of the simple cases.

approaches.nameZh: 按右端点排序，箭射在最早结束处
approaches.nameEn: Sort by end, shoot at the earliest end
approaches.ideaZh: 按右端点从小到大排序。第一支箭射在第一个气球的右端点上最划算：它必须打掉这个气球，而越往右能顺带覆盖的气球越多，再往右就打不到它了。之后依次检查气球：如果左端点不超过当前箭的位置（闭区间，端点相接也能打爆），它已经被这支箭打掉；否则需要新的一支箭，射在这个气球的右端点。坐标可达 ±2^31，C++ 里比较时注意不要用相减来写比较函数，避免溢出。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort balloons by right end. The first arrow is best placed at the first balloon's right end: it must burst that balloon, and the further right it goes the more others it can hit, but going past that end would miss it. Then scan: if a balloon's start is at most the current arrow position (closed intervals, so touching counts), it is already burst; otherwise fire a new arrow at its right end. Coordinates span the full 32-bit range, so in C++ never write the comparator as a subtraction. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.nameZh: 两两分组 + 哈希计数
approaches.nameEn: Pair sums with a hash map
approaches.ideaZh: 直接枚举四个数是 O(n⁴)。把四个数组分成两组：先枚举 nums1 和 nums2 的所有组合，用哈希表记录每个和 a+b 出现了多少次。再枚举 nums3 和 nums4 的组合，对每个 c+d 去表里查 -(c+d) 的次数并累加。这样就把一次 n⁴ 的枚举拆成了两次 n² 的枚举，代价是一个最多 n² 个键的哈希表。
approaches.ideaEn: Enumerating all four indices is O(n^4). Split the arrays into two pairs: enumerate every a+b from nums1 and nums2 and count the sums in a hash map. Then enumerate every c+d from nums3 and nums4 and add the stored count of -(c+d). One n^4 enumeration becomes two n^2 ones at the cost of a map with up to n^2 keys.

approaches.ideaZh: 把孩子的胃口 g 和饼干尺寸 s 都升序排序。用一个指针指向当前胃口最小、还没被满足的孩子，从小到大依次拿饼干：如果这块饼干能满足他，就分给他并把孩子指针后移；不能满足就丢掉这块饼干，因为它也满足不了后面胃口更大的孩子。用"最小的够用的饼干"喂"最容易满足的孩子"，不会浪费大饼干，交换论证可以说明这样不会更差。最终孩子指针的位置就是答案。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort greeds and cookie sizes. Walk through cookies from smallest to largest while a pointer marks the least greedy child still unfed. If the cookie satisfies that child, feed them and advance; otherwise the cookie is useless for every remaining child and is skipped. Giving the smallest sufficient cookie to the easiest child never hurts, by an exchange argument. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.
approaches.time: O(n log n + m log m)

approaches.ideaZh: 固定中间那个最大的数 nums[j]，"1" 显然取它左边的最小值最好，用前缀最小值即可 O(1) 得到。再向右枚举 k，看是否存在 min_left < nums[k] < nums[j]。这样把三重循环降到了两重，思路直接。但当 n 达到 2e5 时 O(n^2) 会超时，它的价值是说明"1"可以贪心取最小，真正难的是快速找"2"。
approaches.ideaEn: Fix the middle (largest) element nums[j]; the best "1" is the minimum to its left, available from a running prefix minimum. Then scan k > j for a value strictly between them. This drops one loop, but O(n^2) is still too slow for n = 2e5. It shows the "1" can be chosen greedily; the hard part is finding the "2".

approaches.ideaZh: 从右往左扫描，维护一个单调递减栈，并记录 third：所有被弹出的元素中的最大值，它代表一个合法的"2"，且它左边（栈里）一定有更大的"3"。遇到新元素 x 时，若 x < third，说明 x 可以当"1"，直接返回 true。否则把栈顶所有小于 x 的元素弹出并更新 third，因为 x 可以作为它们的"3"；最后把 x 压栈。third 只增不减，每个元素进出栈各一次，所以是线性的。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan from the right with a decreasing stack and a variable third: the largest value ever popped, which is a valid "2" with a larger "3" to its left. For each x, if x < third we found the "1" and return true. Otherwise pop every stack value smaller than x (x becomes their "3") and raise third, then push x. Each element is pushed and popped once.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果 s 由某个子串重复多次构成，那个子串的长度 L 一定整除 n，且 L ≤ n/2。枚举所有这样的 L，检查 s 是否满足 s[i] == s[i - L] 对所有 i ≥ L 成立，即 s 以 L 为周期。只要找到一个就返回 true。n 的因子个数很少，实际运行很快，最坏是 O(n·d(n))。
approaches.ideaEn: A repeating unit must have a length L that divides n with L <= n/2. For each such L, check that s[i] == s[i - L] for every i >= L, i.e. s has period L. Return true on the first hit. n has few divisors, so this is fast in practice, O(n * d(n)) worst case.

approaches.ideaZh: 计算 KMP 的前缀函数 pi，pi[n-1] 是 s 最长的、既是真前缀又是真后缀的长度。最长公共前后缀对应最短周期 p = n - pi[n-1]。s 能被整段重复构成，当且仅当 pi[n-1] > 0 且 p 整除 n。这样只需一次线性扫描，不必枚举所有因子。
approaches.ideaEn: Build the KMP prefix function; pi[n-1] is the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix, so the smallest period is p = n - pi[n-1]. s is a whole-number repetition exactly when pi[n-1] > 0 and p divides n. One linear pass, no divisor enumeration.

approaches.ideaZh: 排列关心的是顺序，所以每一层决定"当前位置放哪个数"，候选是所有还没用过的元素。用 used 数组记录哪些下标已在路径里，选一个、递归、再撤销。路径长度等于 n 时得到一个完整排列，复制一份放入答案。共有 n! 个排列，每个需要 O(n) 复制，这已是输出规模的下界。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Order matters, so each recursion level picks which unused element goes in the next slot. A used array marks indices already on the path; choose, recurse, then undo. When the path reaches length n, copy it into the result. There are n! permutations of length n, which is the output size anyway. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 哈希表 + 频次桶（每桶内 LRU）
approaches.nameEn: Hash map plus per-frequency LRU buckets
approaches.ideaZh: 用 node 表记录每个 key 的值和使用次数，再按频次分桶，每个桶是一个按访问先后排列的有序表（同频次内的 LRU）。另外维护 min_freq：当前最小的频次。get 或更新已有 key 时，把它从 f 号桶移到 f+1 号桶的末尾；如果 f 号桶空了且 f 恰好是 min_freq，就把 min_freq 加一。插入新 key 前若已满，从 min_freq 桶的头部淘汰最久未用的那个，然后新 key 放进 1 号桶并令 min_freq = 1。容量为 0 时 put 什么也不做。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep key -> (value, freq) and, for each frequency, an insertion-ordered bucket of keys (LRU within that frequency), plus min_freq. On get or update, move the key from bucket f to the tail of bucket f+1; if bucket f empties and f was min_freq, bump min_freq. On inserting a new key into a full cache, evict the head of the min_freq bucket, then put the key in bucket 1 and reset min_freq to 1. Capacity 0 ignores every put.

approaches.nameEn: Count land cells and shared edges
approaches.ideaZh: 每个陆地格子单独看贡献 4 条边。两个相邻的陆地格子会共享一条边，这条边对两边都不算周长，所以每有一对相邻陆地就减 2。扫描时只检查每个陆地格子的上方和左方，这样每对相邻关系恰好被数一次。网格外和水域都天然算作边界，不需要特殊处理，也不需要 DFS。
approaches.ideaEn: Each land cell contributes 4 edges on its own. Every pair of adjacent land cells shares one edge that is not perimeter for either side, so subtract 2 per pair. Checking only the up and left neighbours counts each pair exactly once. Out-of-grid and water both act as boundary automatically; no DFS needed.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 同层去重回溯
approaches.nameEn: Sort, then skip duplicates on the same level
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序让相同的数挨在一起，再像全排列一样用 used 数组回溯。去重规则：若 nums[i] == nums[i-1] 且 nums[i-1] 当前未被使用，就跳过 nums[i]。这表示在同一层（同一个位置）上，相同的值只让第一个出现的副本作为候选；而在更深的层，前一个副本已经被用在路径上，后一个副本仍然可以继续使用。这样相同值的副本总是按下标顺序被使用，每个不同的排列只生成一次。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort so equal values sit together, then backtrack with a used array. Skip nums[i] when it equals nums[i-1] and nums[i-1] is not currently used: on one level (one slot) only the first copy of a value is tried, while deeper levels may still use later copies once the earlier one is on the path. Copies are thus always consumed in index order, so each distinct permutation appears once. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.nameZh: 二维 0/1 背包（双重倒序）
approaches.ideaZh: 每个字符串是一件物品，它占用 zeros 个 0 和 ones 个 1 的"容量"，价值为 1。dp[i][j] 表示最多用 i 个 0、j 个 1 时最多能选几个字符串。对每个字符串，两个维度都从大到小遍历，dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[i - zeros][j - ones] + 1)。倒序保证本轮更新读到的是"还没放这个字符串"的旧值，从而每个字符串最多选一次。其中 L 为字符串的个数。
approaches.ideaEn: Each string is an item with two weights (its 0-count and 1-count) and value 1. dp[i][j] is the most strings choosable with at most i zeros and j ones. For each string, iterate both capacities downward and take dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[i-zeros][j-ones] + 1). Going downward means the read cell has not yet included this string, so each string is used at most once. Here L is the number of strings.

approaches.ideaZh: 顺时针旋转 90 度把 (i, j) 搬到 (j, n-1-i)。这个映射可以拆成两步：先沿主对角线转置，(i, j) 到 (j, i)；再把每一行左右翻转，(j, i) 到 (j, n-1-i)。两步都能原地完成：转置只交换 j > i 的一半，翻转每行用双指针。不需要额外矩阵，也不容易写错下标。
approaches.ideaEn: A clockwise quarter turn sends (i, j) to (j, n-1-i). Split it in two in-place steps: transpose across the main diagonal ((i, j) -> (j, i), swapping only j > i), then reverse every row ((j, i) -> (j, n-1-i)). No extra matrix and little index juggling.

approaches.ideaZh: 与其分别记录两个人的得分，不如只记录"当前先手比对手多拿多少"。设 d(i, j) 为剩余 nums[i..j] 时当前玩家能取得的最大净胜分：拿左端得 nums[i] 后轮到对手，对手在 [i+1, j] 上的净胜分要减掉，所以 d(i, j) = max(nums[i] - d(i+1, j), nums[j] - d(i, j-1))。这样对手也按最优策略行动，而不是被假设成某种固定贪心。按区间长度递增计算，可以压成一维数组；平局也算玩家 1 获胜，所以判断 d(0, n-1) ≥ 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Track only how far the player to move can get ahead. With d(i, j) the best margin on nums[i..j], taking the left end gives nums[i] minus the opponent's best margin on [i+1, j], so d(i, j) = max(nums[i] - d(i+1, j), nums[j] - d(i, j-1)). The opponent is thus modeled as optimal, not as a fixed greedy rule. Fill by increasing i from the right into a 1D array; player 1 wins ties, so answer d(0, n-1) >= 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 两个字符串互为字母异位词，当且仅当把它们的字母排序后完全相同。因此用排序后的字符串作为哈希表的键，把原串追加到对应分组里。最后把哈希表的所有值作为答案返回，组的顺序任意。每个串排序要 O(k log k)，k 为串长。
approaches.ideaEn: Two strings are anagrams exactly when their sorted letters match, so use the sorted string as a hash key and append each word to its group. Return the groups in any order. Sorting each word costs O(k log k).

approaches.ideaZh: 只含小写字母时，异位词的 26 个字母出现次数完全相同，于是可以用这 26 个计数组成的元组（或拼成字符串）作键，省掉排序。生成键只需 O(k + 26)，当字符串较长时比排序更快。注意键必须是不可变、能区分不同计数的形式，C++ 里可以把计数逐个编码成字符拼成字符串。
approaches.ideaEn: With only lowercase letters, anagrams share the same 26 letter counts, so a tuple of counts (or a string encoding of it) works as the key with no sorting. Building the key is O(k + 26), better than sorting for long words. In C++, encode each count as one char of a string key.

approaches.nameZh: 以停靠点为节点的 BFS
approaches.ideaZh: 球只有在撞墙后才会停下，也只有停下时才能换方向，所以图的节点应该是"球能停住的格子"，而不是路过的每个格子。从一个停靠点出发，朝四个方向各一直滚到下一格是墙或边界为止，得到最多四个相邻停靠点。对这些停靠点做 BFS（或 DFS），用 visited 去重，若某次停下的位置正好是终点就返回 true。只路过终点而停不下来不算。
approaches.ideaEn: The ball only stops at a wall, and can only turn when stopped, so graph nodes are stopping cells, not every cell rolled through. From a stop, roll in each of four directions until the next cell is a wall or outside, giving up to four neighbour stops. BFS over stops with a visited set; return true if a stop equals the destination. Merely passing through the destination does not count.

approaches.nameZh: 回溯 + 每层集合去重
approaches.nameEn: Backtracking with a per-level seen set
approaches.ideaZh: 按原下标顺序做回溯：dfs(start) 表示从 start 之后挑下一个元素接到路径末尾，只有不小于路径末尾的数才能接上。路径长度达到 2 就记录一份。由于数组没有排序，不能用"和前一个相等就跳过"的方式去重，而是在每一层开一个集合，记录这一层已经尝试过的值，同一层里相同的值只选一次。不同层之间可以重复使用相同的值，比如 [7,7]。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Backtrack in index order: dfs(start) appends some later element that is at least the current tail, and records the path once its length reaches 2. The array is unsorted, so the "skip if equal to previous" trick does not apply; instead each level keeps a set of values already tried there, so one value is chosen once per level. Equal values may still repeat across levels, as in [7,7]. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接建模：dfs(i, cur) 表示已经给前 i 个数定好符号、当前和为 cur 时，后面还有多少种方式凑到 target。每个数要么加要么减，两个分支相加。不同的符号组合会走到相同的 (i, cur)，用记忆化合并后，状态数只有 n × (2·sum + 1)。这个做法不依赖任何技巧，便于验证后面的代数变换。
approaches.ideaEn: Model it directly: dfs(i, cur) counts ways to finish from index i with running sum cur, branching on + or - for nums[i]. Different sign choices reach the same (i, cur), so memoization collapses the tree to n * (2*sum + 1) states. No trick needed, and it is a good check for the algebraic version.

approaches.nameZh: 代数变换 + 0/1 背包计数
approaches.ideaZh: 设取正号的数之和为 P，总和为 S，则取负号的和为 S - P，要求 P - (S - P) = target，即 P = (S + target) / 2。所以问题变成：从 nums 中选一个子集使其和恰为 P，有多少种选法。若 |target| > S 或 S + target 为奇数，直接返回 0。之后做 0/1 背包计数，容量倒序遍历；值为 0 的元素会让 dp[j] 翻倍，正好对应它取正或取负两种选择。
approaches.ideaEn: If the plus-signed numbers sum to P and the total is S, then P - (S - P) = target, so P = (S + target) / 2. The task becomes counting subsets with sum P. Return 0 when |target| > S or S + target is odd. Then run a 0/1 knapsack count with capacities descending; a zero doubles dp[j], matching its two sign choices.

approaches.ideaZh: nums1 的每个值都在 nums2 中出现，所以只需先求出 nums2 每个值的"下一个更大元素"，再按 nums1 查表。从右往左扫 nums2，维护一个从栈底到栈顶递减的栈：遇到 x 时，先弹掉所有不大于 x 的元素，它们被 x 挡住，以后不可能成为左侧任何数的答案。弹完后栈顶就是 x 右边第一个更大的数，栈空则为 -1，再把 x 压栈。值互不相同，所以可以用值作哈希表的键。
approaches.ideaEn: Every nums1 value appears in nums2, so compute the next greater element for every value of nums2 and look them up. Scan nums2 right to left with a decreasing stack: pop everything not larger than x (x hides them from anything further left); the remaining top is the answer for x, or -1 if empty; then push x. Values are distinct, so they can key the map.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i][j] 表示 s[i..j] 是否为回文。它成立当且仅当 s[i] == s[j]，并且内部 s[i+1..j-1] 也是回文（长度不超过 3 时内部自动成立）。dp[i][j] 依赖 dp[i+1][j-1]，所以 i 从大到小、j 从小到大填表。填表时顺手记录最长的那个区间的起点和长度，最后切出原串中的这一段。需要 O(n^2) 的表，空间偏大，但状态定义清楚。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i][j] say whether s[i..j] is a palindrome: it holds when s[i] == s[j] and the inside s[i+1..j-1] is a palindrome (automatic for length <= 3). Since dp[i][j] needs dp[i+1][j-1], fill i descending and j ascending, tracking the longest true interval, then slice it out. Clear but uses an O(n^2) table.

approaches.ideaZh: 每个回文串都有一个中心：奇数长度的中心是一个字符，偶数长度的中心是两个相邻字符之间，共 2n - 1 个中心。对每个中心向两边同时扩展，直到两端字符不同或越界，得到以它为中心的最长回文。所有中心里取最长的即可。最坏仍是 O(n^2)，但只用常数空间，常数也比 DP 小。
approaches.ideaEn: Every palindrome has a center: a character (odd length) or a gap between neighbours (even length), 2n - 1 centers in total. Expand outward from each while both ends match, and keep the longest span found. Still O(n^2) in the worst case, but constant space and a smaller constant than the DP.

approaches.nameZh: 按门槛排序 + 最大堆
approaches.nameEn: Sort by capital, max-heap of profits
approaches.ideaZh: 资金只增不减（利润非负），所以一个项目一旦"解锁"（capital ≤ 当前资金 w）就永远可选。把项目按启动资金升序排好，每一轮先把所有新解锁的项目的利润放进最大堆，再从堆里取利润最大的那个做掉、加到 w 上。在当前可选集合中选最大利润是安全的：它让资金最多，只会解锁更多项目。若某一轮堆为空，说明再也做不了项目，可以提前结束。
approaches.ideaEn: Capital never decreases, so once a project is affordable (capital <= w) it stays affordable. Sort projects by required capital; each round, push the profits of all newly unlocked projects into a max-heap, then take the largest profit and add it to w. Picking the max among available projects is safe because more capital only unlocks more. Stop early if the heap is empty.
approaches.time: O(n log n + k log n)

approaches.nameEn: Two passes with a monotonic stack of indices
approaches.ideaZh: 循环数组里，某个位置的下一个更大元素可能在它前面，等价于把数组接在自己后面再找一次。下标 i 从 0 走到 2n - 1，取值 nums[i % n]。栈里存还没找到答案的下标，对应的值从栈底到栈顶不增；新值比栈顶对应的值大时，就弹出并给它写上答案。只有第一轮（i < n）才把下标压栈，第二轮只负责回答，避免给不存在的"第二圈位置"写答案。最后仍留在栈里的就是全局最大值这类位置，答案保持 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: In a circular array the next greater value may lie before the index, which is the same as searching the array concatenated with itself. Walk i from 0 to 2n - 1 using nums[i % n]; the stack holds indices still waiting, with non-increasing values. A larger value pops them and fills their answers. Push only during the first lap (i < n); the second lap only answers. Indices left on the stack keep -1.

approaches.ideaZh: 和 The Maze 一样，节点是球能停住的格子，从一个停靠点沿某方向滚到下一个停靠点构成一条边。不同的是，这条边的权重是滚过的格子数，各边长短不一，所以普通 BFS 的"层数"不是距离，必须用 Dijkstra。用最小堆按已走距离取出停靠点，若比记录的距离大就跳过；第一次从堆中取出终点时，其距离就是答案。堆空仍未到达终点则返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: As in The Maze, nodes are stopping cells and a roll from one stop to the next is an edge. Here the edge weight is the number of cells rolled, which varies, so BFS levels are not distances and Dijkstra is needed. Pop stops from a min-heap by distance, skip stale entries, and return the distance the first time the destination is popped; return -1 if the heap runs out.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接按定义 F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) 递归，会在递归树里反复计算同一个 F(k)，调用次数呈指数增长。给递归加一个缓存，每个 F(k) 只算一次，之后直接查表，调用次数降到 O(n)。这是"重叠子问题"最直观的例子：时间从指数降到线性，代价是 O(n) 的缓存和递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Recursing straight from F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) recomputes the same F(k) over and over, so calls grow exponentially. Caching each F(k) the first time it is computed cuts the work to O(n) calls. It is the textbook overlapping-subproblems example: linear time for O(n) cache and stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 自底向上计算时，F(k) 只依赖前两项，因此不需要整张表，只保留两个变量 a = F(k)、b = F(k+1)。每走一步令 (a, b) = (b, a + b)，走 n 步后 a 就是 F(n)。时间仍是 O(n)，空间降为 O(1)，也没有递归栈。
approaches.ideaEn: Bottom-up, F(k) needs only the previous two values, so keep a = F(k) and b = F(k+1). Each step sets (a, b) = (b, a + b); after n steps a = F(n). Same O(n) time, O(1) space, no recursion stack.

approaches.nameZh: 逐行回溯 + 列/对角线标记
approaches.nameEn: Row-by-row backtracking with column and diagonal flags
approaches.ideaZh: 每行恰好放一个皇后，所以按行递归，第 r 层只决定第 r 行放在哪一列。冲突只可能来自三类：同一列、同一条主对角线（r - c 相同）、同一条副对角线（r + c 相同），用三个布尔数组记录它们是否被占。放下皇后前检查三者，放下后标记，递归返回后撤销。放满 n 行时，把每行的列号转成 "..Q." 形式的字符串加入答案。O(n) 空间不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Each row holds exactly one queen, so recurse by row and choose a column at level r. Conflicts come only from a shared column, a shared main diagonal (same r - c) or a shared anti-diagonal (same r + c); three boolean arrays track them. Check, mark, recurse, unmark. When all n rows are filled, render each row's column as a "..Q." string. The O(n) space excludes the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 要找的是最深一层里最靠左的节点。如果层序遍历时每层都先放右孩子、再放左孩子，那么整个遍历中最后一个出队的节点，一定在最深层，并且是这一层最左边的那个。因此不需要单独记录深度和每层第一个元素，遍历结束时手里的节点就是答案。题目保证树非空。空间里的 w 为树的最大层宽。
approaches.ideaEn: We want the leftmost node of the deepest level. If BFS enqueues the right child before the left, the very last node dequeued is on the deepest level and is its leftmost node. No depth bookkeeping is needed; the node in hand when the queue empties is the answer. The tree is guaranteed non-empty. Here w is the maximum width of a level.

approaches.nameEn: Interval DP with a rolling row
approaches.ideaZh: 子序列不要求连续，所以端点不匹配时可以跳过其中一端。设 f(i, j) 为 s[i..j] 中最长回文子序列的长度：若 s[i] == s[j]，两端都能用上，f(i, j) = f(i+1, j-1) + 2；否则丢掉一端，f(i, j) = max(f(i+1, j), f(i, j-1))。单个字符时 f(i, i) = 1。i 从右往左、j 从左往右计算；由于第 i 行只依赖第 i+1 行和本行左侧，可以用一维数组滚动，另用一个变量保存左下角的 f(i+1, j-1)。
approaches.ideaEn: Subsequences need not be contiguous, so a mismatched end can simply be dropped. With f(i, j) the answer on s[i..j]: if s[i] == s[j], f(i, j) = f(i+1, j-1) + 2; otherwise f(i, j) = max(f(i+1, j), f(i, j-1)); and f(i, i) = 1. Fill i right to left and j left to right. Row i only needs row i+1 and its own left cells, so one array plus a variable holding the diagonal f(i+1, j-1) suffices.

approaches.nameZh: 完全背包计数（硬币在外层）
approaches.nameEn: Unbounded knapsack count, coins in the outer loop
approaches.ideaZh: dp[j] 表示凑出金额 j 的组合数，dp[0] = 1。外层遍历硬币，内层金额从小到大：dp[j] += dp[j - coin]。正序内层让同一枚硬币可以被重复使用（完全背包）；硬币放在外层，意味着每种组合都是按硬币种类的固定顺序"先用完第一种、再用第二种"生成的，于是 1+2 和 2+1 只被数一次。如果把两层循环交换，数的就变成排列数了。C++ 中间值可能超过 int，用无符号数累加，最终答案保证在 32 位内，所以按模 2^32 计算也不影响结果。
approaches.ideaEn: dp[j] counts combinations summing to j, with dp[0] = 1. Loop coins outside and amounts inside, ascending: dp[j] += dp[j - coin]. Ascending lets a coin repeat (unbounded knapsack); coins outside means each combination is built in a fixed coin order, so 1+2 and 2+1 count once. Swapping the loops would count permutations instead. In C++ intermediate values can exceed int, so accumulate in unsigned; the final answer fits in 32 bits, so arithmetic mod 2^32 is still exact.

approaches.ideaZh: 只需要方案数，就不必保存棋盘，三类冲突可以压成三个整数位掩码：cols 表示已占的列，d1、d2 表示从上一行传下来的两类对角线在本行上被攻击的列。本行可放的位置是 ~(cols | d1 | d2) 与全 1 掩码的交集，用 x & -x 逐个取出最低位。放下后递归下一行：对角线掩码分别左移、右移一位，表示攻击范围斜着移动到下一行。cols 填满 n 位时计数加一。
approaches.ideaEn: Only the count is needed, so drop the board and keep three bitmasks: occupied columns, and the columns attacked on this row by each diagonal family. Free cells are ~(cols | d1 | d2) masked to n bits; peel them off with x & -x. Recurse with the diagonal masks shifted left and right by one, which moves the attacks down a row. A full cols mask counts one solution.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和余数 + 最早下标
approaches.ideaZh: 子数组 nums[j+1..i] 的和是 k 的倍数，等价于前缀和 S[i] 与 S[j] 对 k 取余相同。用哈希表记录每个余数第一次出现的下标，并预置余数 0 对应下标 -1（空前缀）。扫到 i 时如果当前余数已经出现过，且两下标距离至少为 2，就说明存在长度不小于 2 的合法子数组。表里只保留最早位置，因为它能让区间最长；遇到重复余数但距离不够时不要覆盖它。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray sum is a multiple of k exactly when the two prefix sums bounding it leave the same remainder mod k. Store the first index of each remainder, seeding remainder 0 at index -1 for the empty prefix. When the current remainder was seen at least two positions earlier, a valid subarray of length >= 2 exists. Keep only the earliest index, since it gives the longest candidate.

approaches.nameZh: 0 记为 -1 + 前缀和最早位置
approaches.ideaZh: 把 0 看成 -1、1 看成 +1，“0 和 1 个数相等”就变成“区间和为 0”，也就是两个前缀和相等。记录每个前缀和第一次出现的下标，初始前缀和 0 出现在 -1。之后每到一个位置，若当前前缀和出现过，用当前下标减去最早下标更新答案；否则记下它。前缀和取值只在 [-n, n]，C++ 里可以用偏移 n 的数组代替哈希表。
approaches.ideaEn: Treat 0 as -1 and 1 as +1; a balanced subarray is then one with sum 0, i.e. two equal prefix sums. Record the first index of each prefix sum (sum 0 at index -1). At each position, if the current sum was seen before, the gap to its first occurrence is a candidate length. Sums stay in [-n, n], so an offset array works instead of a hash map.

approaches.nameEn: Prefix sum minus smallest earlier prefix
approaches.ideaZh: 以 i 结尾的子数组和等于 S[i] 减去某个更早的前缀和，想让它最大，就减去此前出现过的最小前缀和。从左到右维护当前前缀和 pre 与历史最小前缀 low（初始为空前缀 0）。每一步先用 pre - low 更新答案，再更新 low，顺序不能反，否则会得到空子数组。全是负数时答案就是最大的那个元素，这个写法自然覆盖。
approaches.ideaEn: The best subarray ending at i is the prefix sum at i minus the smallest prefix sum before it. Track the running prefix and the minimum earlier prefix (starting at the empty prefix 0). Update the answer with pre - low before updating low, so the subarray is never empty. An all-negative array correctly yields its largest element.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 cur 为以当前元素结尾的最大子数组和。对新元素 x，要么接在前面的子数组后面得到 cur + x，要么从 x 重新开始，二者取大。如果 cur 已经是负数，接上它只会拖累，所以等价于“前缀为负就丢弃”。全程记录 cur 的最大值即可。
approaches.ideaEn: Let cur be the best sum of a subarray ending at the current element. For each x, either extend (cur + x) or restart at x, whichever is larger; a negative running sum is never worth keeping. The answer is the maximum cur seen.

approaches.ideaZh: 二叉搜索树的中序遍历是升序序列，而升序序列中差值最小的一对一定相邻。所以只要中序遍历一遍，记住上一个访问的节点，用当前值减去它更新答案。前驱要用“是否存在”来判断而不是用 0 之类的哨兵，因为节点值本身可能为 0。这里用显式栈做迭代中序，避免深树递归过深。
approaches.ideaEn: An in-order walk of a BST visits values in ascending order, and the closest pair in a sorted list is always adjacent. Walk in order, remember the previous node, and update the answer with the difference. Use an explicit "has previous" check rather than a numeric sentinel, since values can be 0. An explicit stack avoids deep recursion.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def getMinimumDifference(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        best, prev = float('inf'), None
        stack, node = [], root
        while stack or node:
            while node:
                stack.append(node)
                node = node.left
            node = stack.pop()
            if prev is not None:
                best = min(best, node.val - prev)
            prev = node.val
            node = node.right
        return best

approaches.ideaZh: 每个节点的新值是“所有大于等于它的值之和”。按 右 → 根 → 左 的顺序遍历 BST，访问顺序恰好是从大到小。维护一个累加和 total，访问到节点时先把它的值加进 total，再把节点值改成 total。遍历方向决定了累加状态的含义：正向中序累加的是更小的值，反向才是更大的值。
approaches.ideaEn: Each node becomes the sum of all values >= its own. Visiting right, node, left walks the BST in descending order, so keep a running total, add the node value to it, and write the total back. The traversal direction is what makes the running sum mean "everything larger".
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def convertBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        total = 0

        def visit(node):
            nonlocal total
            if node:
                visit(node.right)
                total += node.val
                node.val = total
                visit(node.left)

        visit(root)
        return root

approaches.ideaZh: 在单独元素之前，每一对相同的数都占据 (偶数, 奇数) 两个下标；单独元素出现之后，配对整体右移一位，变成 (奇数, 偶数)。所以只看偶数下标 mid：若 nums[mid] == nums[mid+1]，说明左边还是完整配对，答案在 mid+2 及右边；否则答案在 mid 或左边。始终让 lo、hi、mid 保持偶数，区间收缩到一个点就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Before the single element, every pair starts at an even index; after it, pairs start at odd indices. Probe an even mid: if nums[mid] equals nums[mid+1], the left part is fully paired and the answer is at mid+2 or later; otherwise it is at mid or earlier. Keeping lo, hi and mid even, the range shrinks to the answer.

approaches.ideaZh: 从每个 1 出发各做一次 BFS 会重复大量工作，反过来想：把所有 0 同时作为起点放进队列，距离设为 0。BFS 按层向外扩展，某个格子第一次被访问时的层数就是它到最近 0 的距离。用 -1 标记未访问格子，每个格子只入队一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of a BFS from every 1, start one BFS from all zeros at once with distance 0. BFS expands layer by layer, so the first time a cell is reached, its layer is the distance to the nearest zero. Mark unvisited cells with -1 so each cell is queued once.

approaches.ideaZh: 离某个格子最近的 0，要么在它的左上方向，要么在右下方向。第一遍从左上往右下扫，只用上方和左方邻居更新：d = min(d, 上+1, 左+1)。第二遍从右下往左上扫，再用下方和右方邻居更新。两遍结束后每个格子都综合了四个方向的信息，除输出外不需要额外队列。
approaches.ideaEn: The nearest zero lies either up/left or down/right of a cell. Sweep top-left to bottom-right relaxing from the top and left neighbors, then sweep bottom-right to top-left relaxing from the bottom and right neighbors. After both passes every cell has seen all four directions, with no queue needed. Extra space beyond the output is O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 后序 DFS：高度与直径分开
approaches.ideaZh: 经过某个节点的最长路径 = 左子树高度 + 右子树高度（按边数计）。但返回给父节点的只能是一条单支，也就是 1 + max(左高, 右高)。所以 DFS 返回高度，同时在每个节点用 左高 + 右高 更新全局直径。直径不一定经过根，这正是需要全局变量的原因。
approaches.ideaEn: The longest path through a node is left height plus right height (in edges). The parent can only use one branch, so the DFS returns 1 + max(left, right) while updating a global best with left + right at every node. The diameter need not pass through the root, hence the global.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def diameterOfBinaryTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        best = 0

        def height(node):
            nonlocal best
            if not node:
                return 0
            l, r = height(node.left), height(node.right)
            best = max(best, l + r)
            return 1 + max(l, r)

        height(root)
        return best

approaches.nameZh: 拆成三段：左边界、叶子、逆序右边界
approaches.nameEn: Three parts: left edge, leaves, reversed right edge
approaches.ideaZh: 边界按逆时针顺序由四部分拼成：根、左边界（不含叶子）、所有叶子（从左到右）、右边界（不含叶子，自底向上）。左边界从 root.left 出发，能往左走就往左，否则往右，遇到叶子就停；右边界对称。叶子用先左后右的 DFS 收集，左右边界都排除叶子，就不会重复计数。根本身若是叶子，只输出它一个。
approaches.ideaEn: The boundary is the root, the left edge without leaves, all leaves left to right, then the right edge without leaves in reverse. Walk the left edge from root.left preferring left children and stop at a leaf; the right edge is symmetric. Collect leaves with a left-first DFS. Excluding leaves from both edges avoids duplicates; a lone root is returned by itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 城市是点，isConnected[i][j] = 1 是边，省份就是连通分量。依次检查每个城市，若还没访问过，就计数加一，并用栈做 DFS 把它所在的整个分量都标记掉。邻接矩阵下找邻居需要扫一整行，所以总复杂度是 n²。
approaches.ideaEn: Cities are vertices and isConnected marks edges, so provinces are connected components. For each unvisited city, count a new component and flood it with an iterative DFS. Scanning a matrix row per vertex makes it O(n^2).

approaches.ideaZh: 一开始每个城市自成一个集合，分量数为 n。遍历矩阵上三角，遇到相连的两个城市就合并它们所在的集合；如果原本不在同一集合，分量数减一。find 时做路径压缩，让树保持很矮。并查集的好处是边可以按任意顺序到来，适合在线合并的场景。
approaches.ideaEn: Start with n singleton sets. For every connected pair in the upper triangle, union their sets and decrement the count when they were separate. Path compression keeps find nearly constant. Union-Find handles edges in any order, which also suits online merging.

approaches.ideaZh: 从左往右扫，维护目前能到达的最远下标 reach。走到下标 i 时，若 i > reach，说明 i 根本到不了，后面也就到不了，直接返回 false。否则用 i + nums[i] 更新 reach。能扫完整个数组就说明最后一个位置可达。不需要关心具体怎么跳，只关心可达范围是不是连续覆盖到了终点。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right keeping the farthest reachable index. If the current index lies beyond it, nothing further is reachable, so return false; otherwise extend the reach with i + nums[i]. Finishing the scan means the last index is reachable. Only the covered range matters, not the actual jumps.

approaches.ideaZh: 竖线穿过的砖块数 = 总行数 - 竖线恰好落在缝隙上的行数，所以要找被最多行共享的缝隙位置。对每一行累加砖块宽度，得到每条内部缝隙距离左边的位置，用哈希表计数；最后一块砖的右边是墙的边缘，不能算。答案是行数减去最大计数，若没有任何内部缝隙则是行数本身。
approaches.ideaEn: Bricks crossed = rows minus rows whose gap the line passes through, so find the gap position shared by the most rows. Accumulate brick widths per row and count each inner gap offset in a hash map, skipping the wall edge after the last brick. The answer is rows minus the best count (or all rows if there is no inner gap).

approaches.ideaZh: 按起点排序后，能合并的区间一定在序列里连续出现。维护结果中最后一个区间：如果当前区间的起点不超过它的终点，就有重叠（端点相接也算），把终点更新为两者较大值；否则当前区间独立成段，直接追加。终点要取 max，因为被包含的短区间不能把终点缩短。O(n) 空间用于输出，不计排序开销。
approaches.ideaEn: After sorting by start, intervals that merge appear consecutively. Compare each interval with the last merged one: if its start is at most that end (touching counts), extend the end to the max of both; otherwise start a new block. Taking the max matters when one interval is nested inside another. The O(n) space holds the output, not counting the sort.

approaches.nameZh: 前缀和 + 频次哈希表
approaches.nameEn: Prefix sums with a frequency map
approaches.ideaZh: 子数组 (j, i] 的和为 k，等价于 S[i] - S[j] = k，即 S[j] = S[i] - k。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个前缀和已经出现了多少次（空前缀 0 预置一次）。每到一个位置，答案加上 S[i] - k 的出现次数，然后再把 S[i] 记进表。数组有负数，滑动窗口不适用；前缀和可能重复，所以必须记次数而不是下标。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray (j, i] sums to k exactly when S[j] = S[i] - k. Scan once, counting how many times each prefix sum has occurred (the empty prefix once). Add the count of S[i] - k to the answer, then record S[i]. Negative numbers rule out a sliding window, and repeated prefix sums are why we store counts.

approaches.nameZh: 定长滑动窗口 + 频次比较
approaches.ideaZh: s2 包含 s1 的某个排列，等价于 s2 中存在一个长度为 len(s1) 的子串，其字母频次与 s1 完全相同。先统计 s1 的 26 个字母频次，再在 s2 上滑动同样长度的窗口：右端进一个字符就加一，左端出一个字符就减一。每次窗口长度到位后比较两个频次数组，相等就立即返回 true。比较 26 个数是常数开销。
approaches.ideaEn: A permutation of s1 occurs in s2 exactly when some window of length len(s1) has the same letter counts as s1. Count s1, slide a window of that length over s2, adding the entering letter and removing the leaving one. Compare the two 26-entry arrays at each step and return as soon as they match.

approaches.ideaZh: 原区间已按起点排序且互不重叠，所以相对于新区间 [s, e] 可分成三段：完全在左边的（终点 < s），与之相交的，完全在右边的（起点 > e）。第一段原样放入结果；第二段不断把 s 取最小、e 取最大，合并成一个区间后放入；第三段原样接在后面。每个区间只看一次，不需要再排序。O(n) 空间就是输出本身。
approaches.ideaEn: The intervals are sorted and disjoint, so relative to the new interval [s, e] they split into three runs: those ending before s, those overlapping it, and those starting after e. Copy the first run, fold the overlapping run into [min start, max end] and append it, then copy the rest. One pass, no sorting. The O(n) space is the output itself.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举候选根 + 判断两树相同
approaches.ideaZh: 把问题拆成两个递归职责：same(a, b) 判断两棵树是否完全相同；dfs(node) 负责遍历 root 的每个节点，把它当作候选根去和 subRoot 比较。只要某个候选根 same 成立就返回 true。最坏情况下每个节点都要做一次接近完整的比较，复杂度是 O(m·n)，但思路最直接、最不容易写错。
approaches.ideaEn: Split into two recursions: same(a, b) checks two trees for exact equality, and dfs walks every node of root, trying it as a candidate root against subRoot. Any match returns true. Worst case each node triggers a near-full comparison, O(m·n), but it is the most direct version.

approaches.nameZh: 先序序列化 + 字符串匹配
approaches.ideaZh: 把两棵树都按先序序列化，空孩子写成 #，每个值前后都用逗号隔开。带上空标记后，先序串能唯一确定一棵树，而子树恰好对应大串里一段连续的子串；逗号边界保证 “2” 不会误匹配 “12” 或 “-2”。于是问题变成字符串匹配，用 KMP（Python 的 in 也是线性级别）可在线性时间完成。
approaches.ideaEn: Serialize both trees in pre-order with # for null children and commas around every token.
