approaches.nameEn: Reverse the second half of the digits
approaches.ideaZh: 负数一定不是回文；末位是 0 的正数也不是（因为首位不可能是 0）。其余情况不转字符串，而是不断把 x 的末位挪到 rev 上，直到 rev ≥ x，此时正好处理了一半的数字。偶数位时要求 x == rev，奇数位时中间那位落在 rev 的末尾，比较 x == rev // 10。只反转一半还顺带避免了整数溢出。
approaches.ideaEn: Negatives are never palindromes, nor are positives ending in 0. Otherwise peel digits off x onto rev until rev >= x, which processes half the digits. Even length needs x == rev; odd length leaves the middle digit at the end of rev, so compare x == rev // 10. Reversing only half also sidesteps overflow.

approaches.nameZh: 排序 + 回溯（同层去重）
approaches.ideaZh: 先排序，让相同的数挨在一起。回溯时每进入一层，就把当前路径记为一个子集，然后从 start 开始选下一个数。去重的关键是“同一层不选相同的值”：如果 i > start 且 nums[i] == nums[i-1]，说明这个值在本层已经作为分支开头试过了，跳过即可。不同层选相同的值是允许的，所以 [2,2] 这样的子集不会丢。O(n) 是递归深度，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort so equal values are adjacent. Each recursive call records the current path as a subset, then tries each next element from start. Skip nums[i] when i > start and it equals nums[i-1]: that value already started a branch at this level. Equal values at different depths are still allowed, so subsets like [2,2] survive. The O(n) space is the recursion depth, excluding the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 题目等价于：求最长的、最多只包含两种不同数字的连续子数组。右指针每次纳入一个水果并计数，一旦窗口里出现第三种水果，就移动左指针并减少计数，直到某种水果的数量减到 0 被删掉。每一步窗口都是合法的，用它的长度更新答案。左右指针都只向右走，所以是线性时间。
approaches.ideaEn: Find the longest subarray with at most two distinct values. Extend the right end and count each fruit; when a third kind appears, advance the left end, decrementing counts until one kind disappears. The window is then valid and its length is a candidate. Both pointers only move right.

approaches.nameZh: 单调栈计算每个元素的贡献
approaches.nameEn: Monotonic stack: count each element's contribution
approaches.ideaZh: 换个角度：不枚举子数组，而是问每个 arr[i] 作为最小值出现在多少个子数组里。设它左边第一个不大于它的位置是 L、右边第一个严格小于它的位置是 R，那么它是 (i - L) × (R - i) 个子数组的最小值，贡献 arr[i] 乘以这个数。左右一边取“不大于”、一边取“严格小于”，是为了让相等元素只被计一次。用单调递增栈一次扫描即可：元素被弹出时，弹出它的下标就是 R，新的栈顶就是 L；在末尾加一个 0 作为哨兵把栈清空。
approaches.ideaEn: Instead of enumerating subarrays, count how many subarrays have arr[i] as their minimum. With L the previous index holding a value <= arr[i] and R the next index holding a value < arr[i], that count is (i - L) × (R - i). Using <= on one side and < on the other counts ties exactly once. An increasing stack finds both: when an index is popped, the popper is R and the new top is L. A trailing 0 sentinel flushes the stack.

approaches.ideaZh: 每掷一次骰子算一步，所以求最少步数就是在方格编号 1..n² 上做 BFS。难点在于“牛耕式”编号：编号 s 对应的行是从底往上数第 (s-1)/n 行，偶数行从左到右、奇数行从右到左，写一个函数把编号换成 board 坐标。从当前格子出发尝试 s+1 到 s+6，若落点有蛇或梯子就直接跳到目的地（只跳一次，不连跳）。第一次到达 n² 时的步数就是答案，队列空了还没到就返回 -1。
approaches.ideaEn: Each roll is one move, so BFS over square numbers 1..n². The tricky part is the boustrophedon layout: square s sits in row (s-1)/n counted from the bottom, left-to-right on even rows and right-to-left on odd ones. From s try s+1..s+6, following a snake or ladder once if present. The BFS depth at n² is the answer, or -1 if unreachable.

approaches.nameEn: Linear DP with two rolling variables
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[i] 为前 i 个字符的解码方法数，dp[0] = 1。第 i 个字符单独解码时，它不能是 '0'，贡献 dp[i-1]；和前一个字符合成两位数解码时，这个两位数要在 10 到 26 之间，贡献 dp[i-2]。两种情况相加就是 dp[i]。因为只依赖前两项，用两个变量滚动即可。注意 '0' 只能作为 10 或 20 的一部分出现，否则方法数会变成 0。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[i] be the number of decodings of the first i characters, dp[0] = 1. Taking the last character alone works if it is not '0' and adds dp[i-1]; taking the last two works if they form 10..26 and adds dp[i-2]. Only two previous values matter, so roll them in two variables. A '0' that is not part of 10 or 20 drives the count to 0.

approaches.ideaZh: 这道题考的是自己实现 O(n log n) 排序，不能直接调库。归并排序把数组从中间一分为二，递归排好两半，再用双指针把两个有序数组合并成一个。合并时取相等元素的左边那个，保证排序稳定。无论输入是否有序、是否有大量重复，时间都稳定在 O(n log n)，代价是需要 O(n) 的辅助空间。
approaches.ideaEn: The point is to hand-roll an O(n log n) sort. Merge sort splits the array in half, sorts each half recursively, and merges the two sorted halves with two pointers, taking the left element on ties for stability. Its running time does not depend on input order or duplicates; the cost is O(n) extra space.

approaches.ideaZh: 如果想要 O(1) 的额外空间，可以用堆排序。先自底向上把整个数组调整成大根堆，堆顶就是最大值。然后反复把堆顶和当前末尾交换，把末尾“移出”堆，再对新堆顶做一次下沉恢复堆性质。每次下沉 O(log n)，共 n 次，所以总时间 O(n log n)，但它不稳定，且访问内存不连续，实际常数比归并大。
approaches.ideaEn: For O(1) extra space, use heap sort. Heapify the whole array bottom-up into a max-heap, then repeatedly swap the root with the last element of the heap, shrink the heap by one, and sift the new root down. Each sift costs O(log n), so the total is O(n log n). It is not stable and has worse cache behavior than merge sort.

approaches.nameZh: 首尾双指针跳过非字母
approaches.ideaZh: 用左右两个指针从两端往中间走。左指针遇到非字母就右移，右指针遇到非字母就左移，两边都停在字母上时交换并各走一步。非字母字符从未被移动过，所以天然留在原位。Python 中字符串不可变，先转成列表再交换。O(1) 指 C++ 的额外空间；Python 的字符列表需要 O(n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk two pointers inward from both ends. Each pointer skips non-letters; when both rest on letters, swap and step both. Non-letters are never touched, so they stay in place. In Python, swap inside a list since strings are immutable. O(1) is the extra space in C++; the Python char list takes O(n).

approaches.nameZh: Kadane 求最大与最小子数组和
approaches.nameEn: Kadane for both max and min subarray sums
approaches.ideaZh: 环形数组的最优子数组只有两种形态：不跨越首尾，就是普通的最大子数组和；跨越首尾，那么没被选中的部分是中间一段连续子数组，要让选中的和最大，就要让中间那段的和最小，即总和减去最小子数组和。一次遍历同时用 Kadane 算出最大和、最小和与总和。特殊情况是所有数都为负：此时最小子数组就是整个数组，“总和 - 最小和”对应空数组，不合法，应直接返回最大和。
approaches.ideaEn: The best circular subarray either stays inside the array (ordinary max subarray) or wraps around, in which case the excluded middle part is a contiguous subarray with minimum sum, giving total - minSum. One pass of Kadane tracks max, min and total together. If every number is negative, total - minSum corresponds to an empty pick, so return maxSum in that case.

approaches.nameZh: 哑节点 + 头插法一次遍历
approaches.nameEn: Dummy node + head insertion in one pass
approaches.ideaZh: 先放一个哑节点接在 head 前面，这样 left = 1 时也不用特判。指针 pre 走 left - 1 步，停在待反转区间的前一个节点，cur 指向区间第一个节点。接下来重复 right - left 次：把 cur 后面的那个节点摘下来，插到 pre 的正后方。每插一次，区间前缀就多反转一个节点，而 cur 始终是原来的第一个节点、一路被推到区间末尾。全程只改指针，不需要额外数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Put a dummy node before head so that left = 1 needs no special case. Walk pre to the node just before the range; cur is the first node of the range. Repeat right - left times: unlink the node after cur and splice it in right after pre. Each move reverses one more node of the range while cur drifts to the end. Only pointers change, no extra storage.
approaches.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseBetween(self, head: Optional[ListNode], left: int, right: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        pre = dummy
        for _ in range(left - 1):
            pre = pre.next
        cur = pre.next
        for _ in range(right - left):
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = nxt.next
            nxt.next = pre.next
            pre.next = nxt
        return dummy.next

approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右扫描，用 open 记录还没配上的左括号数。遇到左括号 open 加一；遇到右括号时，如果手里有未配对的左括号就消掉一个，否则这个右括号注定无法配对，必须在前面补一个左括号，计数 add 加一。扫描结束后，剩下的 open 个左括号各需要补一个右括号。答案就是 add + open。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right and keep open, the number of unmatched "(". A "(" increments it. A ")" cancels one pending "(" if any; otherwise it can never be matched, so we must insert a "(" (add += 1). After the scan, each leftover "(" needs one ")". The answer is add + open.

approaches.nameZh: 枚举分界点 + 前缀和
approaches.nameEn: Enumerate the split point with prefix counts
approaches.ideaZh: 单调递增的结果一定是「若干个 0 + 若干个 1」，所以只要枚举 0 和 1 的分界位置 i（0 到 n 共 n+1 种）。分界左边的 1 都要翻成 0，右边的 0 都要翻成 1。先数出整个串里 0 的个数，然后从左到右推进分界点，同时维护左侧 1 的数量和右侧 0 的数量，每个位置 O(1) 算出代价，取最小值。
approaches.ideaEn: A monotone string is some 0s followed by some 1s, so try every split point i from 0 to n. Every 1 left of the split must flip to 0 and every 0 right of it must flip to 1. Count the zeros once, then sweep the split from left to right while maintaining "ones on the left" and "zeros on the right"; each split costs O(1) to evaluate.

approaches.ideaZh: 设 flips 为把当前前缀变成单调递增的最少翻转次数，ones 为前缀里 1 的个数。读到 1 时直接接在末尾仍然单调，flips 不变，只让 ones 加一。读到 0 时有两种选择：把这个 0 翻成 1，代价 flips + 1；或者让它保持 0，那么前面所有的 1 都得翻成 0，代价 ones。取两者较小值即可，只用两个变量。
approaches.ideaEn: Let flips be the minimum flips for the current prefix and ones the number of 1s in it. A 1 can always be appended, so only ones grows. A 0 either gets flipped to 1 (flips + 1) or stays 0, which forces every earlier 1 to become 0 (ones). Take the smaller of the two; two variables suffice.

approaches.ideaZh: 从下标 i 开始，依次尝试截取长度 1、2、3 的一段作为下一个 IP 段。一段合法的条件是：不能有前导零（长度大于 1 时首字符不能是 0），数值不超过 255。一旦当前长度不合法，更长的也不可能合法，可以直接停止。凑满 4 段时，只有恰好用完整个字符串才算一个答案。由于最多 4 层、每层 3 个分支，搜索规模是常数级。
approaches.ideaEn: From index i, try taking 1, 2 or 3 characters as the next segment. A segment is valid if it has no leading zero (unless it is exactly "0") and its value is at most 255; once a length fails, longer ones fail too, so we stop early. After 4 segments, record the address only if the whole string is consumed. With at most 4 levels and 3 branches each, the search is constant-sized.

approaches.ideaZh: 子数组 [l, r] 的和等于 pre[r+1] - pre[l]。从左到右遍历，维护当前前缀和 s，并用哈希表记录每个前缀和出现过几次。以当前位置结尾、和为 goal 的子数组个数，就是之前出现过多少次前缀和 s - goal。初始时前缀和 0 出现一次。这个方法不依赖元素只有 0 和 1，任何整数数组都适用。
approaches.ideaEn: The sum of a subarray is the difference of two prefix sums. Sweep once, keep the running sum s and a count of every prefix sum seen so far. Subarrays ending here with sum goal correspond to earlier prefixes equal to s - goal. Seed the map with prefix 0 seen once. This works for any integer array, not just 0/1.

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口：至多 goal 减至多 goal-1
approaches.ideaZh: 因为元素非负，窗口右端扩张时和只增不减，可以用双指针求「和不超过 k 的子数组个数」：右端每走一步，左端收缩到窗口和不超过 k，此时以右端结尾的合法子数组有 r - l + 1 个。恰好等于 goal 的个数 = 至多 goal 的个数 - 至多 goal - 1 的个数。k 为负数时直接返回 0。这样把额外空间降到了常数。
approaches.ideaEn: Elements are non-negative, so a two-pointer window can count subarrays with sum at most k: for each right end, shrink the left until the sum is at most k, then add r - l + 1. Exactly goal equals atMost(goal) minus atMost(goal - 1); atMost of a negative bound is 0. Extra space drops to O(1).

approaches.nameZh: 逐行动态规划（滚动数组）
approaches.nameEn: Row-by-row DP with a rolling row
approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[j] 为落到当前行第 j 列的最小路径和。第一行就是矩阵本身；之后每一行，(i, j) 只能从上一行的 j-1、j、j+1 三列下来，所以 dp 新值等于 matrix[i][j] 加上这三个位置（越界的忽略）里的最小值。每行只依赖上一行，用一个数组滚动即可。最后一行 dp 的最小值就是答案。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[j] be the cheapest path ending at column j of the current row. The first row is the matrix itself. Cell (i, j) can only come from columns j-1, j, j+1 of the previous row, so its value is matrix[i][j] plus the minimum of those (ignoring out-of-range ones). Each row depends only on the previous one, so one rolling array is enough; the answer is the minimum of the last row.

approaches.nameZh: DFS 标记一座岛 + 多源 BFS 扩张
approaches.nameEn: Flood-fill one island, then multi-source BFS
approaches.ideaZh: 先找到任意一个 1，用 DFS（这里用显式栈）把它所在的整座岛标记成 2，同时把这些格子全部放进 BFS 队列。然后以整座岛为起点做多源 BFS，一层一层向外扩张到水面，每扩一层代表多填一格。第一次碰到值为 1 的格子时，说明碰到了另一座岛，此时的层数就是需要填的最少格子数。每个格子最多进队一次。
approaches.ideaEn: Find any land cell and flood-fill its whole island (an explicit stack here), marking it 2 and pushing every cell into a queue. Then BFS outward from the entire island at once, one layer per step, turning water into visited cells. The first time we touch a cell equal to 1 we have reached the other island, and the current layer count is the number of cells to flip. Each cell is enqueued at most once.

approaches.nameZh: 利用 BST 性质剪枝的 DFS
approaches.nameEn: DFS pruned by the BST property
approaches.ideaZh: 对当前节点分三种情况。若节点值小于 low，它和它的整棵左子树都不在范围内，只需要去右子树找；若节点值大于 high，同理只去左子树找。否则节点值在范围内，把它计入答案，并且左右子树都可能有符合条件的节点，两边都要递归。剪枝让我们跳过整片不可能的子树。
approaches.ideaEn: At each node there are three cases. If its value is below low, it and its entire left subtree are out of range, so only the right subtree matters; if it is above high, only the left subtree matters. Otherwise the value counts toward the sum and both subtrees may contribute. The pruning skips whole subtrees that cannot be in range.

approaches.nameEn: Iterative traversal with an explicit stack
approaches.ideaZh: 中序是「左、根、右」。用一个栈模拟递归：从当前节点出发一路往左走，把经过的节点都压栈；走到空时弹出栈顶，它就是下一个该访问的节点，记录它的值，然后转向它的右子树重复同样的过程。栈里最多同时存放一条从根到叶的路径，所以空间是树高。
approaches.ideaEn: Inorder is left, node, right. Simulate the recursion with a stack: from the current node keep going left, pushing every node passed. When you hit null, pop the top: it is the next node in order, so record it and continue from its right child. The stack never holds more than one root-to-leaf path.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def inorderTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res, stack, cur = [], [], root
        while cur or stack:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            res.append(cur.val)
            cur = cur.right
        return res

approaches.ideaZh: Morris 遍历借用叶子节点空着的右指针来代替栈。对当前节点 cur：如果没有左子树，直接访问它并走向右子树；如果有左子树，找到左子树中最右的节点（中序前驱）。若前驱的右指针为空，就让它指回 cur，然后进入左子树；若前驱的右指针已经指向 cur，说明左子树已经遍历完，把指针恢复为空、访问 cur，再走向右子树。每条边最多被走两次，遍历结束时树结构完全复原。
approaches.ideaEn: Morris traversal replaces the stack with temporary links stored in unused right pointers. If cur has no left child, visit it and go right. Otherwise find its inorder predecessor (rightmost node of the left subtree). If that node’s right pointer is empty, point it back at cur and descend left; if it already points to cur, the left subtree is done, so remove the link, visit cur and go right. Each edge is walked at most twice and the tree is restored at the end.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def inorderTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        res, cur = [], root
        while cur:
            if not cur.left:
                res.append(cur.val)
                cur = cur.right
                continue
            pre = cur.left
            while pre.right and pre.right is not cur:
                pre = pre.right
            if pre.right is None:
                pre.right = cur
                cur = cur.left
            else:
                pre.right = None
                res.append(cur.val)
                cur = cur.right
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Sort, then greedily bump each value
approaches.ideaZh: 排序后从小到大处理，维护变量 nxt 表示「下一个还没被占用的最小值」。当前数 x 只能变大，所以它最终取 max(x, nxt) 是最省的：如果 x 已经大于等于 nxt，就保持不变；否则把它抬到 nxt，代价是 nxt - x。处理完后 nxt 更新为该数最终值加一。由于排序后后面的数不会更小，这样的贪心不会让后面付出额外代价。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort the array and keep nxt, the smallest value not yet taken. Each number can only grow, so its cheapest final value is max(x, nxt): keep x if it is already free, otherwise raise it to nxt at a cost of nxt - x. Then nxt becomes that final value plus one. Because later numbers are never smaller, this choice never hurts them. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 直接模拟入栈出栈过程。按 pushed 的顺序依次把元素压入栈，每压入一个，就检查栈顶是否等于 popped 中下一个待弹出的元素，相等就一直弹出并让指针后移。因为元素互不相同，能弹的时候立刻弹一定不会更差。全部压完后，如果 popped 也恰好全部匹配完（栈为空），序列就合法。
approaches.ideaEn: Replay the operations. Push elements of pushed in order, and after each push keep popping while the top equals the next element of popped, advancing that pointer. Since values are distinct, popping as soon as possible is never worse. The sequence is valid exactly when the stack is empty at the end.

approaches.ideaZh: 要用最少的能量换分，就该朝上翻最便宜的令牌；要用 1 分换回最多的能量，就该朝下翻最贵的令牌。所以先排序，左指针指向最便宜的，右指针指向最贵的。能量够就翻左边换 1 分并更新最高分；能量不够但手里有分、且还剩至少两张令牌时，就翻右边换能量；否则结束。注意答案取过程中的最高分，因为最后一次换能量可能是亏的。额外空间为 O(1)，不计排序本身的开销。
approaches.ideaEn: To gain a point for the least power, play the cheapest token face up; to turn a point into the most power, play the most expensive token face down. Sort, then use a left pointer for cheap tokens and a right pointer for expensive ones. If power allows, take the left token for a point and update the best score; otherwise, if we have a point and at least two tokens remain, trade the right token for power; otherwise stop. Track the best score seen, since a final trade may be a loss. Extra space is O(1), not counting the sort itself.

approaches.nameZh: 层序遍历，空节点之后不能再有节点
approaches.nameEn: BFS: no node may follow a gap
approaches.ideaZh: 按层序把节点（包括空孩子）依次放进队列。完全二叉树的层序序列里，所有非空节点都排在最前面，一旦出现了第一个空位，后面就只能全是空。所以遍历时用一个标记记录是否已经见过空节点：见过之后如果又遇到非空节点，直接返回 false；遍历结束都没有冲突就返回 true。
approaches.ideaEn: Walk the tree in level order, enqueuing children even when they are null. In a complete tree every non-null node comes before the first gap in this order. Keep a flag for "seen a null"; if a real node appears after that, return false. If the scan finishes without that happening, the tree is complete.

approaches.nameZh: 按值排序下标 + 前缀最小下标
approaches.nameEn: Sort indices by value, track the smallest index
approaches.ideaZh: 把下标按对应的值从小到大排序（值相同按下标排）。依次处理排序后的下标 j，此前处理过的下标对应的值都不大于 nums[j]，它们都可以作为坡的左端点，而最优的左端点就是其中最小的下标。所以边扫边维护已处理下标的最小值 mn，用 j - mn 更新答案。这个解法思路直接，代价是排序的 O(n log n)。
approaches.ideaEn: Sort indices by their value (ties by index). Scanning them in that order, every index processed earlier has a value no larger than nums[j], so any of them can be the left end of a ramp ending at j, and the best one is the smallest index. Maintain that running minimum mn and update the answer with j - mn. Simple, at the cost of an O(n log n) sort.

approaches.nameZh: 单调递减栈 + 倒序扫描
approaches.ideaZh: 坡的左端点只可能是「比它左边所有数都小」的位置：如果某个 i 左边有更小或相等的数，用那个更靠左的数做左端点一定更宽。从左到右把这些前缀最小值的下标压栈，栈中值严格递减。再从右往左枚举右端点 j，只要栈顶的值不大于 nums[j]，就用 j - 栈顶更新答案并弹出；弹出是安全的，因为更靠左的 j 只会得到更窄的坡。
approaches.ideaEn: Only prefix minima can be useful left ends: if something to the left of i is no larger, starting there is always wider. Push the indices of strictly decreasing prefix minima onto a stack. Then scan j from right to left; while the value at the stack top is at most nums[j], record j - top and pop. Popping is safe because any smaller j would only give a narrower ramp for that left end.

approaches.nameZh: 二维 DP 压成一维
approaches.ideaZh: 先判断长度：len(s1) + len(s2) 不等于 len(s3) 时必然不行。设 dp[i][j] 表示 s1 的前 i 个字符和 s2 的前 j 个字符能否交错组成 s3 的前 i+j 个字符。s3 的第 i+j 个字符要么来自 s1[i-1]（需要 dp[i-1][j] 为真且字符相等），要么来自 s2[j-1]（需要 dp[i][j-1] 为真且字符相等）。每一行只依赖上一行和本行左边，所以可以压成一维数组，就地更新。
approaches.ideaEn: If the lengths do not add up, the answer is false. Let dp[i][j] mean the first i chars of s1 and the first j chars of s2 can interleave into the first i+j chars of s3. The last char of that prefix comes either from s1[i-1] (needs dp[i-1][j] and a match) or from s2[j-1] (needs dp[i][j-1] and a match). Each row depends only on the previous row and the cell to its left, so a single array updated in place is enough.

approaches.ideaZh: 子数组和能被 k 整除，等价于它两端的前缀和对 k 取模的余数相同。所以遍历时维护前缀和对 k 的余数，并统计每个余数出现过几次；当前余数之前出现过几次，就有几个以当前位置结尾的合法子数组。初始余数 0 出现一次。注意负数取模：C++ 里要写成 ((s % k) + k) % k，Python 的 % 本身就返回非负数。
approaches.ideaEn: A subarray sum is divisible by k exactly when the two prefix sums around it have the same remainder mod k. Sweep once, keep the running remainder, and count how often each remainder has appeared; that count is the number of valid subarrays ending here. Seed remainder 0 once. Watch out for negatives: C++ needs ((s % k) + k) % k, while Python’s % is already non-negative.

approaches.ideaZh: 数组有序但含负数，平方后最大值只可能出现在两端：最左边的负数或最右边的正数。用左右两个指针比较两端的平方，把较大的那个写到结果数组的末尾，然后对应指针向内移动一步，写入位置也前移一步。这样从大到小填满结果，一次遍历完成，避免了平方后再排序的 O(n log n)。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: The array is sorted but may contain negatives, so the largest square is always at one of the two ends. Compare the squares at the left and right pointers, write the larger one into the last free slot of the result, and move that pointer inward. Filling from the back yields a sorted result in one pass, instead of squaring and re-sorting in O(n log n). Extra space is O(1), not counting the output.

approaches.ideaZh: 只比较节点和它的左右孩子是不够的，BST 要求整棵左子树都小于根、整棵右子树都大于根。所以递归时给每个节点带上一个开区间 (lo, hi)：节点值必须严格落在区间内。进入左子树时上界收紧为当前值，进入右子树时下界收紧为当前值。根节点的区间是负无穷到正无穷；C++ 里用 long long 的边界避免和 int 极值冲突。
approaches.ideaEn: Comparing a node only with its children is not enough: every node in the left subtree must be smaller than the root, and every node on the right larger. Carry an open interval (lo, hi) down the recursion; each value must lie strictly inside it. Going left tightens hi to the current value, going right tightens lo. The root starts with (-inf, +inf); in C++ use long long bounds so INT_MIN/INT_MAX values do not collide.

approaches.nameZh: 中序遍历检查严格递增
approaches.nameEn: Inorder traversal must be strictly increasing
approaches.ideaZh: BST 的中序遍历结果一定是严格递增的，反过来也成立。所以用显式栈做一次中序遍历，记录上一个访问到的值 prev；每访问一个新节点，就检查它是否严格大于 prev，一旦不满足就返回 false。这样不需要显式处理上下界，也不会被 int 边界值困扰。
approaches.ideaEn: A tree is a BST exactly when its inorder sequence is strictly increasing. Do an iterative inorder walk and remember the previous value; each new value must be strictly greater, otherwise return false. No explicit bounds are needed, so INT extremes cause no trouble.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def isValidBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        stack, cur, prev = [], root, None
        while cur or stack:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            if prev is not None and cur.val <= prev:
                return False
            prev = cur.val
            cur = cur.right
        return True

approaches.nameZh: 哈希表 + 有序列表二分
approaches.nameEn: Hash map of time-ordered lists + binary search
approaches.ideaZh: 每个 key 保存一串按时间戳递增的记录：Python 版用两个平行列表，一个存时间戳、一个存值；C++ 版用 (时间戳, 值) 的 pair 数组。题目保证同一个 key 的 set 调用时间戳严格递增，所以直接追加到末尾就能保持有序，set 是 O(1)。get 时在该 key 的时间戳上二分，找最后一个不超过给定 timestamp 的位置：如果不存在（key 不在表里，或所有时间戳都更大）就返回空串，否则返回同一位置上的值。
approaches.ideaEn: Keep each key’s records in timestamp order: the Python version uses two parallel lists, one of timestamps and one of values, while the C++ version uses a vector of (timestamp, value) pairs. Timestamps for set calls arrive strictly increasing, so appending keeps them sorted and set is O(1). For get, binary-search the key’s timestamps for the last one not exceeding the query. If there is none (unknown key or all timestamps larger), return ""; otherwise return the value at the same position.
approaches.python:
class TimeMap:

    def __init__(self):
        self.times = defaultdict(list)
        self.vals = defaultdict(list)

    def set(self, key: str, value: str, timestamp: int) -> None:
        self.times[key].append(timestamp)
        self.vals[key].append(value)

    def get(self, key: str, timestamp: int) -> str:
        i = bisect.bisect_right(self.times.get(key, []), timestamp)
        return self.vals[key][i - 1] if i else ''


# Your TimeMap object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = TimeMap()
# obj.set(key,value,timestamp)
# param_2 = obj.get(key,timestamp)

approaches.ideaZh: 设 dp[d] 为覆盖到第 d 天为止所有出行日的最低花费。如果第 d 天不出行，就不用为它花钱，dp[d] = dp[d-1]。如果要出行，最后一张覆盖它的票有三种：1 天票从 d-1 接上，7 天票从 d-7 接上，30 天票从 d-30 接上（下标小于 0 时按 0 算），取三者最小值。只需要算到最后一个出行日，天数最多 365。其中 D 为最后一个出行日。
approaches.ideaEn: Let dp[d] be the cheapest way to cover every travel day up to day d. On a non-travel day nothing is bought, so dp[d] = dp[d-1]. On a travel day the last pass covering it is a 1-day pass (from dp[d-1]), a 7-day pass (from dp[d-7]) or a 30-day pass (from dp[d-30]), clamping negative indices to 0; take the minimum. Only days up to the last travel day matter, at most 365. Here D is the last travel day.

approaches.ideaZh: 两个列表各自有序且内部不重叠，可以像归并一样同时扫描。对当前的两个区间，交集的左端是两个左端点的较大值，右端是两个右端点的较小值；左端不超过右端就说明有交集，把它加入答案。然后丢弃右端点较小的那个区间（它不可能再和对方后面的区间相交），对应指针前进一步。额外空间为 O(1)，不计输出。
approaches.ideaEn: Both lists are sorted and internally disjoint, so scan them together like a merge. For the current pair, the overlap is [max of the starts, min of the ends]; if start ≤ end it is a real intersection, so record it. Then advance whichever interval ends first, since it cannot meet any later interval of the other list. Extra space is O(1), not counting the output.

approaches.nameZh: DFS 记录坐标 + 排序分组
approaches.nameEn: DFS with coordinates, then sort and group
approaches.ideaZh: 遍历整棵树，给每个节点记下 (列, 行, 值)：根在 (0, 0)，左孩子列减一、右孩子列加一，行都加一。把所有三元组排序后，顺序正好满足题意：先按列从左到右，同列按行从上到下，同一位置按值从小到大。最后按列切分，每当列号变化就新开一组。
approaches.ideaEn: Traverse the tree and record (column, row, value) for every node: the root is (0, 0), a left child is column - 1 and a right child column + 1, both one row down. Sorting these triples gives exactly the required order: by column, then by row, then by value for nodes sharing a position. Finally split the sorted list into groups whenever the column changes.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def verticalTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        nodes = []

        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], row: int, col: int) -> None:
            if node:
                nodes.append((col, row, node.val))
                dfs(node.left, row + 1, col - 1)
                dfs(node.right, row + 1, col + 1)

        dfs(root, 0, 0)
        nodes.sort()
        res, last = [], None
        for col, _, val in nodes:
            if col != last:
                res.append([])
                last = col
            res[-1].append(val)
        return res

approaches.nameEn: Inorder walk to find the inversions
approaches.ideaZh: 正确的 BST 中序遍历严格递增。交换了两个节点后，中序序列里会出现逆序：如果交换的是相邻的两个节点，只有一处 prev > cur；否则有两处。第一个出错的节点是第一处逆序里的 prev，第二个出错的节点是最后一处逆序里的 cur。用显式栈做中序遍历，记录这两个节点，遍历结束后交换它们的值即可。
approaches.ideaEn: A correct BST has a strictly increasing inorder sequence. After two nodes are swapped, the sequence has one descent (if the swapped nodes are adjacent in order) or two. The first wrong node is prev at the first descent, and the second wrong node is cur at the last descent. Walk inorder with a stack, remember those two nodes, and swap their values at the end.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def recoverTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        stack, cur, prev = [], root, None
        first = second = None
        while cur or stack:
            while cur:
                stack.append(cur)
                cur = cur.left
            cur = stack.pop()
            if prev and prev.val > cur.val:
                if not first:
                    first = prev
                second = cur
            prev = cur
            cur = cur.right
        first.val, second.val = second.val, first.val

approaches.nameZh: Morris 中序遍历（常数空间）
approaches.ideaZh: 找逆序的逻辑和上一个方法完全一样，只是把栈换成 Morris 遍历：利用中序前驱空着的右指针临时指回当前节点，走完左子树后再把指针恢复。每访问到一个节点就和 prev 比较，记录第一处逆序的 prev 和最后一处逆序的 cur。注意遍历过程中不能提前退出，否则临时指针来不及恢复，树结构会被破坏。
approaches.ideaEn: The inversion logic is the same as before; only the stack is replaced by Morris traversal, which temporarily links each inorder predecessor’s empty right pointer back to the current node and removes the link after the left subtree is done. Compare every visited node with prev, keeping prev at the first descent and cur at the last. Do not stop early, or some temporary links would never be removed.
approaches.python:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class Solution:
    def recoverTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        cur, prev, first, second = root, None, None, None
        while cur:
            if cur.left:
                pre = cur.left
                while pre.right and pre.right is not cur:
                    pre = pre.right
                if pre.right is None:
                    pre.right = cur
                    cur = cur.left
                    continue
                pre.right = None
            if prev and prev.val > cur.val:
                if not first:
                    first = prev
                second = cur
            prev = cur
            cur = cur.right
        first.val, second.val = second.val, first.val

approaches.nameZh: 滑动窗口：至多 k 种减至多 k-1 种
approaches.ideaZh: 「恰好 k 种」不好直接用滑动窗口维护，但「至多 k 种」很好做：右端每加入一个数就更新计数，不同数字超过 k 种时左端收缩，直到恢复到 k 种以内，此时以右端结尾的合法子数组有 r - l + 1 个。恰好 k 种的数量 = 至多 k 种的数量 - 至多 k-1 种的数量。由于元素值在 1 到 n 之间，计数可以直接用数组。
approaches.ideaEn: Counting "exactly k distinct" with one window is awkward, but "at most k distinct" is easy: add the right element to a frequency table, shrink from the left while there are more than k distinct values, then add r - l + 1. Exactly k equals atMost(k) minus atMost(k - 1). Values lie in 1..n, so a plain array works as the frequency table.

approaches.nameZh: 多源 BFS 按分钟扩散
approaches.nameEn: Multi-source BFS, one layer per minute
approaches.ideaZh: 把所有一开始就腐烂的橘子同时放进队列作为起点，并数出新鲜橘子的数量。BFS 每处理完一层就代表过了一分钟：这一层的每个腐烂橘子把四周的新鲜橘子变成腐烂并加入下一层，同时新鲜数减一。当新鲜橘子数降为 0 或队列空了就停止。最后如果还有新鲜橘子，说明有的永远够不到，返回 -1，否则返回经过的分钟数。
approaches.ideaEn: Put every initially rotten orange into the queue at once and count the fresh ones. Each BFS layer is one minute: every rotten orange in the layer rots its fresh neighbours, which form the next layer, and the fresh count drops. Stop when no fresh oranges remain or the queue is empty. If any fresh orange is left it is unreachable, so return -1; otherwise return the minutes elapsed.
